1994 r->slot = malloc((size_t)(r->smask + 1) * sizeof(int));
1995 r->cmask = 63;
1996 r->cset = calloc((size_t)r->cmask + 1, sizeof(uint64_t));
1997 r->cpos = malloc((size_t)(r->cmask + 1) * sizeof(uint32_t));
1998 if (!r->off || !r->wt || !r->spos || !r->key || !r->ckey || !r->org || !r->pool || !r->slot || !r->cset || !r->cpos)
1999 ERROR("memory allocation");
2000 for (uint32_t s = 0; s <= r->smask; s++) r->slot[s] = -1;
2001}
2002
2003static void rec_free(rw_rec_t * const r) {
2004 free(r->off);
2005 free(r->wt);
2006 free(r->spos);
2007 free(r->key);
2008 free(r->ckey);
2009 free(r->org);
2010 free(r->pool);
2011 free(r->slot);
2012 free(r->cset);
2013 free(r->cpos);
2014 memset(r, 0, sizeof(*r));
2015}
2016
2017static inline uint32_t rec_hash(const uint64_t key) { return (uint32_t)(key ^ (key >> 32)); }
2018
2019/* Add the codeword ee (sorted, cnt columns) of the origin `org` (see steplog_thr_t) to the codewords of the step;
2020 * returns 0 if it was found before in it */
2021static int rec_add(rw_rec_t * const r, const uint64_t * const zcol, const int * const ee, const int cnt,
2022 const int org) {
2023 const uint64_t key = rw_set_key(zcol, ee, cnt, 0x2545f4914f6cdd1dULL);
2024 uint32_t s = rec_hash(key) & r->smask;
2025 for (; r->slot[s] >= 0; s = (s + 1) & r->smask) {
2026 const int i = r->slot[s];
2027 if (r->key[i] == key && r->wt[i] == cnt && !memcmp(r->pool + r->off[i], ee, (size_t)cnt * sizeof(int))) return 0;
2028 }
2029 if (r->nrec == r->cap) {
2030 r->cap *= 2;
2031 r->off = realloc(r->off, (size_t)r->cap * sizeof(int));
2032 r->wt = realloc(r->wt, (size_t)r->cap * sizeof(int));
2033 r->spos = realloc(r->spos, (size_t)r->cap * sizeof(uint32_t));
2034 r->key = realloc(r->key, (size_t)r->cap * sizeof(uint64_t));
2035 r->ckey = realloc(r->ckey, (size_t)r->cap * sizeof(uint64_t));
2036 r->org = realloc(r->org, (size_t)r->cap);
2037 if (!r->off || !r->wt || !r->spos || !r->key || !r->ckey || !r->org) ERROR("memory allocation");
2038 }
2039 if (r->plen + (size_t)cnt > r->pcap) {
2040 r->pcap = 2 * (r->plen + (size_t)cnt);
2041 r->pool = realloc(r->pool, r->pcap * sizeof(int));
2042 if (!r->pool) ERROR("memory allocation");
2043 }
2044 if (2 * ((size_t)r->nrec + 1) > (size_t)r->smask + 1) { /* twice as many slots (at most half full) */
2045 r->smask = 2 * r->smask + 1;
2046 free(r->slot);
2047 r->slot = malloc(((size_t)r->smask + 1) * sizeof(int));
2048 if (!r->slot) ERROR("memory allocation");
2049 for (uint32_t q = 0; q <= r->smask; q++) r->slot[q] = -1;
2050 for (int i = 0; i < r->nrec; i++) {
2051 uint32_t q = rec_hash(r->key[i]) & r->smask;
2052 while (r->slot[q] >= 0) q = (q + 1) & r->smask;
2053 r->slot[q] = i;
2054 r->spos[i] = q;
2055 }
2056 s = rec_hash(key) & r->smask;
2057 while (r->slot[s] >= 0) s = (s + 1) & r->smask;
2058 }
2059 const int i = r->nrec++;
2060 r->off[i] = (int)r->plen;
2061 memcpy(r->pool + r->plen, ee, (size_t)cnt * sizeof(int));
2062 r->plen += (size_t)cnt;
2063 r->wt[i] = cnt;
2064 r->key[i] = key;
2065 r->ckey[i] = 0;
2066 r->org[i] = (unsigned char)org;
2067 r->slot[s] = i;
2068 r->spos[i] = s;
2069 return 1;
2070}
2071
2072/* Count the canonical class `key` in this step: returns 0 if it was counted before */
2073static int rec_cset_add(rw_rec_t * const r, const uint64_t key) {
2074 uint32_t s = rec_hash(key) & r->cmask;
2075 for (; r->cset[s]; s = (s + 1) & r->cmask)
2076 if (r->cset[s] == key) return 0;
2077 if (2 * ((size_t)r->ncset + 1) > (size_t)r->cmask + 1) { /* twice as many slots */
2078 const uint32_t cmask = 2 * r->cmask + 1;
2079 uint64_t * const cset = calloc((size_t)cmask + 1, sizeof(uint64_t));
2080 uint32_t * const cpos = malloc(((size_t)cmask + 1) * sizeof(uint32_t));
2081 if (!cset || !cpos) ERROR("memory allocation");
2082 for (int i = 0; i < r->ncset; i++) {
2083 const uint64_t k = r->cset[r->cpos[i]];
2084 uint32_t q = rec_hash(k) & cmask;
2085 while (cset[q]) q = (q + 1) & cmask;
2086 cset[q] = k;
2087 cpos[i] = q;
2088 }
2089 free(r->cset);
2090 free(r->cpos);
2091 r->cset = cset;
2092 r->cpos = cpos;
2093 r->cmask = cmask;
2094 s = rec_hash(key) & r->cmask;
2095 while (r->cset[s]) s = (s + 1) & r->cmask;
2096 }
2097 r->cset[s] = key;
2098 r->cpos[r->ncset++] = s;
2099 return 1;
2100}
2101
2102/* A new step of the kind `src` (the codewords of the last step are recorded, see rw_rec_flush()) */
2103static void rec_step(rw_rec_t * const r, const int src) {
2104 for (int i = 0; i < r->nrec; i++) r->slot[r->spos[i]] = -1;
2105 for (int i = 0; i < r->ncset; i++) r->cset[r->cpos[i]] = 0;
2106 r->nrec = r->nflushed = r->ncset = 0;
2107 r->plen = 0;
2108 r->src = src;
2109}
2110
2111/* Stage 5: the canonical key of the codeword c (w sorted columns), see rw_canon(); a codeword heavier than
2112 * RW_CANON_WMAX is its own canonical form (early in a run, before light codewords are found) */
2113#define RW_CANON_WMAX 64
2114static uint64_t rw_canon_key(distfork_ctx_t * const ctx, rw_thr_t * const th, const int * const c, const int w) {
2115 memcpy(th->cbuf, c, (size_t)w * sizeof(int));
2116 if (w <= RW_CANON_WMAX) rw_canon(ctx->t3, ctx->gdb, th->ws, th->cbuf, w);
2117 return rw_set_key(ctx->zcol, th->cbuf, w, 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ULL);
2118}
2119
2120/* Stage 5 (under `cw_mutex`, after the codeword i of the step is recorded): a codeword of the minimum weight found in
2121 * a uniform step counts one step incidence of its canonical class, unless the class was counted in this step */
2122static void rw_canon_note_locked(distfork_ctx_t * const ctx, rw_thr_t * const th, const int i) {
2123 params_t * const p = ctx->p;
2124 rw_rec_t * const r = &th->rec;
2125 rw_canon_sync_locked(ctx);
2126 rw_canon_stats_t * const cs = &p->canon;
2127 if (r->src != CW_SRC_RW_UNIFORM || r->wt[i] != cs->w || cs->full) return;
2128 if (!r->ckey[i]) r->ckey[i] = rw_canon_key(ctx, th, r->pool + r->off[i], r->wt[i]);
2129 if (rw_canon_tab_raw(ctx->canon_tab, r->key[i])) cs->raw++;
2130 int is_new = 0;
2131 uint32_t * const inc = rw_canon_tab_class(ctx->canon_tab, r->ckey[i], &is_new);
2132 if (!inc || ctx->canon_tab->full) { /* too many classes: back to the rule of codeword_hit_stats() */
2133 cs->full = 1;
2134 return;
2135 }
2136 if (!rec_cset_add(r, r->ckey[i])) return; /* the class was counted in this step */
2137 const uint32_t m = (*inc)++;
2138 cs->n_unif++;
2139 if (m == 0) {
2140 cs->classes++;
2141 cs->f1++;
2142 } else if (m == 1) {
2143 cs->f1--;
2144 cs->f2++;
2145 } else if (m == 2) {
2146 cs->f2--;
2147 }
2148}
2149
2150/* Record the codewords of the current step not recorded yet (see rw_rec_t): the canonical keys outside the mutex,
2151 * then the codewords and the stop checks under it */
2152static void rw_rec_flush(distfork_ctx_t * const ctx, rw_thr_t * const th, const int tid) {
2153 rw_rec_t * const r = &th->rec;
2154 if (r->nflushed >= r->nrec) return;
2155 if (ctx->canon_tab && r->src == CW_SRC_RW_UNIFORM) { /* the codewords which may have the minimum weight */
2156 const int cw = atomic_load_explicit(&ctx->canon_w, memory_order_relaxed);
2157 for (int i = r->nflushed; i < r->nrec; i++)
2158 if (r->wt[i] <= cw) r->ckey[i] = rw_canon_key(ctx, th, r->pool + r->off[i], r->wt[i]);
2159 }
2160 pthread_mutex_lock(&ctx->cw_mutex);
2161 steplog_thr_t * const slt = ctx->wargs[tid].slt; /* (steplog=FILE: the origins) */
2162 for (int i = r->nflushed; i < r->nrec; i++) {
2163 if (slt) slt->orig = r->org[i];
2164 rw_record_locked(ctx, r->pool + r->off[i], r->wt[i], tid, 0, r->src);
2165 if (ctx->canon_tab) rw_canon_note_locked(ctx, th, i);
2166 }
2167 rw_record_checks(ctx);
2168 pthread_mutex_unlock(&ctx->cw_mutex);
2169 r->nflushed = r->nrec;
2170}
2171
2172/* Record the RW codeword ee (sorted, cnt columns) of the origin `org` (see steplog_thr_t) found in the current step:
2173 * at once without rw_rec_buf (as before rw_opt), otherwise once per step, at once if lighter than the upper bound, or
2174 * else at the end of the step */
2175static void rw_rec_record(distfork_ctx_t * const ctx, rw_thr_t * const th, const int * const ee, const int cnt,
2176 const int tid, long long * const hits, const int org) {
2177 if (!ctx->rw_rec_buf) {
2178 if (rw_is_hit(ctx, cnt)) (*hits)++;
2179 if (ctx->wargs[tid].slt) ctx->wargs[tid].slt->orig = org;
2180 rw_record_codeword(ctx, ee, cnt, tid, 0, th->rec.src);
2181 return;
2182 }
2183 if (!rec_add(&th->rec, ctx->zcol, ee, cnt, org)) return; /* found before in this step */
2184 if (rw_is_hit(ctx, cnt)) (*hits)++;
2185 const int dmax = atomic_load_explicit(&ctx->dmax, memory_order_relaxed);
2186 if (dmax <= 0 || cnt < dmax) rw_rec_flush(ctx, th, tid); /* a new upper bound */
2187}
2188
2189/* steplog=FILE: the canonical key (rw_canon_key()) of the codeword c (sorted, w columns) with the key `key`, once per
2190 * codeword in this thread (then from the cache of the thread); 0 without the RW stages, without T_3 and G, or above
2191 * RW_CANON_WMAX */
2192static uint64_t steplog_ckey(distfork_ctx_t * const ctx, steplog_thr_t * const s, rw_thr_t * const th,
2193 const int * const c, const int w, const uint64_t key) {
2194 if (!th || !ctx->zcol || !(ctx->t3 || ctx->gdb) || w > RW_CANON_WMAX) return 0;
2195 uint32_t q = 0;
2196 if (s->ck) {
2197 for (q = steplog_slot(key, s->cmask); s->ck[q]; q = (q + 1) & s->cmask)
2198 if (s->ck[q] == key) return s->cv[q];
2199 }
2200 const uint64_t ck = rw_canon_key(ctx, th, c, w);
2201 if (s->ncache >= STEPLOG_CACHE_MAX) return ck;
2202 if (!s->ck || 2 * ((size_t)s->ncache + 1) > (size_t)s->cmask + 1) { /* twice as many slots (at most half full) */
2203 const uint32_t cmask = s->ck ? 2 * s->cmask + 1 : 1023;
2204 uint64_t * const nk = calloc((size_t)cmask + 1, sizeof(uint64_t));
2205 uint64_t * const nv = malloc(((size_t)cmask + 1) * sizeof(uint64_t));
2206 if (!nk || !nv) ERROR("memory allocation");
2207 for (uint32_t t = 0; s->ck && t <= s->cmask; t++) {
2208 if (!s->ck[t]) continue;
2209 uint32_t u = steplog_slot(s->ck[t], cmask);
2210 while (nk[u]) u = (u + 1) & cmask;
2211 nk[u] = s->ck[t];
2212 nv[u] = s->cv[t];
2213 }
2214 free(s->ck);
2215 free(s->cv);
2216 s->ck = nk;
2217 s->cv = nv;
2218 s->cmask = cmask;
2219 for (q = steplog_slot(key, s->cmask); s->ck[q]; q = (q + 1) & s->cmask) continue;
2220 }
2221 s->ck[q] = key;
2222 s->cv[q] = ck;
2223 s->ncache++;
2224 return ck;
2225}
2226
2227/* steplog=FILE: add the key to the set of the keys logged (under the mutex of the log); returns 1 if it is new there
2228 * (then its support is logged) */
2229static int steplog_seen_add(steplog_t * const sl, const uint64_t key) {
2230 if (sl->seen_full) return 0;
2231 uint32_t q = steplog_slot(key, sl->smask);
2232 for (; sl->seen[q]; q = (q + 1) & sl->smask)
2233 if (sl->seen[q] == key) return 0;
2234 if (sl->nseen >= STEPLOG_SEEN_MAX) {
2235 sl->seen_full = 1;
2236 return 0;
2237 }
2238 if (2 * ((size_t)sl->nseen + 1) > (size_t)sl->smask + 1) { /* twice as many slots (at most half full) */
2239 const uint32_t smask = 2 * sl->smask + 1;
2240 uint64_t * const ns = calloc((size_t)smask + 1, sizeof(uint64_t));
2241 if (!ns) ERROR("memory allocation");
2242 for (uint32_t t = 0; t <= sl->smask; t++) {
2243 if (!sl->seen[t]) continue;
2244 uint32_t u = steplog_slot(sl->seen[t], smask);
2245 while (ns[u]) u = (u + 1) & smask;
2246 ns[u] = sl->seen[t];
2247 }
2248 free(sl->seen);
2249 sl->seen = ns;
2250 sl->smask = smask;
2251 for (q = steplog_slot(key, sl->smask); sl->seen[q]; q = (q + 1) & sl->smask) continue;
2252 }
2253 sl->seen[q] = key;
2254 sl->nseen++;
2255 return 1;
2256}
2257
2258/* steplog=FILE: append the formatted text to the lines of the step */
2259static void steplog_printf(steplog_thr_t * const s, const char * const fmt, ...) __attribute__((format(printf, 2, 3)));
2260static void steplog_printf(steplog_thr_t * const s, const char * const fmt, ...) {
2261 for (;;) {
2262 va_list ap;
2263 va_start(ap, fmt);
2264 const int len = vsnprintf(s->out ? s->out + s->olen : NULL, s->out ? s->ocap - s->olen : 0, fmt, ap);
2265 va_end(ap);
2266 if (len < 0) ERROR("steplog: formatting error");
2267 if (s->out && s->olen + (size_t)len < s->ocap) {
2268 s->olen += (size_t)len;
2269 return;
2270 }
2271 s->ocap = 2 * (s->olen + (size_t)len + 1) + 4096;
2272 s->out = steplog_realloc(s->out, s->ocap);
2273 }
2274}
2275
2276/* steplog=FILE: the L syndrome of the codeword c (w columns): the mask with at most 64 rows of L, otherwise its hash
2277 * (a fixed random linear function of the syndrome); 0 for a classical code */
2278static uint64_t steplog_lsig(const params_t * const p, const int * const c, const int w) {
2279 const colmask_t * const cm = p->maskL;
2280 if (p->classical || !cm) return 0;
2281 uint64_t s = 0;
2282 for (int i = 0; i < w; i++) {
2283 if (cm->kw == 1) {
2284 s ^= cm->mask[c[i]];
2285 continue;
2286 }
2287 for (int k = 0; k < cm->kw; k++)
2288 for (word x = cm->mask[(size_t)c[i] * cm->kw + k]; x; x &= x - 1)
2289 s ^= mix64(0x2545f4914f6cdd1dULL + (uint64_t)(64 * k + __builtin_ctzll(x)));
2290 }
2291 return s;
2292}
2293
2294/* steplog=FILE: write the lines of the current step of the thread `tid` (the global step `step` of the type `type`
2295 * with a, b, ns, rank as in the help of steplog; ok: 1 completed, 0 abandoned at a stop) */
2296static void steplog_step_end(distfork_ctx_t * const ctx, steplog_thr_t * const s, rw_thr_t * const th, const int tid,
2297 const long step, const char type, const int a, const int b, const int ns, const int rank,
2298 const int ok) {
2299 steplog_t * const sl = ctx->steplog;
2300 const params_t * const p = ctx->p;
2301 const csr_t * const HT = ctx->mHT_cc;
2302 const double t1 = get_time_sec();
2303 s->open = 0;
2304 for (int i = 0; i < s->n; i++) s->ckey[i] = steplog_ckey(ctx, s, th, s->pool + s->off[i], s->w[i], s->key[i]);
2305 pthread_mutex_lock(&sl->mtx);
2306 s->olen = 0;
2307 steplog_printf(s, "S %d %ld %c %d %d %d %d %d %d %lld %lld\n", tid, step, type, a, b, ns, rank, ok, s->n,
2308 (long long)llround((t1 - ctx->start_time) * 1e6), (long long)llround((t1 - s->t0) * 1e6));
2309 for (int i = 0; i < s->n; i++) {
2310 steplog_printf(s, "C %d %016" PRIx64 " %016" PRIx64 " %c %c", s->w[i], s->key[i], s->ckey[i], s->flag[i],
2311 s->org[i]);
2312 if (steplog_seen_add(sl, s->key[i])) { /* the first line of the key: the L syndrome, the detectors, the support */
2313 const int * const c = s->pool + s->off[i];
2314 int rlo = INT_MAX, rhi = -1;
2315 for (int k = 0; k < s->w[i]; k++) {
2316 for (int e = HT->p[c[k]]; e < HT->p[c[k] + 1]; e++) {
2317 if (HT->i[e] < rlo) rlo = HT->i[e];
2318 if (HT->i[e] > rhi) rhi = HT->i[e];
2319 }
2320 }
2321 steplog_printf(s, " %" PRIx64 " %d %d", steplog_lsig(p, c, s->w[i]), (rhi >= 0) ? rlo : -1, rhi);
2322 for (int k = 0; k < s->w[i]; k++) steplog_printf(s, " %d", c[k]);
2323 }
2324 steplog_printf(s, "\n");
2325 }
2326 if (fwrite(s->out, 1, s->olen, sl->f) != s->olen) ERROR("steplog: write error (%s)", strerror(errno));
2327 sl->nsteps++;
2328 sl->ncw += s->n;
2329 pthread_mutex_unlock(&sl->mtx);
2330}
2331
2332/* A nontrivial RW candidate ee (cnt columns, any order; L ee != 0) of the current step: recorded if lighter than
2333 * `limit`, unless its shortened form (Stage 2: T_3 contraction, the rows of G) is lighter (then only with outC or maxC
2334 * and dW >= 1, so that the codewords of weight up to d + dW are kept); and its shortened form, if lighter than the
2335 * current limit (`pair`: rw_pairs_limit(), otherwise rw_cw_limit()). With irred=1, a reducible shortened form is
2336 * replaced by an irreducible part (a lighter codeword). The single candidates are circuits, hence irreducible. Only
2337 * the candidates up to the weight min(dmax + rw_ext (+ dW with outC or maxC), RW_SHORTEN_WMAX) are shortened (none
2338 * before an upper bound is known, nor while dmax is still large: early candidates on wide DEMs can have hundreds of
2339 * columns, where greedy pair scans would take O(cnt^3) work). The steepest descent over the rows of G comes first, on
2340 * the candidate itself, then the T_3 contraction (alternating, at most 8 rounds): the realized-generator filter of
2341 * rw_pairs_step() is loss-free only if the first descent move is made on the circuit C_P(y) (Theorem known_gen(c) of
2342 * the notes); a T_3 contraction first can lower the gain of the realized row of G (rw_opt=3 lost minimum-weight hits on
2343 * a small code). The Stern filters are on only while the shortening is not capped, see rw_filters_exact(). */
2344#define RW_SHORTEN_WMAX 64
2345static inline int rw_lim_ext(const int limit, const int ext) {
2346 if (ext <= 0 || limit > RW_SHORTEN_WMAX) return limit;
2347 return minint(limit + ext, RW_SHORTEN_WMAX + 1);
2348}
2349
2350/* The Stern filters of rw_pairs_step() (the columns with a zero L syndrome and w_x <= 2, rw_filter_t3, and those whose
2351 * circuits are rows of G, rw_filter_g) skip a pair x, y only because the single candidate C_P(y), one or w_G - 2
2352 * heavier than the pair, is shortened (Theorems 3(b) and 5(c) of the notes): this holds while the shortening is not
2353 * capped by RW_SHORTEN_WMAX, i.e., for the upper bound dmax with dmax + rw_ext (+ dW when collecting) <= 64 */
2354static inline bool rw_filters_exact(const distfork_ctx_t * const ctx) {
2355 const int dm = atomic_load_explicit(&ctx->dmax, memory_order_relaxed);
2356 const int dw = (ctx->collecting && ctx->p->dW > 0) ? ctx->p->dW : 0;
2357 return dm > 0 && (long long)dm + dw + ctx->rw_ext <= RW_SHORTEN_WMAX;
2358}
2359
2360static void rw_candidate(distfork_ctx_t * const ctx, rw_thr_t * const th, rci_t * const ee, const int cnt,
2361 const int limit, const bool pair, const int tid, long long * const hits) {
2362 params_t * const p = ctx->p;
2363 int cs = cnt;
2364 int * const sh = th->buf;
2365 const int dm = atomic_load_explicit(&ctx->dmax, memory_order_relaxed);
2366 const int scap = minint(RW_SHORTEN_WMAX,
2367 dm + ((ctx->collecting && p->dW > 0) ? p->dW : 0) + (pair ? ctx->rw_ext2 : ctx->rw_ext));
2368 if (ctx->rw_shorten && dm > 0 && cnt <= scap) {
2369 memcpy(sh, ee, (size_t)cnt * sizeof(int));
2370 for (int it = 0; it < 8; it++) {
2371 const int c0 = cs;
2372 if (ctx->rw_gshort) cs = rw_gdb_shorten(ctx->gdb, th->ws, sh, cs); /* (first: see above) */
2373 if (ctx->rw_contract) cs = rw_t3_contract(ctx->t3, sh, cs);
2374 if (cs == c0) break;
2375 }
2376 }
2377 if (cnt < limit && (cs == cnt || (ctx->collecting && p->dW >= 1))) {
2378 rci_quick_sort(ee, cnt);
2379 rw_rec_record(ctx, th, ee, cnt, tid, hits, pair ? 2 : 1);
2380 }
2381 if (cs == cnt) return;
2382 const int lim2 = pair ? rw_pairs_limit(ctx) : rw_cw_limit(ctx); /* (the upper bound may have decreased) */
2383 if (cs >= lim2 || cs <= 0) return;
2384 rci_quick_sort(sh, cs);
2385 if (p->irred && cs >= 3 && csr_cols_rank(ctx->mHT_cc, cs, sh, th->ws->irr) != cs - 1) {
2386 atomic_fetch_add_explicit(&ctx->cw_red_rw, 1, memory_order_relaxed);
2387 cs = rw_cw_reduce(ctx->mHT_cc, p->maskL, th->ws, sh, cs);
2388 }
2389 rw_rec_record(ctx, th, sh, cs, tid, hits, pair ? 6 : 5);
2390}
2391
2392/* The columns of a RW step (see rw_pairs_step()): all columns of H (full = 1: the transposed reduced matrix `ht`), or
2393 * the columns of a row slab (Stage 3, the rows of its transposed reduced matrix at rows + c * stride) */
2394typedef struct {
2395 const mzd_t *ht; /* the transposed reduced matrix (row c: the column c of the step in the pivot rows), or */
2396 const word *rows; /* (ht NULL) its row c at rows + c * stride */
2397 size_t stride;
2398 int ncols; /* the columns of the step */
2399 const int *colmap; /* the column of H of each column of the step (NULL: the same) */
2400 int full; /* 1: all columns of H (the L syndromes `srows` of the pairs, the Harris-FKG score) */
2401} rw_view_t;
2402
2403static inline const word *view_row(const rw_view_t * const v, const int c) {
2404 return v->ht ? mzd_row_cons(v->ht, c) : v->rows + (size_t)c * v->stride;
2405}
2406
2407static inline int view_col(const rw_view_t * const v, const int c) { return v->colmap ? v->colmap[c] : c; }
2408
2409/* The rows of L reduced with the pivot rows of the RW step (with at most 64 rows of L, ws->nl > 0): the L syndromes of
2410 * the codewords of all columns (`lhash` is then the column masks of L), see rw_pairs_step() */
2411static void rw_srows(rw_pairs_ws_t * const ws, const mzd_t * const mH, const rci_t * const pivs, const int rank,
2412 const uint64_t * const lhash) {
2413 const int nl = ws->nl;
2414 const wi_t width = ws->width;
2415 memcpy(ws->srows, ws->lrows, (size_t)nl * width * sizeof(word));
2416 for (int i = 0; i < rank; i++) {
2417 word g = lhash[pivs[i]];
2418 if (!g) continue;
2419 const word * const ri = mzd_row_cons(mH, i);
2420 for (; g; g &= g - 1) rw_row_xor(ws->srows + (size_t)__builtin_ctzll(g) * width, ri, width);
2421 }
2422}
2423
2424/* The L syndrome of the codeword of the column col from the reduced rows of L (see rw_srows()) */
2425static inline uint64_t rw_srows_sig(const rw_pairs_ws_t * const ws, const int col) {
2426 uint64_t sig = 0;
2427 const word * const sc = ws->srows + (col >> 6);
2428 for (int t = 0; t < ws->nl; t++) sig |= ((sc[(size_t)t * ws->width] >> (col & 63)) & 1) << t;
2429 return sig;
2430}
2431
2432/* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
2433 * Stage 4 (rw_opt, RW_OPT_DUAL): the sparse-dual elimination of the full-matrix RW steps (Proposition 3 of
2434 * doc/rw_triplet_degeneracies.tex). Instead of the reduced m x n matrix R = M H, the elimination keeps the m x m
2435 * transform M (the identity before the first step, then its rows 0..rank-1 from the previous step, as the dense
2436 * elimination keeps the rows of R): the bit R[r][c] is the parity of the row r of M on the rows of the column c of H,
2437 * O(|h_c|) operations, and the row operations act on rows of m bits instead of n. The pivots, their rows, and the
2438 * reduced columns are those of the dense elimination (rw_eliminate(), with the same blocks). After the elimination,
2439 * the transpose MT of the pivot rows of M gives the reduced column c (its circuit) as the sum of the rows MT[d] over
2440 * the rows d of h_c, and its L syndrome as the sum of hl[d]. The columns are formed only when needed: those with a
2441 * nonzero L syndrome (the single candidates and the pairs), and those with a zero L syndrome only in the buckets of the
2442 * pairs with a nonzero one (see rw_dual_entries()), so that the same codewords are recorded in the same order as with
2443 * the dense matrices. Only with at most 64 rows of L (exact L syndromes).
2444 * ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ */
2445typedef struct {
2446 int m; /* the rows of H */
2447 size_t mw; /* words per row of M */
2448 word *M; /* the transform M: m rows of mw words */
2449 word *tab; /* the tables of the blocked elimination (nt << k rows of tstride words) */
2450 size_t tstride;
2451 int k, nt; /* pivots per table and tables (0: column by column), see rw_block_params() */
2452 word *MT; /* the pivot rows of M transposed: m rows of aw words */
2453 size_t aw;
2454 uint64_t *hl; /* the L syndrome of each row d of MT: the sum of L(pivs[r]) over the r with M[r][d] = 1 */
2455 word *hb; /* the bucket words of each row d of MT (nk words each, see rw_dual_entries()) */
2456 word *pool; /* the reduced columns formed (aw words each) */
2457 int *pcol; /* their columns */
2458 uint64_t *psig; /* their L syndromes */
2459 int np1; /* the first np1 of them: the columns with a nonzero L syndrome (in increasing order) */
2460 int npool, pcap;
2461 int *pidx; /* the formed column of each entry of the pairs */
2462 uint64_t *bset; /* the buckets of the columns with a nonzero L syndrome (keys + 1; 0: an empty slot) */
2463 uint32_t bmask;
2464} rw_dual_t;
2465
2466static rw_dual_t *rw_dual_init(const distfork_ctx_t * const ctx) {
2467 const int m = ctx->p->spaH->rows, nvar = ctx->p->spaH->cols;
2468 rw_dual_t * const d = calloc(1, sizeof(rw_dual_t));
2469 if (!d) ERROR("memory allocation");
2470 d->m = m;
2471 d->mw = ((size_t)m + 63) >> 6;
2472 d->M = calloc((size_t)m * d->mw + 1, sizeof(word));
2473 d->MT = malloc(((size_t)m * d->mw + 1) * sizeof(word));
2474 d->hb = malloc(((size_t)m * d->mw + 1) * sizeof(word));
2475 d->hl = malloc(((size_t)m + 1) * sizeof(uint64_t));
2476 d->pidx = malloc(((size_t)nvar + 1) * sizeof(int));
2477 d->pcap = 256;
2478 d->pool = malloc((size_t)d->pcap * d->mw * sizeof(word));
2479 d->pcol = malloc((size_t)d->pcap * sizeof(int));
2480 d->psig = malloc((size_t)d->pcap * sizeof(uint64_t));
2481 d->bmask = 255;
2482 d->bset = calloc((size_t)d->bmask + 1, sizeof(uint64_t));
2483 rw_block_params(m, (wi_t)d->mw, &d->k, &d->nt);
2484 d->tstride = (d->mw + 7) & ~(size_t)7;
2485 const size_t tbytes = (d->nt > 0 ? ((size_t)d->nt << d->k) : 1) * d->tstride * sizeof(word);
2486 d->tab = aligned_alloc(64, tbytes);
2487 if (!d->M || !d->MT || !d->hb || !d->hl || !d->pidx || !d->pool || !d->pcol || !d->psig || !d->bset || !d->tab)
2488 ERROR("memory allocation");
2489 memset(d->tab, 0, tbytes);
2490 for (int r = 0; r < m; r++) d->M[(size_t)r * d->mw + (size_t)(r >> 6)] = (word)1 << (r & 63);
2491 return d;
2492}
2493
2494static rw_dual_t *rw_dual_free(rw_dual_t *d) {
2495 if (!d) return NULL;
2496 free(d->M);
2497 free(d->MT);
2498 free(d->hb);
2499 free(d->hl);
2500 free(d->pidx);
2501 free(d->pool);
2502 free(d->pcol);
2503 free(d->psig);
2504 free(d->bset);
2505 free(d->tab);
2506 free(d);
2507 return NULL;
2508}
2509
2510/* The bit of R = M H in the row `row` of M and the column of H with the rows dets[0..nd-1] */
2511static inline word dual_dot(const word * const row, const int * const dets, const int nd) {
2512 word b = 0;
2513 for (int k = 0; k < nd; k++) b ^= row[dets[k] >> 6] >> (dets[k] & 63);
2514 return b & 1;
2515}
2516
2517/* The sparse-dual elimination of the columns order[0], order[1], ... in the rows 0..nrows_eff-1 (see rw_dual_t): the
2518 * same pivots and row operations as rw_eliminate() (or gauss_one_rows() column by column, with fewer than 128 rows),
2519 * on the rows of M. Returns the rank, or -1 if interrupted by a stop flag. */
2520__attribute__((noinline))
2521static int rw_dual_eliminate(distfork_ctx_t * const ctx, rw_dual_t * const d, const int nrows_eff, const int nvar,
2522 const rci_t * const order, rci_t * const pivs, word * const piv_mask) {
2523 const int * const cp = ctx->dcp, * const ci = ctx->dci;
2524 word * const M = d->M;
2525 const size_t mw = d->mw;
2526 const int K = d->k, nt = d->nt;
2527 int rank = 0, i = 0;
2528 if (nt == 0) { /* column by column */
2529 for (; i < nvar && rank < nrows_eff; i++) {
2530 if ((i & 15) == 15 && (atomic_load_explicit(&ctx->stop_flag, memory_order_relaxed) ||
2531 atomic_load_explicit(&ctx->rw_stop_flag, memory_order_relaxed)))
2532 return -1;
2533 const int col = order[i];
2534 const int * const dets = ci + cp[col];
2535 const int nd = cp[col + 1] - cp[col];
2536 int found = rank;
2537 while (found < nrows_eff && !dual_dot(M + (size_t)found * mw, dets, nd)) found++;
2538 if (found == nrows_eff) continue;
2539 word * const prow = M + (size_t)rank * mw;
2540 if (found != rank) {
2541 word * const fr = M + (size_t)found * mw;
2542 for (size_t w = 0; w < mw; w++) {
2543 const word t = prow[w];
2544 prow[w] = fr[w];
2545 fr[w] = t;
2546 }
2547 }
2548 for (int r = 0; r < nrows_eff; r++) {
2549 word * const row = M + (size_t)r * mw;
2550 if (r != rank && dual_dot(row, dets, nd)) rw_row_xor(row, prow, (wi_t)mw);
2551 }
2552 pivs[rank++] = col;
2553 piv_mask[col >> 6] |= (word)1 << (col & 63);
2554 }
2555 return rank;
2556 }
2557 const int P = K * nt; /* pivots per block */
2558 int bc[RW_K_MAX * RW_NT_MAX]; /* the pivot columns of the block */
2559 while (i < nvar && rank < nrows_eff) {
2560 const int r0 = rank; /* the first pivot row of the block */
2561 int kk = 0;
2562 while (kk < P && i < nvar && rank < nrows_eff) {
2563 if ((i & 15) == 15 && (atomic_load_explicit(&ctx->stop_flag, memory_order_relaxed) ||
2564 atomic_load_explicit(&ctx->rw_stop_flag, memory_order_relaxed)))
2565 return -1;
2566 const int col = order[i++];
2567 const int * const dets = ci + cp[col];
2568 const int nd = cp[col + 1] - cp[col];
2569 uint64_t mask = 0; /* the block's pivot rows with a 1 in the column */
2570 for (int l = 0; l < kk; l++) mask |= (uint64_t)dual_dot(M + (size_t)(r0 + l) * mw, dets, nd) << l;
2571 int found = -1;
2572 for (int r = rank; r < nrows_eff; r++) {
2573 const word * const row = M + (size_t)r * mw;
2574 word b = dual_dot(row, dets, nd);
2575 for (uint64_t m2 = mask; m2; m2 &= m2 - 1) {
2576 const int c = bc[__builtin_ctzll(m2)];
2577 b ^= dual_dot(row, ci + cp[c], cp[c + 1] - cp[c]);
2578 }
2579 if (b) {
2580 found = r;
2581 break;
2582 }
2583 }
2584 if (found < 0) continue; /* not a pivot */
2585 word * const prow = M + (size_t)rank * mw;
2586 if (found != rank) {
2587 word * const fr = M + (size_t)found * mw;
2588 for (size_t w = 0; w < mw; w++) {
2589 const word t = prow[w];
2590 prow[w] = fr[w];
2591 fr[w] = t;
2592 }
2593 }
2594 for (int l = 0; l < kk; l++) { /* reduce the new pivot row with the block's pivot rows */
2595 const int c = bc[l];
2596 if (dual_dot(prow, ci + cp[c], cp[c + 1] - cp[c])) rw_row_xor(prow, M + (size_t)(r0 + l) * mw, (wi_t)mw);
2597 }
2598 for (uint64_t m2 = mask; m2; m2 &= m2 - 1) /* and clear the column in them */
2599 rw_row_xor(M + (size_t)(r0 + __builtin_ctzll(m2)) * mw, prow, (wi_t)mw);
2600 bc[kk++] = col;
2601 pivs[rank] = col;
2602 piv_mask[col >> 6] |= (word)1 << (col & 63);
2603 rank++;
2604 }
2605 if (kk == 0) break;
2606 const int ntab = (kk + K - 1) / K;
2607 for (int t = 0; t < ntab; t++) {
2608 word * const Tt = d->tab + ((size_t)t << K) * d->tstride;
2609 const int kt = (kk - t * K < K) ? kk - t * K : K;
2610 for (unsigned g = 1; g < (1u << kt); g++) {
2611 const unsigned gc = g ^ (g >> 1), gp = (g - 1) ^ ((g - 1) >> 1);
2612 rw_row_xor3(Tt + gc * d->tstride, Tt + gp * d->tstride, M + (size_t)(r0 + t * K + __builtin_ctz(g)) * mw,
2613 (wi_t)mw);
2614 }
2615 }
2616 for (int r = 0; r < nrows_eff; r++) {
2617 if (r == r0) {
2618 r = rank - 1;
2619 continue;
2620 }
2621 word * const row = M + (size_t)r * mw;
2622 unsigned x[RW_NT_MAX];
2623 for (int t = 0; t < ntab; t++) {
2624 const int lo = t * K, hi = (lo + K < kk) ? lo + K : kk;
2625 unsigned xt = 0;
2626 for (int l = lo; l < hi; l++) {
2627 const int c = bc[l];
2628 xt |= (unsigned)dual_dot(row, ci + cp[c], cp[c + 1] - cp[c]) << (l - lo);
2629 }
2630 x[t] = xt;
2631 }
2632 for (int t = 0; t < ntab; t++)
2633 if (x[t]) rw_row_xor(row, d->tab + (((size_t)t << K) + x[t]) * d->tstride, (wi_t)mw);
2634 }
2635 }
2636 return rank;
2637}
2638
2639/* A new formed column of the pool (see rw_dual_t): the sum of the rows MT[d] over the rows d of the column c of H */
2640static word *dual_form(const distfork_ctx_t * const ctx, rw_dual_t * const d, const int c, const uint64_t sig) {
2641 if (d->npool == d->pcap) {
2642 d->pcap *= 2;
2643 d->pool = realloc(d->pool, (size_t)d->pcap * d->mw * sizeof(word));
2644 d->pcol = realloc(d->pcol, (size_t)d->pcap * sizeof(int));
2645 d->psig = realloc(d->psig, (size_t)d->pcap * sizeof(uint64_t));
2646 if (!d->pool || !d->pcol || !d->psig) ERROR("memory allocation");
2647 }
2648 const size_t aw = d->aw;
2649 word * const v = d->pool + (size_t)d->npool * aw;
2650 memset(v, 0, aw * sizeof(word));
2651 for (int k = ctx->dcp[c]; k < ctx->dcp[c + 1]; k++) rw_row_xor(v, d->MT + (size_t)ctx->dci[k] * aw, (wi_t)aw);
2652 d->pcol[d->npool] = c;
2653 d->psig[d->npool] = sig;
2654 d->npool++;
2655 return v;
2656}
2657
2658/* The entries of the pairs (see rw_pairs_step()) of a sparse-dual step: the formed columns with a nonzero L syndrome,
2659 * and the columns with a zero L syndrome in their buckets (formed now, with the Stern filters of rw_pairs_step()), in
2660 * increasing order of the columns in each group, so that the sort and the pairs are those of the dense step. Returns
2661 * the number of entries (-1 at a stop: then rw_pairs_step() returns -1, and its step does not count as completed). */
2662static int rw_dual_entries(distfork_ctx_t * const ctx, rw_dual_t * const d, rw_thr_t * const th,
2663 const word * const piv_mask, const int rank, const int nk, const int * const kword,
2664 const word * const kmask, const int kb, const int sh_key, const int sh_grp, const int ib,
2665 rw_pair_t * const ent, uint64_t * const srt, rci_t * const ee, const rci_t * const pivs,
2666 const bool filt_t3, const bool filt_g) {
2667 const params_t * const p = ctx->p;
2668 const int nvar = p->spaH->cols, m = d->m;
2669 const size_t aw = d->aw;
2670 const word last_mask = (rank & 63) ? (((word)1 << (rank & 63)) - 1) : ~(word)0;
2671 const word * const lmask = p->maskL->mask;
2672 while (2 * ((size_t)d->np1 + 1) > (size_t)d->bmask + 1) { /* the buckets: at most half full */
2673 d->bmask = 2 * d->bmask + 1;
2674 free(d->bset);
2675 d->bset = calloc((size_t)d->bmask + 1, sizeof(uint64_t));
2676 if (!d->bset) ERROR("memory allocation");
2677 }
2678 memset(d->bset, 0, ((size_t)d->bmask + 1) * sizeof(uint64_t));
2679 int K = 0;
2680 for (int k = 0; k < d->np1; k++) {
2681 const word * const v = d->pool + (size_t)k * aw;
2682 int wt = 0;
2683 for (size_t iw = 0; iw + 1 < aw; iw++) wt += __builtin_popcountll(v[iw]);
2684 wt += __builtin_popcountll(v[aw - 1] & last_mask);
2685 uint64_t key = 0;
2686 for (int j = 0; j < nk; j++) key = (key ^ (v[kword[j]] & kmask[j])) * 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ULL;
2687 key >>= 64 - kb;
2688 uint32_t s = rec_hash(key + 1) & d->bmask;
2689 while (d->bset[s] && d->bset[s] != key + 1) s = (s + 1) & d->bmask;
2690 d->bset[s] = key + 1;
2691 ent[K].sig = d->psig[k];
2692 ent[K].col = d->pcol[k];
2693 ent[K].known = 1;
2694 d->pidx[K] = k;
2695 srt[K] = ((uint64_t)key << sh_key) | ((uint64_t)1 << sh_grp) | ((uint64_t)wt << ib) | (uint64_t)K;
2696 K++;
2697 }
2698 /* the bucket words of the rows of MT */
2699 for (int r = 0; r < m; r++)
2700 for (int j = 0; j < nk; j++) d->hb[(size_t)r * nk + j] = d->MT[(size_t)r * aw + kword[j]] & kmask[j];
2701 word bw[RW_PAIRS_MAX_BITS];
2702 for (int col = 0; col < nvar; col++) {
2703 if ((col & 255) == 255 && (atomic_load_explicit(&ctx->stop_flag, memory_order_relaxed) ||
2704 atomic_load_explicit(&ctx->rw_stop_flag, memory_order_relaxed)))
2705 return -1;
2706 if ((piv_mask[col >> 6] >> (col & 63)) & 1) continue;
2707 const int k0 = ctx->dcp[col], k1 = ctx->dcp[col + 1];
2708 uint64_t sig = lmask[col];
2709 for (int k = k0; k < k1; k++) sig ^= d->hl[ctx->dci[k]];
2710 if (sig) continue;
2711 for (int j = 0; j < nk; j++) bw[j] = 0;
2712 for (int k = k0; k < k1; k++) {
2713 const word * const hr = d->hb + (size_t)ctx->dci[k] * nk;
2714 for (int j = 0; j < nk; j++) bw[j] ^= hr[j];
2715 }
2716 uint64_t key = 0;
2717 for (int j = 0; j < nk; j++) key = (key ^ bw[j]) * 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ULL;
2718 key >>= 64 - kb;
2719 uint32_t s = rec_hash(key + 1) & d->bmask;
2720 while (d->bset[s] && d->bset[s] != key + 1) s = (s + 1) & d->bmask;
2721 if (!d->bset[s]) continue; /* no column with a nonzero L syndrome in its bucket: no pairs */
2722 const word * const v = dual_form(ctx, d, col, 0);
2723 int wt = 0;
2724 for (size_t iw = 0; iw + 1 < aw; iw++) wt += __builtin_popcountll(v[iw]);
2725 wt += __builtin_popcountll(v[aw - 1] & last_mask);
2726 int skip = filt_t3 && wt <= 2;
2727 if (!skip && filt_g && wt + 1 <= ctx->gdb->wmax && ctx->gdb->wpres[wt + 1]) { /* a realized row of G */
2728 int cnt = 0;
2729 ee[cnt++] = col;
2730 for (size_t iw = 0; iw < aw; iw++)
2731 for (word x = (iw + 1 < aw) ? v[iw] : (v[iw] & last_mask); x; x &= x - 1)
2732 ee[cnt++] = pivs[(iw << 6) + (size_t)__builtin_ctzll(x)];
2733 skip = rw_gdb_is_row(ctx->gdb, th->ws, ee, cnt, rw_set_key(ctx->zcol, ee, cnt, 0));
2734 }
2735 if (skip) {
2736 d->npool--;
2737 continue;
2738 }
2739 ent[K].sig = 0;
2740 ent[K].col = col;
2741 ent[K].known = 1;
2742 d->pidx[K] = d->npool - 1;
2743 srt[K] = ((uint64_t)key << sh_key) | ((uint64_t)wt << ib) | (uint64_t)K;
2744 K++;
2745 }
2746 for (int k = 0; k < K; k++) ent[k].row = d->pool + (size_t)d->pidx[k] * aw; /* (the pool is complete) */
2747 return K;
2748}
2749
2750/* The pairs visited between the polls of the stop flags and of the upper bound in rw_pairs_step(): with few rows l, a
2751 * bucket can hold many columns (e.g., with pairs=1, two buckets of (n - r)/2 columns each), so that a step would
2752 * otherwise not end in time at a timeout */
2753#define RW_PAIRS_POLL 65536
2754
2755/* The pairs of a RW step (see rw_pair_t), after its single columns: the columns `v` of the step (see rw_view_t; with
2756 * v->full, the reduced matrix `mH`: Gauss-Jordan, `rank` pivot rows, whose pivot columns are `pivs`, and its transpose
2757 * v->ht, row c: the column c in the pivot rows), `l` pivot rows of the buckets, the workspace `ws`, and the support
2758 * `ee`; `src` as in rw_record_codeword(). Adds the number of the pairs checked to `*checked`, and of the hits to
2759 * `*hits` (see rw_is_hit()); returns l (0: no pairs), or -1 after a stop in the pairs (the step is not completed, see
2760 * run_rw_steps(); an upper bound which leaves no pair only ends them early). The
2761 * bucket of a column is a hash of its l bits (64 bits; the sort uses its top bits: the buckets with different bits are
2762 * merged rarely, which only adds pairs).
2763 * With the stages of rw_opt (`th` not NULL): the L syndromes `srows` may be computed before (`srows_ready`, see
2764 * rw_srows()); the columns with a zero L syndrome and w_x <= 2 pivot rows (rw_filter_t3) and those whose circuits are
2765 * rows of G (rw_filter_g) are not used (the Stern Bucket-0 filter of Theorems 3(b) and 5(c) of the notes, loss-free
2766 * for the distance with the shortening of the single candidates, hence only while it is not capped by RW_SHORTEN_WMAX,
2767 * see rw_filters_exact()); the pairs up to the weight min(limit + rw_ext2, RW_SHORTEN_WMAX + 1) - 1 are formed and
2768 * those
2769 * up to min(dmax + rw_ext2 (+ dW), RW_SHORTEN_WMAX) shortened (see rw_candidate(), rw_lim_ext()); and for a full
2770 * dense step, `*fkg` (if not NULL) is set to the Harris-FKG sum of ln(1 + w_x) over the non-pivot columns x (NAN if the
2771 * columns were not scanned; not with the sparse dual `dl`, which does not form the columns of a zero L syndrome
2772 * outside the buckets). */
2773static int rw_pairs_step(distfork_ctx_t * const ctx, const rw_view_t * const v, const mzd_t * const mH,
2774 const rci_t * const pivs, const word * const piv_mask, const int rank, int l,
2775 rw_pairs_ws_t * const ws, rci_t * const ee, uint64_t * const rng_state, const int tid,
2776 const int src, long long * const checked, long long * const hits, rw_thr_t * const th,
2777 const bool srows_ready, double * const fkg, rw_dual_t * const dl) {
2778 params_t * const p = ctx->p;
2779 const colmask_t * const maskL = p->maskL;
2780 const int classical = p->classical;
2781 const uint64_t * const lhash = ctx->rw_lhash;
2782 const int ncols = v->ncols;
2783 rw_pair_t * const ent = ws->ent;
2784 uint64_t * const srt = ws->srt;
2785 if (fkg) *fkg = NAN;
2786 int lim = rw_pairs_limit(ctx);
2787 if (lim < 3 || l < 1 || l > rank) return 0; /* (the weight of a pair is at least 2) */
2788 /* the sort keys: the top kb bits of the bucket's hash, the bit "the L syndrome is not known to be zero", the weight
2789 * (wb bits), and the entry (ib bits) */
2790 int wb = 1, ib = 1;
2791 while ((1L << wb) <= (long)rank) wb++;
2792 while ((1L << ib) < (long)(ncols - rank)) ib++;
2793 const int kb = (l + 8 < 63 - wb - ib) ? l + 8 : 63 - wb - ib;
2794 if (kb < 1) return 0;
2795 const int sh_grp = ib + wb, sh_key = sh_grp + 1;
2796 const uint64_t wmask = ((uint64_t)1 << wb) - 1, imask = ((uint64_t)1 << ib) - 1;
2797 const int aw = (rank + 63) >> 6;
2798 const word last_mask = (rank & 63) ? (((word)1 << (rank & 63)) - 1) : ~(word)0; /* bits of rows < rank */
2799 /* l distinct random pivot rows, as the masks `kmask` of the words `kword` of the rows */
2800 int nk = 0, kword[RW_PAIRS_MAX_BITS];
2801 word kmask[RW_PAIRS_MAX_BITS];
2802 for (int i = 0; i < l; i++) {
2803 int r, j;
2804 do {
2805 r = rand_uniform_thread(rank, rng_state);
2806 for (j = 0; j < nk && kword[j] != (r >> 6); j++) continue;
2807 } while (j < nk && ((kmask[j] >> (r & 63)) & 1));
2808 if (j == nk) {
2809 kword[nk] = r >> 6;
2810 kmask[nk++] = 0;
2811 }
2812 kmask[j] |= (word)1 << (r & 63);
2813 }
2814 /* the L syndromes of the codewords of all columns (with at most 64 rows of L, a full step): the rows of L reduced
2815 * with the pivot rows (`lhash` is then the column masks of L) */
2816 const int nl = v->full ? ws->nl : 0;
2817 if (nl > 0 && !srows_ready) rw_srows(ws, mH, pivs, rank, lhash);
2818 const int wsig = lim + 1; /* (otherwise) the L syndromes of the columns up to this weight */
2819 /* rw_opt: the Stern Bucket-0 filter (only while the shortening of the single candidates is not capped, see
2820 * rw_filters_exact()); an L syndrome from `lhash` is exact with at most 64 rows of L */
2821 const bool filt_on = th && (ctx->rw_filter_t3 || ctx->rw_filter_g) && rw_filters_exact(ctx);
2822 const bool filt_t3 = filt_on && ctx->rw_filter_t3, filt_g = filt_on && ctx->rw_filter_g;
2823 const bool lhash_exact = maskL && (maskL->kw == 1);
2824 double fsum = 0.0;
2825 const double * const ltab = (th && fkg && v->full) ? th->ltab : NULL;
2826 int K = 0;
2827 if (dl) { /* Stage 4: the formed columns of the sparse-dual step (no Harris-FKG score) */
2828 K = rw_dual_entries(ctx, dl, th, piv_mask, rank, nk, kword, kmask, kb, sh_key, sh_grp, ib, ent, srt, ee, pivs,
2829 filt_t3, filt_g);
2830 if (K < 0) return -1; /* (stopped) */
2831 }
2832 for (int col = 0; col < ncols && !dl; col++) {
2833 if ((piv_mask[col >> 6] >> (col & 63)) & 1) continue;
2834 const word * const row = view_row(v, col);
2835 int wt = 0;
2836 for (int iw = 0; iw < aw - 1; iw++) wt += __builtin_popcountll(row[iw]);
2837 wt += __builtin_popcountll(row[aw - 1] & last_mask);
2838 if (ltab) fsum += ltab[wt];
2839 uint64_t key = 0;
2840 for (int j = 0; j < nk; j++) key = (key ^ (row[kword[j]] & kmask[j])) * 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ULL;
2841 key >>= 64 - kb;
2842 uint64_t sig = 0;
2843 int known = 0;
2844 if (nl > 0) {
2845 sig = rw_srows_sig(ws, col);
2846 known = 1;
2847 } else if (lhash && wt <= wsig) {
2848 sig = lhash[view_col(v, col)];
2849 for (int iw = 0; iw < aw; iw++) {
2850 for (word x = (iw < aw - 1) ? row[iw] : (row[iw] & last_mask); x; x &= x - 1)
2851 sig ^= lhash[view_col(v, pivs[(iw << 6) + __builtin_ctzll(x)])];
2852 }
2853 known = 1;
2854 }
2855 if ((filt_t3 || filt_g) && known && sig == 0) { /* the Stern filter: a trivial circuit (zero L syndrome) */
2856 int skip = 0;
2857 if (filt_t3 && wt <= 2) { /* (with more than 64 rows of L, the syndrome is checked exactly) */
2858 int cnt = 0;
2859 if (!(nl > 0 || lhash_exact)) {
2860 ee[cnt++] = view_col(v, col);
2861 for (int iw = 0; iw < aw; iw++)
2862 for (word x = (iw < aw - 1) ? row[iw] : (row[iw] & last_mask); x; x &= x - 1)
2863 ee[cnt++] = view_col(v, pivs[(iw << 6) + __builtin_ctzll(x)]);
2864 }
2865 skip = (nl > 0 || lhash_exact) || !colmask_syndrome_non_zero(maskL, cnt, ee);
2866 }
2867 if (!skip && filt_g && wt + 1 <= ctx->gdb->wmax && ctx->gdb->wpres[wt + 1]) { /* a realized row of G */
2868 int cnt = 0;
2869 ee[cnt++] = view_col(v, col);
2870 for (int iw = 0; iw < aw; iw++)
2871 for (word x = (iw < aw - 1) ? row[iw] : (row[iw] & last_mask); x; x &= x - 1)
2872 ee[cnt++] = view_col(v, pivs[(iw << 6) + __builtin_ctzll(x)]);
2873 skip = rw_gdb_is_row(ctx->gdb, th->ws, ee, cnt, rw_set_key(ctx->zcol, ee, cnt, 0));
2874 }
2875 if (skip) continue;
2876 }
2877 const uint64_t grp = !known || (sig != 0);
2878 ent[K].row = row;
2879 ent[K].sig = sig;
2880 ent[K].col = col;
2881 ent[K].known = known;
2882 srt[K] = ((uint64_t)key << sh_key) | (grp << sh_grp) | ((uint64_t)wt << ib) | (uint64_t)K;
2883 K++;
2884 }
2885 if (ltab && !dl) *fkg = fsum;
2886 rw_radix_sort(srt, srt + p->spaH->cols, K, sh_key + kb);
2887
2888 /* with one row of L (known syndromes), the other columns have the same syndrome: only their pairs with the columns
2889 * with zero syndromes */
2890 const bool other_pairs = (nl != 1);
2891 const bool irred = (p->irred != 0);
2892 const int ext2 = (th && ctx->rw_shorten) ? ctx->rw_ext2 : 0; /* rw_opt: the pairs to shorten */
2893 long long int nchk = 0, nhits = 0, nvis = 0, next_poll = RW_PAIRS_POLL; /* nvis: the pairs visited, also skipped */
2894 long long int nred = 0; /* irred=1: the pairs of disjoint circuits skipped (reducible sums) */
2895 bool stopped = false; /* a stop flag ended the pairs */
2896 for (int b0 = 0; b0 < K;) {
2897 const uint64_t bkey = srt[b0] >> sh_key;
2898 int b1 = b0 + 1;
2899 while (b1 < K && (srt[b1] >> sh_key) == bkey) b1++;
2900 if (b1 - b0 >= 2) {
2901 if (atomic_load_explicit(&ctx->stop_flag, memory_order_relaxed) ||
2902 atomic_load_explicit(&ctx->rw_stop_flag, memory_order_relaxed)) {
2903 stopped = true;
2904 break;
2905 }
2906 lim = rw_pairs_limit(ctx); /* (the upper bound may have decreased) */
2907 if (lim < 3) break;
2908 int lx = rw_lim_ext(lim, ext2) - 3; /* the largest weight of the sum of the two columns */
2909 int g0 = b0; /* [b0, g0): the columns with zero L syndromes; [g0, b1): the others */
2910 while (g0 < b1 && !((srt[g0] >> sh_grp) & 1)) g0++;
2911 int lo = g0;
2912 const int x_end = other_pairs ? b1 - 1 : g0;
2913 for (int x = b0; x < x_end; x++) {
2914 if (nvis >= next_poll) { /* a bucket can be large (few rows l): the stop flags and the upper bound, also here */
2915 next_poll = nvis + RW_PAIRS_POLL;
2916 if (atomic_load_explicit(&ctx->stop_flag, memory_order_relaxed) ||
2917 atomic_load_explicit(&ctx->rw_stop_flag, memory_order_relaxed)) {
2918 stopped = true;
2919 goto done;
2920 }
2921 lim = rw_pairs_limit(ctx);
2922 if (lim < 3) goto done;
2923 lx = rw_lim_ext(lim, ext2) - 3;
2924 }
2925 const int wx = (int)((srt[x] >> ib) & wmask);
2926 const rw_pair_t * const ex = ent + (srt[x] & imask);
2927 int y = x + 1;
2928 if (x < g0) { /* (a column with a zero L syndrome: only the pairs with the others) */
2929 while (lo < b1 && (int)((srt[lo] >> ib) & wmask) < wx - lx) lo++;
2930 y = lo;
2931 }
2932 const int y0 = y;
2933 for (; y < b1; y++) {
2934 const int wy = (int)((srt[y] >> ib) & wmask);
2935 if (wy - wx > lx) break;
2936 const rw_pair_t * const ey = ent + (srt[y] & imask);
2937 if (x >= g0 && ex->known && ey->known && ex->sig == ey->sig) continue;
2938 const word * const ra = ex->row;
2939 const word * const rb = ey->row;
2940 nchk++;
2941 int c = 0;
2942 for (int iw = 0; iw < aw - 1 && c <= lx; iw++) c += __builtin_popcountll(ra[iw] ^ rb[iw]);
2943 if (c <= lx) c += __builtin_popcountll((ra[aw - 1] ^ rb[aw - 1]) & last_mask);
2944 if (c > lx) continue;
2945 /* irred=1: the sum of the two circuits is reducible iff they are disjoint, i.e., the weight of the sum of
2946 * their pivot parts is wx + wy (a kernel vector on the pivots and the two columns is a sum of the two
2947 * circuits, so that the circuits are the only candidates for a proper subset with zero syndrome) */
2948 if (irred && c == wx + wy) {
2949 nred++;
2950 continue;
2951 }
2952 int cnt = 0;
2953 ee[cnt++] = view_col(v, ex->col);
2954 ee[cnt++] = view_col(v, ey->col);
2955 for (int iw = 0; iw < aw; iw++) {
2956 for (word z = (ra[iw] ^ rb[iw]) & ((iw < aw - 1) ? ~(word)0 : last_mask); z; z &= z - 1)
2957 ee[cnt++] = view_col(v, pivs[(iw << 6) + __builtin_ctzll(z)]);
2958 }
2959 if (classical || colmask_syndrome_non_zero(maskL, cnt, ee)) {
2960 if (th) {
2961 rw_candidate(ctx, th, ee, cnt, lim, true, tid, &nhits);
2962 } else {
2963 rci_quick_sort(ee, cnt);
2964 if (rw_is_hit(ctx, cnt)) nhits++;
2965 if (ctx->wargs[tid].slt) ctx->wargs[tid].slt->orig = 2; /* (steplog=FILE: a pair) */
2966 rw_record_codeword(ctx, ee, cnt, tid, 0, src);
2967 }
2968 lim = rw_pairs_limit(ctx);
2969 if (lim < 3) goto done;
2970 lx = rw_lim_ext(lim, ext2) - 3;
2971 }
2972 }
2973 nvis += y - y0;
2974 }
2975 }
2976 b0 = b1;
2977 }
2978done:
2979 *checked += nchk;
2980 *hits += nhits;
2981 if (nred > 0) atomic_fetch_add_explicit(&ctx->cw_red_rw, nred, memory_order_relaxed);
2982 return stopped ? -1 : l;
2983}
2984
2985/* A new generation of the slab marks of a thread (see rw_slab_step(); cleared when the counter wraps around) */
2986static inline uint32_t slab_gen(rw_thr_t * const th, const int nvar) {
2987 if (++th->sgen == 0) {
2988 memset(th->smark, 0, ((size_t)nvar + 1) * sizeof(uint32_t));
2989 th->sgen = 1;
2990 }
2991 return th->sgen;
2992}
2993
2994/* Stage 3 (rw_opt, RW_OPT_SLAB): a row-slab window step, instead of the index window of a hybrid step. The columns of
2995 * H inside a range of slab_msub consecutive rows (the detectors of a DEM in time order; default m/2), from the row
2996 * r0 = 0 or m - msub with probability slab_bnd percent each (the boundary slabs: with the default 50, only these, the
2997 * two detector layers of a single round), otherwise uniform, ordered by a random maximal independent
2998 * set of the triplet graph G_3 first, then the others (MIS push-back, Theorem 2(a) of the notes), each part in random
2999 * order; the slab matrix (msub rows) is reduced (Gauss-Jordan), and its single columns and pairs give codewords of H
3000 * (the slab columns touch no other row), mapped back to the columns of H. The study options slab_bnd and slab_var
3001 * change the probability of the boundary slabs and reduce the height msub at random (slab_var=0 draws no random
3002 * number for the height). Returns the rank of the slab matrix (-1: stopped in its elimination or in the pairs;
3003 * then the step does not count as completed). */
3004static int rw_slab_step(distfork_ctx_t * const ctx, rw_thr_t * const th, rw_pairs_ws_t * const pws, rci_t * const ee,
3005 uint64_t * const rng, const int tid, long long * const hits1, long long * const hits2,
3006 long long * const n_pairs) {
3007 params_t * const p = ctx->p;
3008 const int m = p->spaH->rows, nvar = p->spaH->cols;
3009 int msub = ctx->slab_msub;
3010 if (ctx->slab_var > 0) { /* a random height in [slab_msub (100 - slab_var)/100, slab_msub], at least 2 */
3011 msub -= rand_uniform_thread((int)((long long)ctx->slab_msub * ctx->slab_var / 100) + 1, rng);
3012 if (msub < 2) msub = minint(2, m);
3013 }
3014 const int span = m - msub;
3015 const uint64_t u = splitmix64(rng) % 100, bnd = (uint64_t)ctx->slab_bnd;
3016 const int r0 = (u < bnd) ? 0 : ((u < 2 * bnd) ? span : rand_uniform_thread(span + 1, rng));
3017 const int r1 = r0 + msub;
3018 int ns = 0;
3019 for (int k = ctx->slab_first[r0]; k < ctx->slab_first[r1]; k++) {
3020 const int j = ctx->slab_order[k];
3021 if (ctx->col_rmax[j] < r1) th->cols[ns++] = j;
3022 }
3023 th->slab_r0 = r0;
3024 th->slab_r1 = r1;
3025 th->slab_ns = ns;
3026 if (ns < 2) return 0;
3027 for (int i = ns - 1; i > 0; i--) {
3028 const int j = rand_uniform_thread(i + 1, rng);
3029 SWAPINT(th->cols[i], th->cols[j]);
3030 }
3031 const rw_t3_t * const t3 = ctx->t3;
3032 if (t3 && t3->ntrip > 0) { /* MIS push-back: a greedy maximal independent set F of G_3 first */
3033 const uint32_t g1 = slab_gen(th, nvar), g2 = slab_gen(th, nvar);
3034 int * const ord = th->cbuf;
3035 int nf = 0;
3036 for (int i = 0; i < ns; i++) {
3037 const int c = th->cols[i];
3038 if (th->smark[c] == g1) continue; /* (in F, or a neighbor of a column in F) */
3039 ord[nf++] = c;
3040 th->smark[c] = g1;
3041 for (int e = t3->gp[c]; e < t3->gp[c + 1]; e++) th->smark[t3->gi[e]] = g1;
3042 }
3043 for (int i = 0; i < nf; i++) th->smark[ord[i]] = g2;
3044 int q = nf;
3045 for (int i = 0; i < ns; i++)
3046 if (th->smark[th->cols[i]] != g2) ord[q++] = th->cols[i];
3047 memcpy(th->cols, ord, (size_t)ns * sizeof(int));
3048 }
3049 /* the slab matrix: the slab columns in this order */
3050 const size_t sw = ((size_t)ns + 63) >> 6;
3051 memset(th->S, 0, (size_t)msub * sw * sizeof(word));
3052 const csr_t * const HT = ctx->mHT_cc;
3053 for (int idx = 0; idx < ns; idx++) {
3054 const int j = th->cols[idx];
3055 for (int k = HT->p[j]; k < HT->p[j + 1]; k++)
3056 th->S[(size_t)(HT->i[k] - r0) * sw + (size_t)(idx >> 6)] |= (word)1 << (idx & 63);
3057 }
3058 /* Gauss-Jordan elimination, column by column */
3059 memset(th->spmask, 0, sw * sizeof(word));
3060 int rank = 0;
3061 for (int col = 0; col < ns && rank < msub; col++) {
3062 if ((col & 255) == 255 && (atomic_load_explicit(&ctx->stop_flag, memory_order_relaxed) ||
3063 atomic_load_explicit(&ctx->rw_stop_flag, memory_order_relaxed)))
3064 return -1;
3065 const size_t cw = (size_t)(col >> 6);
3066 const word bit = (word)1 << (col & 63);
3067 int r = rank;
3068 while (r < msub && !(th->S[(size_t)r * sw + cw] & bit)) r++;
3069 if (r == msub) continue;
3070 word * const prow = th->S + (size_t)rank * sw;
3071 if (r != rank) {
3072 word * const rr = th->S + (size_t)r * sw;
3073 for (size_t w = 0; w < sw; w++) {
3074 const word t = prow[w];
3075 prow[w] = rr[w];
3076 rr[w] = t;
3077 }
3078 }
3079 for (int q = 0; q < msub; q++) {
3080 word * const qr = th->S + (size_t)q * sw;
3081 if (q != rank && (qr[cw] & bit)) rw_row_xor(qr, prow, (wi_t)sw);
3082 }
3083 th->spivs[rank++] = col;
3084 th->spmask[cw] |= bit;
3085 }
3086 if (rank == 0) return 0;
3087 /* the transpose: the slab columns in the pivot rows */
3088 const int rw = (rank + 63) >> 6;
3089 memset(th->T, 0, (size_t)ns * (size_t)rw * sizeof(word));
3090 for (int r = 0; r < rank; r++) {
3091 const word * const row = th->S + (size_t)r * sw;
3092 const word rb = (word)1 << (r & 63);
3093 const size_t rwi = (size_t)(r >> 6);
3094 for (size_t w = 0; w < sw; w++)
3095 for (word x = row[w]; x; x &= x - 1) th->T[(w * 64 + (size_t)__builtin_ctzll(x)) * (size_t)rw + rwi] |= rb;
3096 }
3097 /* the single columns (p=1) */
3098 const int ext = ctx->rw_shorten ? ctx->rw_ext : 0;
3099 const word last_mask = (rank & 63) ? (((word)1 << (rank & 63)) - 1) : ~(word)0;
3100 for (int idx = 0; idx < ns; idx++) {
3101 if ((th->spmask[idx >> 6] >> (idx & 63)) & 1) continue;
3102 const int limit = rw_cw_limit(ctx);
3103 const int lim_ext = rw_lim_ext(limit, ext);
3104 const word * const row = th->T + (size_t)idx * (size_t)rw;
3105 int wt = 1;
3106 for (int iw = 0; iw < rw - 1 && wt < lim_ext; iw++) wt += __builtin_popcountll(row[iw]);
3107 if (wt < lim_ext) wt += __builtin_popcountll(row[rw - 1] & last_mask);
3108 if (wt >= lim_ext) continue;
3109 int cnt = 0;
3110 ee[cnt++] = th->cols[idx];
3111 for (int iw = 0; iw < rw; iw++)
3112 for (word x = (iw < rw - 1) ? row[iw] : (row[iw] & last_mask); x; x &= x - 1)
3113 ee[cnt++] = th->cols[th->spivs[(iw << 6) + __builtin_ctzll(x)]];
3114 if (!p->classical && !colmask_syndrome_non_zero(p->maskL, cnt, ee)) continue;
3115 rw_candidate(ctx, th, ee, cnt, limit, false, tid, hits1);
3116 }
3117 /* the pairs (p=2) */
3118 if (pws->ent) {
3119 const int l = rw_pairs_bits(p, ns, rank, atomic_load_explicit(&ctx->dmax, memory_order_relaxed));
3120 if (l > 0) {
3121 const rw_view_t v = {NULL, th->T, (size_t)rw, ns, th->cols, 0};
3122 if (rw_pairs_step(ctx, &v, NULL, th->spivs, th->spmask, rank, l, pws, ee, rng, tid, CW_SRC_RW_SLAB, n_pairs,
3123 hits2, th, false, NULL, NULL) < 0)
3124 return -1; /* (stopped in the pairs: the step is not completed) */
3125 }
3126 }
3127 return rank;
3128}
3129
3130/* Stage 4 (rw_opt, RW_OPT_DUAL): a full-matrix RW step with the sparse-dual elimination (see rw_dual_t) of the columns
3131 * order[0], order[1], ... in the rows 0..nrows_eff-1 of M: the single columns with a nonzero L syndrome, formed in
3132 * increasing order, and the pairs (see rw_dual_entries()). Returns the rank (-1: stopped in the elimination, in the
3133 * single columns, or in the pairs; then the step does not count as completed). */
3134static int rw_dual_step(distfork_ctx_t * const ctx, rw_dual_t * const d, rw_thr_t * const th, rw_pairs_ws_t * const pws,
3135 const int nrows_eff, const rci_t * const order, rci_t * const pivs, word * const piv_mask,
3136 rci_t * const ee, uint64_t * const rng, const int tid, const int src, long long * const hits1,
3137 long long * const hits2, long long * const n_pairs) {
3138 params_t * const p = ctx->p;
3139 const int nvar = p->spaH->cols, m = d->m;
3140 const int rank = rw_dual_eliminate(ctx, d, nrows_eff, nvar, order, pivs, piv_mask);
3141 if (rank < 0) return -1;
3142 if (atomic_load_explicit(&ctx->rw_rank, memory_order_relaxed) != rank)
3143 atomic_store_explicit(&ctx->rw_rank, rank, memory_order_relaxed);
3144 /* the pivot rows of M transposed, and the L syndromes of the rows of MT */
3145 const size_t aw = (rank > 0) ? (((size_t)rank + 63) >> 6) : 1;
3146 d->aw = aw;
3147 memset(d->MT, 0, (size_t)m * aw * sizeof(word));
3148 memset(d->hl, 0, (size_t)m * sizeof(uint64_t));
3149 const uint64_t * const lmask = ctx->rw_lhash; /* (the column masks of L) */
3150 for (int r = 0; r < rank; r++) {
3151 const word * const row = d->M + (size_t)r * d->mw;
3152 const word rb = (word)1 << (r & 63);
3153 const size_t rwi = (size_t)(r >> 6);
3154 const uint64_t lp = lmask[pivs[r]];
3155 for (size_t w = 0; w < d->mw; w++) {
3156 for (word x = row[w]; x; x &= x - 1) {
3157 const size_t dd = w * 64 + (size_t)__builtin_ctzll(x);
3158 d->MT[dd * aw + rwi] |= rb;
3159 d->hl[dd] ^= lp;
3160 }
3161 }
3162 }
3163 /* the single columns (p=1): those with a nonzero L syndrome, formed in increasing order */
3164 const word last_mask = (rank & 63) ? (((word)1 << (rank & 63)) - 1) : ~(word)0;
3165 const int ext = ctx->rw_shorten ? ctx->rw_ext : 0;
3166 d->npool = 0;
3167 for (int col = 0; col < nvar; col++) {
3168 if ((col & 255) == 255 && (atomic_load_explicit(&ctx->stop_flag, memory_order_relaxed) ||
3169 atomic_load_explicit(&ctx->rw_stop_flag, memory_order_relaxed)))
3170 return -1;
3171 if ((piv_mask[col >> 6] >> (col & 63)) & 1) continue;
3172 uint64_t sig = lmask[col];
3173 for (int k = ctx->dcp[col]; k < ctx->dcp[col + 1]; k++) sig ^= d->hl[ctx->dci[k]];
3174 if (!sig) continue;
3175 const word * const v = dual_form(ctx, d, col, sig);
3176 const int limit = rw_cw_limit(ctx);
3177 const int lim_ext = rw_lim_ext(limit, ext);
3178 int wt = 1;
3179 for (size_t iw = 0; iw + 1 < aw; iw++) wt += __builtin_popcountll(v[iw]);
3180 if (rank > 0) wt += __builtin_popcountll(v[aw - 1] & last_mask);
3181 if (wt >= lim_ext) continue;
3182 int cnt = 0;
3183 ee[cnt++] = col;
3184 for (size_t iw = 0; iw < aw && rank > 0; iw++)
3185 for (word x = (iw + 1 < aw) ? v[iw] : (v[iw] & last_mask); x; x &= x - 1)
3186 ee[cnt++] = pivs[(iw << 6) + (size_t)__builtin_ctzll(x)];
3187 rw_candidate(ctx, th, ee, cnt, limit, false, tid, hits1);
3188 }
3189 d->np1 = d->npool;
3190 /* the pairs (p=2) */
3191 if (pws->ent) {
3192 const int l = rw_pairs_bits(p, nvar, rank, atomic_load_explicit(&ctx->dmax, memory_order_relaxed));
3193 if (l > 0) {
3194 const rw_view_t v = {NULL, NULL, 0, nvar, NULL, 1};
3195 const int lu = rw_pairs_step(ctx, &v, NULL, pivs, piv_mask, rank, l, pws, ee, rng, tid, src, n_pairs, hits2, th,
3196 true, NULL, d);
3197 if (lu < 0) return -1; /* (stopped in the pairs) */
3198 if (lu > 0 && atomic_load_explicit(&ctx->rw_pairs_l, memory_order_relaxed) != lu)
3199 atomic_store_explicit(&ctx->rw_pairs_l, lu, memory_order_relaxed);
3200 }
3201 }
3202 return rank;
3203}
3204
3205/* Method 3 with two or more workers: whether an RW worker leaves its batch before its next RW step for the current CC
3206 * round, i.e., the round has work units left and fewer workers than the coordinator's target cc_target_workers (see
3207 * m3_plan_cc_threads()), while RW steps remain to be claimed. The worker keeps the steps of the batch not run yet and
3208 * runs them after the round (see worker_thread_func()): a batch of slow RW steps does not keep a CC round waiting, and
3209 * no step is abandoned (only the stop flags end a step early). Once all RW steps are claimed, the coordinator plans
3210 * all threads for CC (the workers without RW work join the rounds), and a worker finishes its batch first, as before.
3211 * With a single worker, RW batches and CC rounds alternate (see m3_batch_steps()). */
3212static inline bool rw_yield_to_cc(distfork_ctx_t * const ctx) {
3213 if (ctx->p->method != 3 || ctx->num_threads < 2 ||
3214 !atomic_load_explicit(&ctx->cc_round_active, memory_order_acquire))
3215 return false;
3216 if (atomic_load_explicit(&ctx->cc_active_workers, memory_order_relaxed) >=
3217 atomic_load_explicit(&ctx->cc_target_workers, memory_order_relaxed))
3218 return false;
3219 if (atomic_load_explicit(&ctx->rw_steps_started, memory_order_relaxed) >= ctx->total_rw_steps) return false;
3220 const long long next = atomic_load_explicit(&ctx->cc_next, memory_order_relaxed);
3221 return cc_unpack_idx(next) <= cc_unit_last(ctx, cc_unpack_w(next), cc_unpack_lev(next));
3222}
3223
3224#define M3_BATCH_TIME 0.5 /* method 3, adaptive batches (chunk_size=0): at most about 0.5 s of RW steps per batch */
3225
3226/* Method 3, adaptive batches (chunk_size=0): the RW batch `batch_size` cut to about M3_BATCH_TIME seconds of RW steps
3227 * by the measured thread time per step (fast steps keep their batches), so that RW batches and CC rounds alternate
3228 * quickly also with slow RW steps on a single worker, and the last batches are short. Until the step time is
3229 * measured, a single worker takes a single step, while more workers keep `batch_size` (they leave a batch for a CC
3230 * round, see rw_yield_to_cc()). */
3231static long m3_batch_steps(distfork_ctx_t * const ctx, const long batch_size) {
3232 const long n = atomic_load_explicit(&ctx->rw_timed_steps, memory_order_relaxed);
3233 if (n <= 0) return (ctx->num_threads < 2) ? 1 : batch_size;
3234 const double t_step = 1e-9 * (double)atomic_load_explicit(&ctx->rw_busy_ns, memory_order_relaxed) / (double)n;
3235 if (!(t_step * (double)batch_size > M3_BATCH_TIME)) return batch_size;
3236 const long b = (long)(M3_BATCH_TIME / t_step);
3237 return (b > 1) ? b : 1;
3238}
3239
3240/* Run RW batch of the global steps step0 .. step0+n_steps-1; returns the number of completed steps. `el`: the thread's
3241 * RW elimination (blocked or column by column, see rw_elim_t); `pws`: the workspace of the RW pairs (see
3242 * rw_pairs_ws_init()); `th`: the state of the RW stages of rw_opt (NULL: none, the RW steps of version 0.16.1); `dl`:
3243 * the sparse-dual elimination of Stage 4 (NULL: the dense matrices mH, mHT); `*left` is set if the worker leaves the
3244 * batch for a CC round after the completed steps (the other steps are not started, see rw_yield_to_cc()) */
3245static int run_rw_steps(distfork_ctx_t *ctx, long step0, int n_steps,
3246 mzd_t *mH, mzd_t *mHT, rci_t *ee,
3247 mzp_t *perm, mzp_t *pivs, word *piv_mask, rw_elim_t *el, rw_pairs_ws_t *pws,
3248 int *eff_nrows_ptr,
3249 int *visited_cols, int *visited_checks, int *col_queue,
3250 int *visit_marker, uint64_t *rng_state, int tid, rw_thr_t *th, rw_dual_t *dl, bool *left) {
3251 params_t * const p = ctx->p;
3252 const colmask_t * const maskL = p->maskL; /* NULL for a classical code */
3253 const int nvar = p->spaH->cols;
3254 const int classical = p->classical;
3255 const int kwin = p->kwin;
3256 const int win_mode = p->win_mode;
3257 worker_arg_t * const warg = &ctx->wargs[tid];
3258 steplog_thr_t * const slt = warg->slt; /* steplog=FILE (NULL: no log) */
3259 long lg_step = step0; /* (the current step for the log: its type, range, and columns) */
3260 char lg_type = 'u';
3261 int lg_a = 0, lg_b = 0, lg_ns = nvar;
3262 int eff_nrows = *eff_nrows_ptr;
3263 int n_done = 0;
3264 long n_unif = 0; /* completed steps with uniform random permutations (for the information-set estimate) */
3265 long long int n_pairs = 0, hits1 = 0, hits2 = 0; /* see rw_pairs_checked, rw_hits1, rw_hits2 */
3266 double t_last = get_time_sec(), acc_t = 0.0;
3267 int acc_n = 0;
3268 *left = false;
3269
3270 for (int step = 0; step < n_steps; step++) {
3271 if (atomic_load_explicit(&ctx->stop_flag, memory_order_relaxed) ||
3272 atomic_load_explicit(&ctx->rw_stop_flag, memory_order_relaxed)) {
3273 break;
3274 }
3275 if (step > 0 && rw_yield_to_cc(ctx)) { /* (after at least one step per call: progress) */
3276 *left = true;
3277 break;
3278 }
3279
3280 int eff_kwin = kwin;
3281 int eff_win_mode = win_mode;
3282 bool slab = false;
3283 if (eff_kwin == 0) {
3284 if (ctx->slab_on) { /* Stage 3: a row-slab window on every slab_every-th global step (default: every other) */
3285 slab = ((step0 + step) % ctx->slab_every) == ctx->slab_every - 1;
3286 } else if (((step0 + step) & 1) == 1 && rw_hybrid_on(p, nvar)) { /* hybrid: every other global step */
3287 eff_kwin = hybrid_window(p, nvar);
3288 eff_win_mode = 1;
3289 }
3290 }
3291 const bool uniform = !slab && !(eff_kwin > 0 && eff_kwin < nvar);
3292 const int src = slab ? CW_SRC_RW_SLAB : (uniform ? CW_SRC_RW_UNIFORM : CW_SRC_RW_WINDOW);
3293 if (th) rec_step(&th->rec, src);
3294 if (slt) {
3295 steplog_step_begin(slt);
3296 lg_step = step0 + step;
3297 lg_type = 'u';
3298 lg_a = lg_b = 0;
3299 lg_ns = nvar;
3300 }
3301
3302 if (slab) {
3303 const int srank = rw_slab_step(ctx, th, pws, ee, rng_state, tid, &hits1, &hits2, &n_pairs);
3304 if (slt) {
3305 lg_type = 's';
3306 lg_a = th->slab_r0;
3307 lg_b = th->slab_r1;
3308 lg_ns = th->slab_ns;
3309 }
3310 if (srank < 0) break;
3311 rw_rec_flush(ctx, th, tid);
3312 atomic_fetch_add(&ctx->rw_steps_completed, 1);
3313 n_done++;
3314 if (slt) steplog_step_end(ctx, slt, th, tid, lg_step, lg_type, lg_a, lg_b, lg_ns, srank, 1);
3315 rw_time_step(ctx, &t_last, &acc_t, &acc_n, n_done == 1);
3316 continue;
3317 }
3318
3319 if (eff_kwin > 0 && eff_kwin < nvar) {
3320 int seed_col = rand_uniform_thread(nvar, rng_state);
3321 localized_window_perm(perm, nvar, seed_col, eff_kwin, eff_win_mode,
3322 p->spaH, ctx->mHT_cc,
3323 visited_cols, visited_checks, col_queue,
3324 visit_marker, rng_state);
3325 if (slt) {
3326 lg_type = eff_win_mode ? 'i' : 'b';
3327 lg_a = seed_col;
3328 lg_b = eff_win_mode ? seed_col + eff_kwin : eff_kwin;
3329 lg_ns = eff_kwin;
3330 }
3331 } else {
3332 pivs = mzp_rand_thread(pivs, nvar, rng_state);
3333 mzp_set_ui(perm, 1);
3334 perm = perm_p_trans(perm, pivs, 0);
3335 }
3336
3337 memset(piv_mask, 0, (((size_t)nvar + 63) >> 6) * sizeof(word));
3338 if (dl) { /* Stage 4: the sparse-dual elimination, the single columns, and the pairs */
3339 const int rank = rw_dual_step(ctx, dl, th, pws, eff_nrows, perm->values, pivs->values, piv_mask, ee, rng_state,
3340 tid, src, &hits1, &hits2, &n_pairs);
3341 if (rank < 0) break;
3342 eff_nrows = rank;
3343 *eff_nrows_ptr = eff_nrows;
3344 rw_rec_flush(ctx, th, tid);
3345 atomic_fetch_add(&ctx->rw_steps_completed, 1);
3346 n_done++;
3347 if (uniform) n_unif++;
3348 if (slt) steplog_step_end(ctx, slt, th, tid, lg_step, lg_type, lg_a, lg_b, lg_ns, rank, 1);
3349 rw_time_step(ctx, &t_last, &acc_t, &acc_n, n_done == 1);
3350 continue;
3351 }
3352 /* the elimination (see rw_elim_t): column by column, or blocked */
3353 int timed = -1; /* tuning: time this step's elimination, column by column (0) or blocked (1) */
3354 if (el->choice < 0 && el->steps > 0) timed = el->steps & 1;
3355 const double t_elim = (timed >= 0) ? get_time_sec() : 0.0;
3356 int rank = 0;
3357 if (el->choice == 0 || timed == 0) {
3358 for (int i = 0; i < nvar && rank < eff_nrows; i++) {
3359 /* a step on a large matrix can take many seconds: check the stop flags also every 16 columns */
3360 if ((i & 15) == 15 && (atomic_load_explicit(&ctx->stop_flag, memory_order_relaxed) ||
3361 atomic_load_explicit(&ctx->rw_stop_flag, memory_order_relaxed))) {
3362 rank = -1;
3363 break;
3364 }
3365 int col = perm->values[i];
3366 if (gauss_one_rows(mH, col, rank, eff_nrows)) {
3367 pivs->values[rank++] = col;
3368 piv_mask[col >> 6] |= (word)1 << (col & 63);
3369 }
3370 }
3371 } else {
3372 rank = rw_eliminate(ctx, mH, eff_nrows, nvar, perm->values, pivs->values, piv_mask, el);
3373 }
3374 /* abandon the step: `eff_nrows` is kept, as rows rank..eff_nrows-1 are not processed (same row space) */
3375 if (rank < 0) break;
3376 if (el->choice < 0) {
3377 if (timed >= 0) el->t[timed] += get_time_sec() - t_elim;
3378 if (++el->steps > 2 * RW_TUNE_STEPS) {
3379 el->choice = (el->t[1] < el->t[0]) ? 1 : 0;
3380 if (tid == 0 && (p->debug & DBG_TIMING)) {
3381 fprintf(stderr, "# [thread 0] RW elimination: %s (blocked: %.2fx the time of column by column)\n",
3382 el->choice ? "blocked" : "column by column", el->t[1] / (el->t[0] > 0.0 ? el->t[0] : 1e-9));
3383 }
3384 }
3385 }
3386 eff_nrows = rank;
3387 *eff_nrows_ptr = eff_nrows;
3388 if (atomic_load_explicit(&ctx->rw_rank, memory_order_relaxed) != rank) { /* rank of H (the same in every step) */
3389 atomic_store_explicit(&ctx->rw_rank, rank, memory_order_relaxed);
3390 }
3391
3392 mzd_transpose(mHT, mH);
3393
3394 const int active_width = (rank + 63) >> 6;
3395 const word last_mask = (rank & 63) ? (((word)1 << (rank & 63)) - 1) : ~(word)0; /* bits of rows < rank */
3396 bool srows_ready = false;
3397 if (!th) {
3398 for (int col = 0; col < nvar; col++) {
3399 if ((piv_mask[col >> 6] >> (col & 63)) & 1) continue;
3400 const int limit = rw_cw_limit(ctx);
3401 word *rawrow = mzd_row(mHT, col);
3402 /* the weight 1 + (the number of pivot rows with a 1 in column col) first: word-wise popcount, which ends as
3403 * soon as the weight reaches the limit (most candidates are much heavier) */
3404 int wt = 1;
3405 for (int iw = 0; iw < active_width - 1 && wt < limit; iw++) wt += __builtin_popcountll(rawrow[iw]);
3406 if (wt < limit && active_width > 0) wt += __builtin_popcountll(rawrow[active_width - 1] & last_mask);
3407 if (wt >= limit) continue;
3408
3409 int cnt = 0;
3410 ee[cnt++] = col;
3411 rci_t j = -1;
3412 while (cnt < wt) {
3413 j = nextelement(rawrow, active_width, j);
3414 if (j == -1 || j >= rank) break;
3415 ee[cnt++] = pivs->values[j++];
3416 }
3417
3418 /* the check L c != 0 needs no sorted support: only the codewords recorded are sorted (hash key) */
3419 if (classical || colmask_syndrome_non_zero(maskL, cnt, ee)) {
3420 rci_quick_sort(ee, cnt);
3421 if (rw_is_hit(ctx, cnt)) hits1++;
3422 if (slt) slt->orig = 1; /* (steplog=FILE: a single column) */
3423 rw_record_codeword(ctx, ee, cnt, tid, 0, src);
3424 }
3425 }
3426 } else {
3427 /* rw_opt: the L syndromes of the single columns first (Stage 2a: with at most 64 rows of L, from the reduced rows
3428 * of L, before the support of the candidate is formed), and the candidates up to the weight min(limit + rw_ext,
3429 * RW_SHORTEN_WMAX + 1) - 1 for the shortening (see rw_lim_ext(), rw_candidate()) */
3430 const bool use_sig = (pws->nl > 0);
3431 if (use_sig) {
3432 rw_srows(pws, mH, pivs->values, rank, ctx->rw_lhash);
3433 srows_ready = true;
3434 }
3435 const int ext = ctx->rw_shorten ? ctx->rw_ext : 0;
3436 for (int col = 0; col < nvar; col++) {
3437 if ((piv_mask[col >> 6] >> (col & 63)) & 1) continue;
3438 if (use_sig && !rw_srows_sig(pws, col)) continue; /* a zero L syndrome: not a codeword */
3439 const int limit = rw_cw_limit(ctx);
3440 const int lim_ext = rw_lim_ext(limit, ext);
3441 const word * const rawrow = mzd_row(mHT, col);
3442 int wt = 1;
3443 for (int iw = 0; iw < active_width - 1 && wt < lim_ext; iw++) wt += __builtin_popcountll(rawrow[iw]);
3444 if (wt < lim_ext && active_width > 0) wt += __builtin_popcountll(rawrow[active_width - 1] & last_mask);
3445 if (wt >= lim_ext) continue;
3446 int cnt = 0;
3447 ee[cnt++] = col;
3448 for (int iw = 0; iw < active_width; iw++)
3449 for (word x = (iw < active_width - 1) ? rawrow[iw] : (rawrow[iw] & last_mask); x; x &= x - 1)
3450 ee[cnt++] = pivs->values[(iw << 6) + __builtin_ctzll(x)];
3451 if (!use_sig && !classical && !colmask_syndrome_non_zero(maskL, cnt, ee)) continue;
3452 rw_candidate(ctx, th, ee, cnt, limit, false, tid, &hits1);
3453 }
3454 }
3455 if (pws->ent) { /* the pairs of non-pivot columns (p=2) */
3456 int l = rw_pairs_bits(p, nvar, rank, atomic_load_explicit(&ctx->dmax, memory_order_relaxed));
3457 if (l > 0) {
3458 const rw_view_t v = {mHT, NULL, 0, nvar, NULL, 1};
3459 double fkg = NAN;
3460 l = rw_pairs_step(ctx, &v, mH, pivs->values, piv_mask, rank, l, pws, ee, rng_state, tid, src, &n_pairs, &hits2,
3461 th, srows_ready, th ? &fkg : NULL, NULL);
3462 if (l < 0) break; /* stopped in the pairs: the step does not count as completed */
3463 if (th && !isnan(fkg)) { /* the Harris-FKG score -sum ln(1 + w_x) of the step */
3464 warg->fkg_sum[uniform ? 0 : 1] -= fkg;
3465 warg->fkg_steps[uniform ? 0 : 1]++;
3466 }
3467 }
3468 if (l > 0 && atomic_load_explicit(&ctx->rw_pairs_l, memory_order_relaxed) != l)
3469 atomic_store_explicit(&ctx->rw_pairs_l, l, memory_order_relaxed);
3470 }
3471 if (th) rw_rec_flush(ctx, th, tid);
3472 atomic_fetch_add(&ctx->rw_steps_completed, 1);
3473 n_done++;
3474 if (uniform) n_unif++;
3475 if (slt) steplog_step_end(ctx, slt, th, tid, lg_step, lg_type, lg_a, lg_b, lg_ns, rank, 1);
3476 rw_time_step(ctx, &t_last, &acc_t, &acc_n, n_done == 1);
3477 }
3478 if (th) rw_rec_flush(ctx, th, tid); /* (a step abandoned at a stop) */
3479 if (slt && slt->open) steplog_step_end(ctx, slt, th, tid, lg_step, lg_type, lg_a, lg_b, lg_ns, -1, 0);
3480 rw_time_publish(ctx, &acc_t, &acc_n);
3481 atomic_fetch_add_explicit(&ctx->rw_unif_steps, n_unif, memory_order_relaxed);
3482 if (n_pairs > 0) atomic_fetch_add_explicit(&ctx->rw_pairs_checked, n_pairs, memory_order_relaxed);
3483 if (hits1 > 0) atomic_fetch_add_explicit(&ctx->rw_hits1, hits1, memory_order_relaxed);
3484 if (hits2 > 0) atomic_fetch_add_explicit(&ctx->rw_hits2, hits2, memory_order_relaxed);
3485 return n_done;
3486}
3487
3488/* After a completed RW step, only the first `rank` = rank(H) rows of the reduced thread-local matrix `*mH` are non-zero
3489 * (they span the rows of H), and the later steps eliminate only these rows: keep just these rows, so that the
3490 * transposition in each RW step skips the zero rows (for H with redundant rows) */
3491static void rw_shrink_matrices(mzd_t **mH, mzd_t **mHT, const int rank) {
3492 pthread_mutex_lock(&m4ri_mem_mutex);
3493 mzd_t * const top = mzd_init_window(*mH, 0, 0, rank, (*mH)->ncols);
3494 mzd_t * const small = mzd_copy(NULL, top);
3495 mzd_free_window(top);
3496 mzd_free(*mH);
3497 *mH = small;
3498 mzd_free(*mHT);
3499 *mHT = mzd_init(small->ncols, rank);
3500 pthread_mutex_unlock(&m4ri_mem_mutex);
3501}
3502
3503/* Whether row `r` of N has a non-zero entry in a column of the current RW window (visited_cols[j] == marker) */
3504static inline bool ksub_row_in_window(const mzd_t * const N, const int r, const int nvar,
3505 const int * const visited_cols, const int marker) {
3506 const word * const raw_n = mzd_row_cons(N, r);
3507 for (int j = nextelement(raw_n, N->width, -1); j >= 0 && j < nvar; j = nextelement(raw_n, N->width, j + 1)) {
3508 if (visited_cols[j] == marker) return true;
3509 }
3510 return false;
3511}
3512
3513/* Run compact subspace RW batch (ksub > 0) of the global steps step0 .. step0+n_steps-1; returns the number of
3514 * completed steps. `nidx` is the thread's permutation of the row indices 0..nu-1 of N, used to sample ksub distinct
3515 * rows (partial Fisher-Yates shuffle); `*left` as in run_rw_steps() */
3516static int run_rw_steps_ksub(distfork_ctx_t *ctx, long step0, int n_steps,
3517 mzd_t *M_sub, rci_t *ee, mzp_t *perm, mzp_t *pivs, int *nidx,
3518 int *visited_cols, int *visited_checks, int *col_queue,
3519 int *visit_marker, uint64_t *rng_state, int tid, bool *left) {
3520 params_t * const p = ctx->p;
3521 const colmask_t * const maskL = p->maskL; /* NULL for a classical code */
3522 const int nvar = p->spaH->cols;
3523 const int classical = p->classical;
3524 const int nu = ctx->nu;
3525 const int ksub = M_sub->nrows;
3526 const int kwin = p->kwin;
3527 const int win_mode = p->win_mode;
3528
3529 *left = false;
3530 if (nu <= 0 || ksub <= 0 || !ctx->N_global) { /* not reached: no subspace to sample, count the steps as done */
3531 atomic_fetch_add(&ctx->rw_steps_completed, n_steps);
3532 return n_steps;
3533 }
3534
3535 int n_done = 0;
3536 double t_last = get_time_sec(), acc_t = 0.0;
3537 int acc_n = 0;
3538 pthread_rwlock_rdlock(&ctx->basis_rwlock);
3539 const mzd_t * const N = ctx->N_global;
3540
3541 for (int step = 0; step < n_steps; step++) {
3542 if (atomic_load_explicit(&ctx->stop_flag, memory_order_relaxed) ||
3543 atomic_load_explicit(&ctx->rw_stop_flag, memory_order_relaxed)) {
3544 break;
3545 }
3546 if (step > 0 && rw_yield_to_cc(ctx)) { /* (as in run_rw_steps()) */
3547 *left = true;
3548 break;
3549 }
3550
3551 /* 1. Generate column permutation (localized window or uniform) */
3552 int eff_kwin = kwin;
3553 int eff_win_mode = win_mode;
3554 if (rw_hybrid_on(p, nvar) && ((step0 + step) & 1) == 1) { /* hybrid: every other global step */
3555 eff_kwin = hybrid_window(p, nvar);
3556 eff_win_mode = 1;
3557 }
3558
3559 if (eff_kwin > 0 && eff_kwin < nvar) {
3560 int seed_col = rand_uniform_thread(nvar, rng_state);
3561 localized_window_perm(perm, nvar, seed_col, eff_kwin, eff_win_mode,
3562 p->spaH, ctx->mHT_cc,
3563 visited_cols, visited_checks, col_queue,
3564 visit_marker, rng_state);
3565 } else {
3566 pivs = mzp_rand_thread(pivs, nvar, rng_state);
3567 mzp_set_ui(perm, 1);
3568 perm = perm_p_trans(perm, pivs, 0);
3569 }
3570
3571 /* 2. Sample ksub distinct rows of N into M_sub: partial Fisher-Yates shuffle of the row indices (rows drawn
3572 * with replacement would repeat and reduce the rank), with up to 4 redraws to prefer rows overlapping the window */
3573 const int marker = *visit_marker;
3574 const bool in_window = (eff_kwin > 0 && eff_kwin < nvar && visited_cols);
3575 for (int i = 0; i < ksub; i++) {
3576 int j = i + rand_uniform_thread(nu - i, rng_state);
3577 for (int attempt = 0; in_window && attempt < 4 && !ksub_row_in_window(N, nidx[j], nvar, visited_cols, marker);
3578 attempt++) {
3579 j = i + rand_uniform_thread(nu - i, rng_state);
3580 }
3581 SWAPINT(nidx[i], nidx[j]);
3582 mzd_copy_row(M_sub, i, N, nidx[i]);
3583 }
3584
3585 /* 3. Echelonize M_sub directly in L1/L2 cache using permuted column order */
3586 int rank = 0;
3587 for (int i = 0; i < nvar && rank < ksub; i++) {
3588 int col = perm->values[i];
3589 if (gauss_one(M_sub, col, rank)) {
3590 rank++;
3591 }
3592 }
3593
3594 /* 4. Extract candidate codewords directly from reduced rows (already in sorted order) */
3595 for (int ir = 0; ir < rank; ir++) {
3596 int cnt = 0;
3597 const int limit = rw_cw_limit(ctx);
3598
3599 word *rawrow = mzd_row(M_sub, ir);
3600 rci_t j = -1;
3601 while (cnt < limit) {
3602 j = nextelement(rawrow, M_sub->width, j);
3603 if (j == -1 || j >= nvar) break;
3604 ee[cnt++] = j++;
3605 }
3606
3607 if (cnt > 0 && cnt < limit && (classical || colmask_syndrome_non_zero(maskL, cnt, ee))) {
3608 /* irred=1: a reduced row of the sampled subspace is not a circuit, so it can be reducible */
3609 if (!cw_irreducible(ctx, ctx->wargs[tid].irr_ws, cnt, ee)) {
3610 atomic_fetch_add_explicit(&ctx->cw_red_rw, 1, memory_order_relaxed);
3611 continue;
3612 }
3613 rw_record_codeword(ctx, ee, cnt, tid, ksub,
3614 (eff_kwin > 0 && eff_kwin < nvar) ? CW_SRC_RW_WINDOW : CW_SRC_RW_UNIFORM);
3615 }
3616 }
3617 atomic_fetch_add(&ctx->rw_steps_completed, 1);
3618 n_done++;
3619 rw_time_step(ctx, &t_last, &acc_t, &acc_n, n_done == 1);
3620 }
3621 rw_time_publish(ctx, &acc_t, &acc_n);
3622
3623 pthread_rwlock_unlock(&ctx->basis_rwlock);
3624
3625 /* 5. Periodic adaptive basis refresh if enabled */
3626 if (p->refresh > 0 && !atomic_load_explicit(&ctx->stop_flag, memory_order_relaxed) &&
3627 !atomic_load_explicit(&ctx->rw_stop_flag, memory_order_relaxed)) {
3628 long done = atomic_load_explicit(&ctx->rw_steps_completed, memory_order_relaxed);
3629 long next_ref = atomic_load_explicit(&ctx->next_refresh_step, memory_order_relaxed);
3630 if (done >= next_ref && next_ref > 0) {
3631 if (atomic_compare_exchange_strong(&ctx->next_refresh_step, &next_ref,
3632 done + p->refresh)) {
3633 int cw_wt = 0;
3634 pthread_mutex_lock(&ctx->cw_mutex);
