3635 if (p->codewords && p->min_w < nvar) {
3636 cw_vec_t *cw, *tmp;
3637 HASH_ITER(hh, p->codewords, cw, tmp) {
3638 if (cw->weight == p->min_w) {
3639 cw_wt = cw->weight;
3640 for (int k = 0; k < cw_wt; k++) ee[k] = cw->arr[k];
3641 break;
3642 }
3643 }
3644 }
3645 pthread_mutex_unlock(&ctx->cw_mutex);
3646
3647 pthread_rwlock_wrlock(&ctx->basis_rwlock);
3648 pthread_mutex_lock(&m4ri_mem_mutex);
3649 refresh_nullspace_basis(ctx->N_global, cw_wt > 0 ? ee : NULL, cw_wt, rng_state);
3650 pthread_mutex_unlock(&m4ri_mem_mutex);
3651 pthread_rwlock_unlock(&ctx->basis_rwlock);
3652 }
3653 }
3654 }
3655 return n_done;
3656}
3657
3658/* The state of the RW stages of rw_opt of a RW thread (see rw_thr_t) */
3659static rw_thr_t *rw_thr_init(const distfork_ctx_t * const ctx) {
3660 const params_t * const p = ctx->p;
3661 const int nvar = p->spaH->cols, m = p->spaH->rows;
3662 rw_thr_t * const th = calloc(1, sizeof(rw_thr_t));
3663 if (!th) ERROR("memory allocation");
3664 th->ws = rw_tws_init(nvar, ctx->gdb, m);
3665 rec_init(&th->rec);
3666 th->buf = malloc(((size_t)nvar + 2) * sizeof(int));
3667 th->cbuf = malloc(((size_t)nvar + 2) * sizeof(int));
3668 th->ltab = malloc(((size_t)m + 2) * sizeof(double));
3669 if (!th->buf || !th->cbuf || !th->ltab) ERROR("memory allocation");
3670 for (int s = 0; s <= m + 1; s++) th->ltab[s] = log1p((double)s);
3671 if (ctx->slab_on) {
3672 const size_t sw = ((size_t)nvar + 63) >> 6, rw = ((size_t)ctx->slab_msub + 63) >> 6;
3673 th->S = malloc((size_t)ctx->slab_msub * sw * sizeof(word));
3674 th->T = malloc(((size_t)nvar + 1) * rw * sizeof(word));
3675 th->cols = malloc(((size_t)nvar + 1) * sizeof(int));
3676 th->spivs = malloc(((size_t)ctx->slab_msub + 1) * sizeof(int));
3677 th->spmask = malloc((sw + 1) * sizeof(word));
3678 th->smark = calloc((size_t)nvar + 1, sizeof(uint32_t));
3679 if (!th->S || !th->T || !th->cols || !th->spivs || !th->spmask || !th->smark) ERROR("memory allocation");
3680 }
3681 return th;
3682}
3683
3684static rw_thr_t *rw_thr_free(rw_thr_t *th) {
3685 if (!th) return NULL;
3686 rw_tws_free(th->ws);
3687 rec_free(&th->rec);
3688 free(th->buf);
3689 free(th->cbuf);
3690 free(th->ltab);
3691 free(th->S);
3692 free(th->T);
3693 free(th->cols);
3694 free(th->spivs);
3695 free(th->spmask);
3696 free(th->smark);
3697 free(th);
3698 return NULL;
3699}
3700
3701/* Worker thread main loop */
3702static void *worker_thread_func(void *arg) {
3703 worker_arg_t *warg = (worker_arg_t *)arg;
3704 distfork_ctx_t *ctx = warg->ctx;
3705 int tid = warg->tid;
3706 const int nvar = ctx->p->spaH->cols;
3707 /* only workers 0..rw_threads-1 run RW (method 1 or 3) and allocate dense RW matrices; all workers may run CC */
3708 const bool enable_rw = ((ctx->p->method & 1) != 0) && (tid < ctx->rw_threads);
3709 const bool use_ksub = enable_rw && (ctx->p->ksub > 0);
3710 const int ksub_eff = (use_ksub && ctx->nu > 0) ? minint(ctx->p->ksub, ctx->nu) : 0;
3711 /* (warg->min_swei is initialized by the main thread before the workers are launched) */
3712
3713 /* Thread-local RW matrices (allocated safely only if RW is enabled) */
3714 mzd_t *mH = NULL;
3715 mzd_t *mHT_rw = NULL;
3716 mzd_t *M_sub = NULL;
3717 int *nidx = NULL; /* ksub: permutation of the row indices of N, for sampling distinct rows */
3718 rci_t *ee = NULL;
3719 mzp_t *perm = NULL;
3720 mzp_t *pivs = NULL;
3721 word *piv_mask = NULL;
3722 rw_elim_t rw_el = {NULL, 0, 0, 0, 0, {0.0, 0.0}, 0}; /* the RW elimination of this thread */
3723 rw_pairs_ws_t rw_pws; /* the RW pairs of this thread (see rw_pairs_ws_init()) */
3724 memset(&rw_pws, 0, sizeof(rw_pws));
3725 rw_thr_t *rw_th = NULL; /* the RW stages of rw_opt of this thread (NULL: none) */
3726 rw_dual_t *rw_dl = NULL; /* Stage 4: the sparse-dual elimination of this thread (NULL: dense matrices) */
3727 int eff_nrows = ctx->p->spaH->rows;
3728 int *visited_cols = NULL;
3729 int *visited_checks = NULL;
3730 int *col_queue = NULL;
3731 int visit_marker = 0;
3732 /* RNG stream of this thread: a hashed starting point of splitmix64 (consecutive starting points would give
3733 * shifted copies of one stream) */
3734 uint64_t rng_state = mix64((uint64_t)ctx->p->seed ^ mix64((uint64_t)tid + 0x517cc1b727220a95ULL));
3735 /* method 3: the global RW steps rest0 .. rest1-1 of a batch which this worker left for a CC round (see
3736 * rw_yield_to_cc()), run before any new batch is claimed (none if rest0 >= rest1) */
3737 long rest0 = 0, rest1 = 0;
3738
3739 if (enable_rw) {
3740 ee = malloc((nvar + 2) * sizeof(rci_t));
3741 perm = safe_mzp_init(nvar);
3742 pivs = safe_mzp_init(nvar);
3743 if (ctx->p->kwin > 0 || nvar >= 500) {
3744 visited_cols = calloc(nvar, sizeof(int));
3745 visited_checks = calloc(ctx->p->spaH->rows, sizeof(int));
3746 col_queue = calloc(nvar, sizeof(int));
3747 if (!visited_cols || !visited_checks || !col_queue) ERROR("memory allocation");
3748 }
3749 if (!ee || !perm || !pivs) ERROR("memory allocation");
3750 if (use_ksub) {
3751 if (ksub_eff > 0) {
3752 M_sub = safe_mzd_init(ksub_eff, nvar);
3753 nidx = malloc((size_t)ctx->nu * sizeof(int));
3754 if (!nidx) ERROR("memory allocation");
3755 for (int i = 0; i < ctx->nu; i++) nidx[i] = i;
3756 }
3757 } else if (ctx->dual_on) { /* Stage 4: the m x m transform instead of the dense matrices */
3758 rw_dl = rw_dual_init(ctx);
3759 piv_mask = calloc(((size_t)nvar >> 6) + 1, sizeof(word));
3760 if (!piv_mask) ERROR("memory allocation");
3761 rw_pairs_ws_init(&rw_pws, ctx, NULL, nvar);
3762 rw_th = rw_thr_init(ctx);
3763 } else {
3764 mH = safe_mzd_from_csr(NULL, ctx->p->spaH);
3765 mHT_rw = safe_mzd_init(nvar, ctx->p->spaH->rows);
3766 piv_mask = calloc(mH->width, sizeof(word));
3767 /* the tables of rw_eliminate(), with its parameters for this matrix (64-byte aligned rows) */
3768 rw_el.tstride = ((size_t)mH->width + 7) & ~(size_t)7;
3769 rw_block_params(mH->nrows, mH->width, &rw_el.k, &rw_el.nt);
3770 rw_el.choice = (rw_el.nt == 0) ? 0 : ((mH->nrows >= 512) ? 1 : -1); /* (tuning between 128 and 512 rows) */
3771 const size_t tbytes = (rw_el.nt > 0 ? ((size_t)rw_el.nt << rw_el.k) : 1) * rw_el.tstride * sizeof(word);
3772 rw_el.table = aligned_alloc(64, tbytes);
3773 if (!piv_mask || !rw_el.table) ERROR("memory allocation");
3774 memset(rw_el.table, 0, tbytes);
3775 rw_pairs_ws_init(&rw_pws, ctx, mH, nvar);
3776 if (ctx->rw_active) rw_th = rw_thr_init(ctx);
3777 }
3778 if (ctx->steplog && !use_ksub) { /* steplog=FILE: the codewords of the current RW step of this worker */
3779 warg->slt = calloc(1, sizeof(steplog_thr_t));
3780 if (!warg->slt) ERROR("memory allocation");
3781 }
3782 }
3783
3784 /* Thread-local CC memory (only for CC, method 2 or 3) */
3785 const int wmax_alloc = MAX_W - 1;
3786 one_vec_t *err = NULL, *urr = NULL, **syn = NULL;
3787 cc_walk_t walk; /* the CC walk with bitset syndromes (smax = 0: ctx->cc_hash, see cc_walk()) */
3788 memset(&walk, 0, sizeof(walk));
3789 if (ctx->p->method >= 2) {
3790 err = calloc(1, sizeof(one_vec_t) + sizeof(int) * (wmax_alloc + 2));
3791 urr = calloc(1, sizeof(one_vec_t) + sizeof(int) * (wmax_alloc + 2));
3792 syn = calloc(wmax_alloc + 3, sizeof(one_vec_t *));
3793 if (!err || !urr || !syn) ERROR("memory allocation");
3794 for (int i = 0; i <= wmax_alloc + 2; i++) {
3795 syn[i] = calloc(1, sizeof(one_vec_t) + sizeof(int) * (ctx->p->spaH->rows + 1));
3796 if (!syn[i]) ERROR("memory allocation");
3797 }
3798 if (ctx->cc_hash) {
3799 walk.ctx = ctx;
3800 walk.warg = warg;
3801 walk.mH = ctx->p->spaH;
3802 walk.mHT = ctx->mHT_cc;
3803 walk.hs = ctx->cc_hash;
3804 walk.m = ctx->p->spaH->rows;
3805 walk.max_col_wt = ctx->max_col_W;
3806 walk.S = calloc((size_t)(walk.m / 64 + 2), sizeof(uint64_t));
3807 walk.E = calloc((size_t)(nvar / 64 + 2), sizeof(uint64_t));
3808 walk.cols = calloc(wmax_alloc + 3, sizeof(int));
3809 walk.cw = calloc(1, sizeof(one_vec_t) + sizeof(int) * (wmax_alloc + 3));
3810 if (!walk.S || !walk.E || !walk.cols || !walk.cw) ERROR("memory allocation");
3811 walk.prune = ctx->p->cc_prune;
3812 if (walk.prune > 0) { /* the branch and bound, see cc_bnb() */
3813 const int B = (ctx->cc_B > 0) ? ctx->cc_B : 1;
3814 walk.max_row_wt = B;
3815 walk.acnt_col = INT_MIN;
3816 walk.X = calloc((size_t)(nvar / 64 + 2), sizeof(uint64_t));
3817 walk.acnt = calloc((size_t)walk.m + 1, sizeof(int));
3818 walk.kfirst = calloc((size_t)walk.m + 1, sizeof(int));
3819 walk.fstk = malloc(((size_t)nvar + 1) * sizeof(int));
3820 walk.brl = malloc((size_t)(wmax_alloc + 3) * (size_t)B * sizeof(int));
3821 walk.ulist = malloc(((size_t)walk.m + 1) * sizeof(int));
3822 walk.uacnt = malloc(((size_t)walk.m + 1) * sizeof(int));
3823 walk.ord = malloc(((size_t)walk.m + 1) * sizeof(int));
3824 walk.bcnt = malloc(((size_t)B + 2) * sizeof(int));
3825 walk.mark = calloc((size_t)nvar + 1, sizeof(uint32_t));
3826 if (!walk.X || !walk.acnt || !walk.kfirst || !walk.fstk || !walk.brl || !walk.ulist || !walk.uacnt ||
3827 !walk.ord || !walk.bcnt || !walk.mark)
3828 ERROR("memory allocation");
3829 if (walk.prune >= 2) {
3830 walk.cv = malloc(((size_t)nvar + 1) * sizeof(int));
3831 walk.touched = malloc(((size_t)nvar + 1) * sizeof(int));
3832 walk.hist = malloc(((size_t)walk.max_col_wt + 2) * sizeof(int));
3833 if (!walk.cv || !walk.touched || !walk.hist) ERROR("memory allocation");
3834 }
3835 }
3836 }
3837 }
3838
3839 /* irred=1: the workspace of the irreducibility test of the codewords found by CC and by the experimental ksub RW */
3840 if (ctx->p->irred && (ctx->p->method >= 2 || use_ksub)) warg->irr_ws = cols_ws_init(ctx->p->spaH->rows);
3841
3842 while (!atomic_load_explicit(&ctx->stop_flag, memory_order_relaxed)) {
3843 if (ctx->timeout > 0.0 && (get_time_sec() - ctx->start_time >= ctx->timeout)) {
3844 ctx_stop(ctx, STOP_TIMEOUT);
3845 break;
3846 }
3847
3848 bool did_work = false;
3849
3850 /* 1. Try to take CC work if CC is active (method 2 or 3) */
3851 if (ctx->p->method >= 2 && atomic_load_explicit(&ctx->cc_round_active, memory_order_acquire)) {
3852 int active = atomic_load_explicit(&ctx->cc_active_workers, memory_order_relaxed);
3853 int target = atomic_load_explicit(&ctx->cc_target_workers, memory_order_relaxed);
3854 /* A worker without RW work joins any CC round: method 2, a CC-only worker (tid >= rw_threads), RW stopped by
3855 * `min_hits`, or all RW steps already claimed by other workers (it would otherwise idle until the round ends).
3856 * A worker with the rest of a batch left for a CC round (see rw_yield_to_cc()) follows the coordinator's target
3857 * while RW steps remain to be claimed, and otherwise runs the rest first (as a worker finishes its batch). */
3858 const bool rw_on = enable_rw && !atomic_load_explicit(&ctx->rw_stop_flag, memory_order_relaxed);
3859 const bool all_claimed =
3860 rw_on && atomic_load_explicit(&ctx->rw_steps_started, memory_order_relaxed) >= ctx->total_rw_steps;
3861 if (!rw_on || (all_claimed && rest0 >= rest1)) target = ctx->num_threads;
3862 else if (all_claimed) target = 0;
3863 const long long next = atomic_load_explicit(&ctx->cc_next, memory_order_relaxed);
3864 if (active < target && cc_unpack_idx(next) <= cc_unit_last(ctx, cc_unpack_w(next), cc_unpack_lev(next))) {
3865 if (atomic_compare_exchange_weak(&ctx->cc_active_workers, &active, active + 1)) {
3866 if (rw_on && rest0 < rest1) atomic_fetch_add_explicit(&ctx->cc_rw_joins, 1, memory_order_relaxed);
3867 const double t_join = get_time_sec();
3868 while (!atomic_load_explicit(&ctx->stop_flag, memory_order_relaxed)) {
3869 if (ctx->timeout > 0.0 && (get_time_sec() - ctx->start_time >= ctx->timeout)) {
3870 ctx_stop(ctx, STOP_TIMEOUT);
3871 break;
3872 }
3873 /* claim the next work unit together with the weight and the fixed levels of its round (see cc_pack()) */
3874 const long long claim = atomic_fetch_add_explicit(&ctx->cc_next, 1, memory_order_relaxed);
3875 const int w = cc_unpack_w(claim);
3876 const int lev = cc_unpack_lev(claim);
3877 const int unit = cc_unpack_idx(claim);
3878 if (unit > cc_unit_last(ctx, w, lev)) break;
3879 /* the start index of the unit, and its branches at the fixed levels: the digits of the unit in radix B */
3880 const int idx = unit / ctx->cc_R[lev];
3881 int fix[CC_SPLIT_MAX_LEVELS];
3882 for (int l = 0, k = unit - idx * ctx->cc_R[lev]; l < lev; l++, k /= ctx->cc_B) fix[l] = k % ctx->cc_B;
3883 /* with the expert `start` list, `idx` enumerates the listed start columns */
3884 const int col = (ctx->p->start_num > 0) ? ctx->p->start_list[idx] : idx;
3885
3886 if (walk.S) {
3887 const int swei = ctx->mHT_cc->p[col + 1] - ctx->mHT_cc->p[col];
3888 if (w > 1) {
3889 if (swei > 0 && swei <= (w - 1) * ctx->max_col_W) {
3890 if (walk.prune > 0) cc_bnb_unit(&walk, col, idx, w, fix, lev);
3891 else cc_walk_unit(&walk, col, w, fix, lev);
3892 }
3893 continue;
3894 }
3895 if (swei > 0) continue;
3896 }
3897
3898 err->vec[0] = urr->vec[0] = col;
3899 err->wei = urr->wei = 1;
3900 syn[1]->wei = 0;
3901 int swei = walk.S ? 0 : one_csr_row_combine(syn[1], syn[0], ctx->mHT_cc, col);
3902
3903 if (ctx->p->smax && swei > 0 && swei <= ctx->p->smax) {
3904 if (swei < warg->min_swei[1]) {
3905 warg->min_swei[1] = swei;
3906 }
3907 }
3908
3909 if (w > 1) {
3910 if (swei > 0 && swei <= (w - 1) * ctx->max_col_W + ctx->p->smax) {
3911 if (walk.S) {
3912 if (walk.prune > 0) cc_bnb_unit(&walk, col, idx, w, fix, lev);
3913 else cc_walk_unit(&walk, col, w, fix, lev);
3914 } else {
3915 start_CC_recurs_mt(err, urr, syn, w, ctx->max_col_W,
3916 ctx->p->spaH, ctx->mHT_cc, warg, fix, lev);
3917 }
3918 }
3919 } else {
3920 if (!swei) {
3921 int nz = (!ctx->p->maskL) || colmask_syndrome_non_zero(ctx->p->maskL, 1, err->vec);
3922 if (nz) {
3923 params_t * const p = ctx->p;
3924 pthread_mutex_lock(&ctx->cw_mutex);
3925 p->codewords = codeword_add_maybe(p, err->vec, 1, CW_SRC_OTHER);
3926 if (res.on) res_witness_set(err->vec, 1, "cc");
3927 ctx_update_feed_limit(ctx);
3928 rw_canon_sync_locked(ctx);
3929 if ((p->debug & DBG_CODEWORDS) && atomic_load(&ctx->dmax) != 1) {
3930 char prefix[48];
3931 snprintf(prefix, sizeof(prefix), "# [thread %d] CC codeword", tid);
3932 print_codeword_support(stderr, prefix, err->vec, 1, p->debug);
3933 }
3934 atomic_store(&ctx->cc_found_weight, 1);
3935 atomic_store(&ctx->cc_exact, true); /* weight 1 is always the exact distance */
3936 atomic_store(&ctx->dmin, 1);
3937 atomic_store(&ctx->dmax, 1);
3938 res_event_ctx(ctx);
3939 /* d=1 is known; with outC or maxC, the round goes on to collect all codewords of weight 1 */
3940 if (codeword_maxc_reached(p)) {
3941 ctx_stop(ctx, STOP_MAXC);
3942 } else if (!p->outC && p->maxC == 0) {
3943 ctx_stop(ctx, STOP_CC_FOUND);
3944 }
3945 pthread_mutex_unlock(&ctx->cw_mutex);
3946 }
3947 }
3948 }
3949 err->wei = urr->wei = 0;
3950 }
3951 /* CC thread time (added before leaving the round, so the coordinator sees it once the round is over) */
3952 atomic_fetch_add_explicit(&ctx->cc_busy_ns, (long long)((get_time_sec() - t_join) * 1e9),
3953 memory_order_relaxed);
3954 atomic_fetch_add_explicit(&ctx->cc_nodes, walk.nodes, memory_order_relaxed);
3955 walk.nodes = 0;
3956 atomic_fetch_sub_explicit(&ctx->cc_active_workers, 1, memory_order_release);
3957 did_work = true;
3958 continue;
3959 }
3960 }
3961 }
3962
3963 /* 2. Try to take RW work if RW is active (method 1 or 3): the rest of a batch left for a CC round first */
3964 if (enable_rw && !atomic_load(&ctx->stop_flag) && !atomic_load(&ctx->rw_stop_flag)) {
3965 long cur_s = rest0, target_s = rest1;
3966 bool claimed = (rest0 < rest1);
3967 if (!claimed) {
3968 cur_s = atomic_load(&ctx->rw_steps_started);
3969 if (cur_s < ctx->total_rw_steps) {
3970 long batch_size;
3971 if (ctx->p->chunk_size > 0) {
3972 batch_size = ctx->p->chunk_size;
3973 } else {
3974 int nvar = ctx->p->nvar;
3975 if (nvar < 500) {
3976 if (ctx->total_rw_steps >= 50000) batch_size = 500;
3977 else if (ctx->total_rw_steps >= 1000) batch_size = 250;
3978 else batch_size = 50;
3979 } else if (nvar < 5000) {
3980 if (ctx->total_rw_steps >= 10000) batch_size = 100;
3981 else batch_size = 50;
3982 } else {
3983 /* Large matrices (e.g. n >= 5000): fewer steps per batch (in method 3, see also m3_batch_steps()) */
3984 if (ctx->total_rw_steps >= 10000) batch_size = 50;
3985 else batch_size = 25;
3986 }
3987 /* method 3: at most about M3_BATCH_TIME seconds of RW steps (see m3_batch_steps()) */
3988 if (ctx->p->method == 3) batch_size = m3_batch_steps(ctx, batch_size);
3989 }
3990 /* Guided scheduling: a batch takes at most a quarter of the remaining steps per RW thread, so that no
3991 * thread monopolizes the steps and the RW threads finish together (no idle threads at the end of the
3992 * steps) */
3993 if (ctx->rw_threads > 1) {
3994 const long guided = (ctx->total_rw_steps - cur_s + 4L * ctx->rw_threads - 1) / (4L * ctx->rw_threads);
3995 if (batch_size > guided) batch_size = (guided > 0) ? guided : 1;
3996 }
3997 target_s = cur_s + batch_size;
3998 if (target_s > ctx->total_rw_steps) target_s = ctx->total_rw_steps;
3999 claimed = atomic_compare_exchange_weak(&ctx->rw_steps_started, &cur_s, target_s);
4000 }
4001 }
4002 if (claimed) {
4003 const int n_steps = (int)(target_s - cur_s);
4004 int n_done = n_steps;
4005 bool left = false; /* the batch was left for a CC round after n_done steps (see rw_yield_to_cc()) */
4006 if (use_ksub) {
4007 if (ksub_eff > 0) {
4008 n_done = run_rw_steps_ksub(ctx, cur_s, n_steps, M_sub, ee, perm, pivs, nidx,
4009 visited_cols, visited_checks, col_queue,
4010 &visit_marker, &rng_state, tid, &left);
4011 } else {
4012 atomic_fetch_add(&ctx->rw_steps_completed, n_steps);
4013 }
4014 } else {
4015 n_done = run_rw_steps(ctx, cur_s, n_steps, mH, mHT_rw, ee, perm, pivs,
4016 piv_mask, &rw_el, &rw_pws, &eff_nrows, visited_cols, visited_checks,
4017 col_queue, &visit_marker, &rng_state, tid, rw_th, rw_dl, &left);
4018 if (mH && eff_nrows > 0 && eff_nrows < mH->nrows) rw_shrink_matrices(&mH, &mHT_rw, eff_nrows);
4019 }
4020 /* the steps not run of a batch left for a CC round are run later (the steps of a batch ended by a stop flag
4021 * are not run: the run, or RW, ends) */
4022 rest0 = left ? cur_s + n_done : 0;
4023 rest1 = left ? target_s : 0;
4024 did_work = true;
4025 continue;
4026 }
4027 }
4028
4029 if (!did_work) {
4030 usleep(100);
4031 }
4032 }
4033
4034 if (enable_rw) {
4035 free(piv_mask);
4036 free(rw_el.table);
4037 rw_pairs_ws_free(&rw_pws);
4038 rw_th = rw_thr_free(rw_th);
4039 rw_dl = rw_dual_free(rw_dl);
4040 warg->slt = steplog_thr_free(warg->slt);
4041 safe_mzp_free(perm);
4042 safe_mzp_free(pivs);
4043 free(ee);
4044 free(visited_cols);
4045 free(visited_checks);
4046 free(col_queue);
4047 free(nidx);
4048 safe_mzd_free(M_sub);
4049 safe_mzd_free(mHT_rw);
4050 safe_mzd_free(mH);
4051 }
4052
4053 if (syn) {
4054 for (int i = 0; i <= wmax_alloc + 2; i++) free(syn[i]);
4055 free(syn);
4056 }
4057 free(err);
4058 free(urr);
4059 free(walk.S);
4060 free(walk.E);
4061 free(walk.cols);
4062 free(walk.cw);
4063 free(walk.X);
4064 free(walk.acnt);
4065 free(walk.kfirst);
4066 free(walk.fstk);
4067 free(walk.brl);
4068 free(walk.ulist);
4069 free(walk.uacnt);
4070 free(walk.ord);
4071 free(walk.bcnt);
4072 free(walk.mark);
4073 free(walk.cv);
4074 free(walk.touched);
4075 free(walk.hist);
4076 warg->irr_ws = cols_ws_free(warg->irr_ws);
4077
4078 return NULL;
4079}
4080
4081/* Percentage of the start indices of the current (or last) CC round claimed by the workers (in work units) */
4082static double cc_round_claimed(distfork_ctx_t * const ctx) {
4083 const long long beg = (long long)ctx->round_beg * ctx->round_R;
4084 const long long end = ((long long)ctx->round_end + 1) * ctx->round_R; /* one past the last work unit */
4085 if (end <= beg) return 100.0;
4086 long long idx = cc_unpack_idx(atomic_load(&ctx->cc_next));
4087 if (idx > end) idx = end;
4088 if (idx < beg) idx = beg;
4089 return 100.0 * (double)(idx - beg) / (double)(end - beg);
4090}
4091
4092/* State of RW once it no longer runs, for messages */
4093static const char *rw_end_state(distfork_ctx_t * const ctx) {
4094 if (atomic_load(&ctx->rw_stop_flag)) return "converged";
4095 if (atomic_load(&ctx->rw_steps_completed) >= ctx->total_rw_steps) return "all steps done";
4096 return "stopped";
4097}
4098
4099/* DBG_STATUS: periodic status line, after 1, 2, 4, ... s, then every 60 s (called by the coordinator only) */
4100static void ctx_status(distfork_ctx_t * const ctx) {
4101 params_t * const p = ctx->p;
4102 if (!(p->debug & DBG_STATUS)) return;
4103 const double t = get_time_sec() - ctx->start_time;
4104 if (t < ctx->status_next) return;
4105 ctx->status_next += ctx->status_dt;
4106 if (ctx->status_next <= t) ctx->status_next = t + ctx->status_dt;
4107 ctx->status_dt = (2.0 * ctx->status_dt < 60.0) ? 2.0 * ctx->status_dt : 60.0;
4108
4109 char cc_str[160] = "", rw_str[320] = "";
4110 if (p->method >= 2) {
4111 if (ctx->round_open) {
4112 int len = snprintf(cc_str, sizeof(cc_str), "; CC round w=%d: %.1f%% of start columns claimed, %.3gs",
4113 ctx->round_w, cc_round_claimed(ctx), get_time_sec() - ctx->round_t0);
4114 if (ctx->round_est > 0.0 && ctx->round_threads > 0 && len > 0 && len < (int)sizeof(cc_str))
4115 snprintf(cc_str + len, sizeof(cc_str) - len, " (predicted %.3gs on %d threads)",
4116 ctx->round_est / ctx->round_threads, ctx->round_threads);
4117 } else {
4118 snprintf(cc_str, sizeof(cc_str), "; CC %s", ctx->cc_idle ? ctx->cc_idle : "between rounds");
4119 }
4120 }
4121 if ((p->method & 1) && ctx->rw_threads > 0) {
4122 const long steps = atomic_load(&ctx->rw_steps_completed);
4123 const double rate = (t > ctx->status_t) ? (double)(steps - ctx->status_steps) / (t - ctx->status_t) : 0.0;
4124 ctx->status_steps = steps;
4125 ctx->status_t = t;
4126 const bool rw_on = !atomic_load(&ctx->rw_stop_flag) && steps < ctx->total_rw_steps;
4127 int len = snprintf(rw_str, sizeof(rw_str), "; RW: %ld of %ld steps (%.3g/s)%s%s", steps, ctx->total_rw_steps,
4128 rate, rw_on ? "" : ", ", rw_on ? "" : rw_end_state(ctx));
4129 if (p->min_hits > 0 && len > 0 && len < (int)sizeof(rw_str)) {
4130 /* the statistic of the min_hits stop: the canonical classes (rw_opt bit 16), or the average hits <n> */
4131 cw_hit_stats_t st = {0};
4132 pthread_mutex_lock(&ctx->cw_mutex);
4133 const int rule = min_hits_rule(p);
4134 const rw_canon_stats_t cs = p->canon;
4135 if (rule == MIN_HITS_VECTOR) codeword_hit_stats(p, &st);
4136 pthread_mutex_unlock(&ctx->cw_mutex);
4137 if (rule == MIN_HITS_CANON) {
4138 if (cs.w < INT_MAX && cs.classes <= 0)
4139 snprintf(rw_str + len, sizeof(rw_str) - len, ", min_hits stop inactive: no codeword of weight %d in the "
4140 "uniform steps yet", cs.w);
4141 else if (cs.w < INT_MAX)
4142 snprintf(rw_str + len, sizeof(rw_str) - len, ", canonical classes (w=%d): %.2f step incidences per class "
4143 "over %lld classes, p_GT=%.3g", cs.w, (double)cs.n_unif / (double)cs.classes, cs.classes,
4144 (double)cs.f1 / (double)cs.n_unif);
4145 } else if (st.min_cws > 0 && st.set_cws > 0) {
4146 len += snprintf(rw_str + len, sizeof(rw_str) - len, ", <n>=%.2f over %lld cws of weight %d..%d", st.avg,
4147 st.set_cws, st.w_lo, st.w_hi);
4148 if (st.excl_hits > 0 && len > 0 && len < (int)sizeof(rw_str)) /* (see rw_nhits_sources()) */
4149 snprintf(rw_str + len, sizeof(rw_str) - len, " (%lld window and slab hits not counted)", st.excl_hits);
4150 } else if (st.all_cws > 0) {
4151 snprintf(rw_str + len, sizeof(rw_str) - len, ", min_hits stop inactive: no codeword of weight %d in the "
4152 "uniform steps yet (%lld window and slab hits not counted)", st.w_lo, st.excl_hits);
4153 }
4154 }
4155 }
4156 fprintf(stderr, "# status %.1fs: bounds [%d, %d]%s%s\n", t, atomic_load(&ctx->dmin), atomic_load(&ctx->dmax),
4157 cc_str, rw_str);
4158}
4159
4160/* Start the workers ctx->spawned .. n-1 (main thread only). If a thread cannot be created, the run goes on with the
4161 * workers already started, and no more are started. */
4162static void ctx_spawn(distfork_ctx_t * const ctx, const int n) {
4163 for (int i = ctx->spawned; i < n && !ctx->spawn_failed; i++) {
4164 const int err = pthread_create(&ctx->threads[i], NULL, worker_thread_func, &ctx->wargs[i]);
4165 if (err != 0) {
4166 if (i == 0) ERROR("cannot create a worker thread (error %d)", err);
4167 fprintf(stderr, "# Warning: cannot create worker thread %d (error %d), running with %d threads\n", i, err, i);
4168 ctx->spawn_failed = true;
4169 break;
4170 }
4171 ctx->spawned = i + 1;
4172 }
4173}
4174
4175/* Method 2 (unless nothrottle=1) starts only CC_SPAWN_INITIAL workers, and the others for a CC round predicted to take
4176 * more than CC_SPAWN_WORK thread-seconds per started worker (or of unknown work), or once a round has run for
4177 * CC_SPAWN_TIME seconds: tiny runs avoid the start-up of many threads, longer runs use all of them (any worker can
4178 * join a CC round at any time) */
4179#define CC_SPAWN_INITIAL 4
4180#define CC_SPAWN_WORK 2e-3
4181#define CC_SPAWN_TIME 5e-3
4182
4183/* Method 2: some workers not started yet */
4184static inline bool m2_can_spawn(const distfork_ctx_t * const ctx) {
4185 return ctx->spawned < ctx->num_threads && !ctx->spawn_failed;
4186}
4187
4188/* Method 2: start the remaining workers during (or for) the CC round at weight w; `why`: for the message */
4189static void m2_spawn_rest(distfork_ctx_t * const ctx, const int w, const char * const why) {
4190 const int n0 = ctx->spawned;
4191 ctx_spawn(ctx, ctx->num_threads);
4192 ctx->round_threads = ctx->spawned;
4193 if ((ctx->p->debug & DBG_TIMING) && ctx->spawned > n0) {
4194 fprintf(stderr, "# CC round w=%d: started %d more threads, %d in total (%s)\n", w, ctx->spawned - n0, ctx->spawned,
4195 why);
4196 }
4197}
4198
4199/* Method 1 coordinator */
4200static void run_method1_coordinator(distfork_ctx_t *ctx) {
4201 while (!atomic_load(&ctx->stop_flag)) {
4202 if (ctx->timeout > 0.0 && (get_time_sec() - ctx->start_time >= ctx->timeout)) {
4203 ctx_stop(ctx, STOP_TIMEOUT);
4204 break;
4205 }
4206 if (atomic_load(&ctx->rw_steps_completed) >= ctx->total_rw_steps) {
4207 ctx_stop(ctx, STOP_RW_STEPS);
4208 break;
4209 }
4210 ctx_status(ctx);
4211 usleep(1000);
4212 }
4213}
4214
4215/* Estimated work of the CC round at weight w in thread-seconds (the unit of `cc_time_per_weight`, i.e., wall time
4216 * times the number of CC threads): the measured work W(w-1) of the previous round times the growth factor
4217 * W(w-1)/W(w-2), clamped to [2, 10] (4 if W(w-2) is not known), also returned in `*growth`; when all codewords have
4218 * even weight (even_weight_only: the odd rounds are skipped), W(w-2) times the factor W(w-2)/W(w-4) of two weights,
4219 * clamped to [4, 100] (16 if W(w-4) is not known). Returns 0 if the previous round has not been measured (the first
4220 * round at a supplied dmin > 1). */
4221static double cc_work_estimate(const distfork_ctx_t * const ctx, const int w, double * const growth) {
4222 if (ctx->even_weight_only && !(w & 1)) {
4223 *growth = 16.0;
4224 if (w <= 2) return 1e-4;
4225 if (w > MAX_W) return 0.0;
4226 const double prev = ctx->cc_time_per_weight[w - 2];
4227 if (!(prev > 0.0)) return 0.0;
4228 if (w >= 6 && ctx->cc_time_per_weight[w - 4] > 1e-4) {
4229 const double g = prev / ctx->cc_time_per_weight[w - 4];
4230 *growth = (g < 4.0) ? 4.0 : ((g > 100.0) ? 100.0 : g);
4231 }
4232 return ((prev > 1e-4) ? prev : 1e-4) * (*growth);
4233 }
4234 *growth = 4.0;
4235 if (w <= 1) return 1e-4; /* one syndrome per column */
4236 if (w > MAX_W) return 0.0;
4237 const double prev = ctx->cc_time_per_weight[w - 1];
4238 if (!(prev > 0.0)) return 0.0;
4239 if (w >= 3 && ctx->cc_time_per_weight[w - 2] > 1e-4) {
4240 const double g = prev / ctx->cc_time_per_weight[w - 2];
4241 *growth = (g < 2.0) ? 2.0 : ((g > 10.0) ? 10.0 : g);
4242 }
4243 return ((prev > 1e-4) ? prev : 1e-4) * (*growth);
4244}
4245
4246/* Number of collected codewords (the collection window, as exported with outC), for messages */
4247static long long ctx_num_cws(distfork_ctx_t * const ctx) {
4248 pthread_mutex_lock(&ctx->cw_mutex);
4249 const long long num = codeword_window_count(ctx->p);
4250 pthread_mutex_unlock(&ctx->cw_mutex);
4251 return num;
4252}
4253
4254/* Method 2 coordinator */
4255static void run_method2_coordinator(distfork_ctx_t *ctx) {
4256 const int wmax = ctx->p->wmax;
4257 const int w_start = ctx->p->noscan ? wmax : (ctx->p->dmin > 1 ? ctx->p->dmin : 1);
4258 /* with outC or maxC, CC does not stop at the first codeword but collects all codewords of a round */
4259 const bool collecting = (ctx->p->outC != NULL) || (ctx->p->maxC > 0);
4260 /* with outC and dW > 0, extra CC rounds export the codewords of weight up to d + dW */
4261 const int extra_w = (ctx->p->outC && ctx->p->dW > 0) ? ctx->p->dW : 0;
4262
4263 int w_limit = wmax;
4264 for (int w = w_start; ; w++) {
4265 if (atomic_load(&ctx->stop_flag)) break;
4266 /* The current upper bound dmax (given, read from finC, or found by CC) limits the rounds: since the CC kernel
4267 * caps the cluster weight at dmax + dW, a round w > dmax + extra_w would only enumerate the same clusters
4268 * again. Unless codewords are collected, the round w = dmax is not needed once dmin = dmax. */
4269 const int cur_dmax = atomic_load(&ctx->dmax);
4270 if (cur_dmax > 0) {
4271 if (!collecting && atomic_load(&ctx->dmin) >= cur_dmax) {
4272 if (ctx->p->debug & DBG_PROGRESS) {
4273 fprintf(stderr, "# bounds coincide: dmin = dmax = %d (CC round w=%d not needed)%s\n",
4274 cur_dmax, w, tstamp_now(ctx).s);
4275 }
4276 ctx_stop(ctx, STOP_BOUNDS);
4277 break;
4278 }
4279 w_limit = minint(w_limit, cur_dmax + extra_w);
4280 }
4281 /* The stop target dstop (if below dmax): no rounds w >= dstop are needed, except the rounds w = dstop..dstop+dW
4282 * which collect codewords */
4283 const int dstop = ctx->p->dstop;
4284 if (dstop > 0 && (cur_dmax == 0 || dstop < cur_dmax)) {
4285 if (!collecting && atomic_load(&ctx->dmin) >= dstop) {
4286 if (ctx->p->debug & DBG_PROGRESS) {
4287 fprintf(stderr, "# lower bound dmin=%d reached dstop=%d (CC round w=%d not needed)%s\n",
4288 atomic_load(&ctx->dmin), dstop, w, tstamp_now(ctx).s);
4289 }
4290 ctx_stop(ctx, STOP_DSTOP);
4291 break;
4292 }
4293 w_limit = minint(w_limit, collecting ? dstop + extra_w : dstop - 1);
4294 }
4295 if (w > w_limit) {
4296 ctx->stop_w = w_limit;
4297 ctx_stop(ctx, (dstop > 0 && atomic_load(&ctx->dmin) >= dstop) ? STOP_DSTOP : STOP_CC_DONE);
4298 break;
4299 }
4300 if (ctx->even_weight_only && (w & 1)) {
4301 if (w == atomic_load(&ctx->dmin)) {
4302 atomic_store(&ctx->dmin, w + 1);
4303 res_event_ctx(ctx);
4304 }
4305 continue;
4306 }
4307
4308 double now = get_time_sec();
4309 double remaining_time = ctx->timeout - (now - ctx->start_time);
4310 if (ctx->timeout > 0.0 && remaining_time <= 0.0) {
4311 ctx_stop(ctx, STOP_TIMEOUT);
4312 break;
4313 }
4314
4315 /* With a timeout, a round predicted not to finish in time is started anyway: it can still end early with a
4316 * codeword of weight w, which gives the exact distance (all lower weights have been analyzed) */
4317 double growth;
4318 const double t_cc_work = cc_work_estimate(ctx, w, &growth); /* thread-seconds (0: unknown) */
4319 if (ctx->timeout > 0.0 && (ctx->p->debug & DBG_PROGRESS)) {
4320 const double t_cc_est = t_cc_work / ctx->num_threads; /* wall time */
4321 if (t_cc_est > remaining_time) {
4322 fprintf(stderr, "# CC for w=%d (est %.2fs) may not finish in the remaining time %.2fs, searching anyway "
4323 "(dmin=%d)%s\n", w, t_cc_est, remaining_time, atomic_load(&ctx->dmin),
4324 tstamp_at(ctx->p, now - ctx->start_time).s);
4325 }
4326 }
4327
4328 const int beg = cc_round_beg(ctx->p);
4329 const int end = cc_round_end(ctx->p, w);
4330 /* all weights below w analyzed (or a supplied dmin): a codeword of weight w found is exact */
4331 const bool certified = (w == atomic_load(&ctx->dmin));
4332 /* the workers not started yet, for a longer round (or one of unknown work) */
4333 if (m2_can_spawn(ctx) && !(t_cc_work > 0.0 && t_cc_work <= CC_SPAWN_WORK * ctx->spawned)) {
4334 char why[64];
4335 if (t_cc_work > 0.0) snprintf(why, sizeof(why), "predicted %.3g thread-s", t_cc_work);
4336 else snprintf(why, sizeof(why), "work not known");
4337 m2_spawn_rest(ctx, w, why);
4338 }
4339 const int lev = cc_round_levels(ctx, w, beg, end, t_cc_work); /* fixed levels of the CC work units */
4340 const int last = cc_unit_last(ctx, w, lev);
4341
4342 atomic_store(&ctx->cc_target_workers, ctx->num_threads);
4343 const long long busy_ns0 = atomic_load(&ctx->cc_busy_ns);
4344 const long long nodes0 = atomic_load(&ctx->cc_nodes);
4345 atomic_store(&ctx->cc_next, cc_pack(w, lev, beg * ctx->cc_R[lev]));
4346 atomic_store(&ctx->cc_round_active, 1);
4347
4348 double cc_start = get_time_sec();
4349 ctx->round_open = 1;
4350 ctx->round_w = w;
4351 ctx->round_beg = beg;
4352 ctx->round_end = end;
4353 ctx->round_R = ctx->cc_R[lev];
4354 ctx->round_threads = ctx->spawned;
4355 ctx->round_t0 = cc_start;
4356 ctx->round_est = t_cc_work;
4357
4358 if (ctx->p->debug & DBG_TIMING) {
4359 const char *note = (certified || atomic_load(&ctx->cc_exact)) ? "" : " (lower weights not scanned)";
4360 char units[64] = "";
4361 if (lev > 0) snprintf(units, sizeof(units), ", %d work units per start column", ctx->cc_R[lev]);
4362 if (ctx->p->start_num > 0) {
4363 fprintf(stderr, "# searching w=%d with %d CC threads, start list (%d columns%s)%s%s\n",
4364 w, ctx->spawned, ctx->p->start_num, ctx->p->start_scan ? ", start_scan=1" : "", units, note);
4365 } else {
4366 fprintf(stderr, "# searching w=%d with %d CC threads, columns [%d, %d]%s%s\n",
4367 w, ctx->spawned, beg, end, units, note);
4368 }
4369 }
4370
4371 bool round_completed = false;
4372 while (!atomic_load(&ctx->stop_flag)) {
4373 const double t = get_time_sec();
4374 if (ctx->timeout > 0.0 && (t - ctx->start_time >= ctx->timeout)) {
4375 ctx_stop(ctx, STOP_TIMEOUT);
4376 break;
4377 }
4378 if (cc_unpack_idx(atomic_load(&ctx->cc_next)) > last && atomic_load(&ctx->cc_active_workers) == 0) {
4379 round_completed = true;
4380 break;
4381 }
4382 if (m2_can_spawn(ctx) && t - cc_start > CC_SPAWN_TIME) {
4383 char why[64];
4384 snprintf(why, sizeof(why), "running for %.3fs", t - cc_start);
4385 m2_spawn_rest(ctx, w, why);
4386 }
4387 ctx_status(ctx);
4388 usleep(100);
4389 }
4390
4391 atomic_store(&ctx->cc_round_active, 0);
4392 if (round_completed) ctx->round_open = 0;
4393
4394 const double t_round_end = get_time_sec();
4395 double cc_dur = t_round_end - cc_start;
4396 const double cc_work_meas = 1e-9 * (double)(atomic_load(&ctx->cc_busy_ns) - busy_ns0);
4397 const long long cc_nodes_meas = atomic_load(&ctx->cc_nodes) - nodes0;
4398 if (w < MAX_W) { /* CC work of the round in thread-seconds, as measured by the workers */
4399 ctx->cc_time_per_weight[w] = cc_work_meas;
4400 if ((ctx->p->debug & DBG_TIMING) && round_completed) {
4401 char est_str[48] = "unknown";
4402 if (t_cc_work > 0.0) snprintf(est_str, sizeof(est_str), "%.3g thread-s", t_cc_work);
4403 fprintf(stderr, "# CC round w=%d work: %.3g thread-s measured, %s predicted (%.3fs on %d threads), %lld "
4404 "nodes\n", w, ctx->cc_time_per_weight[w], est_str, cc_dur, ctx->spawned, cc_nodes_meas);
4405 }
4406 }
4407 res_round_add(w, busy_ns0, nodes0, cc_work_meas, cc_dur, cc_nodes_meas, ctx->spawned, round_completed);
4408
4409 int cw_found = atomic_load(&ctx->cc_found_weight);
4410 if (cw_found > 0 && certified && cw_found == w && !atomic_load(&ctx->cc_exact)) {
4411 atomic_store(&ctx->cc_exact, true);
4412 }
4413 const bool exact = (cw_found > 0) && atomic_load(&ctx->cc_exact);
4414 if (exact) {
4415 atomic_store(&ctx->dmin, cw_found);
4416 atomic_store(&ctx->dmax, cw_found);
4417 const double t_now = t_round_end - ctx->start_time;
4418 res_event_ctx_at(ctx, t_now);
4419 /* the distance is known: no rounds beyond w = cw_found + extra_w */
4420 w_limit = minint(w_limit, cw_found + extra_w);
4421 const int next_w = (ctx->even_weight_only && !(w & 1)) ? w + 2 : w + 1;
4422 const bool more_rounds = round_completed && (next_w <= w_limit);
4423 if (ctx->p->debug & DBG_PROGRESS) {
4424 const tstamp_t ts = tstamp_at(ctx->p, t_now);
4425 if (w == cw_found && more_rounds) {
4426 fprintf(stderr,
4427 "# CC round w=%d finished in %.3fs (%d CC threads): found min-weight codewords "
4428 "(dmin=%d, continuing up to w=%d for dW=%d, total %lld cws)%s\n",
4429 w, cc_dur, ctx->spawned, cw_found, w_limit, ctx->p->dW, ctx_num_cws(ctx), ts.s);
4430 } else if (w == cw_found) {
4431 fprintf(stderr, "# CC found min-weight codeword: d=%d (using %d CC threads, total %lld cws)%s\n",
4432 cw_found, ctx->spawned, ctx_num_cws(ctx), ts.s);
4433 } else if (round_completed) {
4434 fprintf(stderr,
4435 "# CC round w=%d finished in %.3fs (%d CC threads): extra dW round completed "
4436 "(dmin=%d, total %lld cws)%s\n",
4437 w, cc_dur, ctx->spawned, cw_found, ctx_num_cws(ctx), ts.s);
4438 }
4439 }
4440 if (!more_rounds) {
4441 /* (a stop reason recorded during the round, e.g., the timeout, is kept) */
4442 ctx_stop(ctx, collecting ? STOP_COLLECTED : STOP_CC_FOUND);
4443 break;
4444 }
4445 } else if (cw_found > 0) {
4446 /* noscan=1 without dmin=wmax: lower weights not scanned, the codeword only gives an upper bound */
4447 if (ctx->p->debug & DBG_PROGRESS) {
4448 fprintf(stderr,
4449 "# CC round w=%d finished in %.3fs (%d CC threads): found codeword of weight %d -> dmax=%d "
4450 "(dmin=%d not certified: lower weights not scanned)%s\n",
4451 w, cc_dur, ctx->spawned, cw_found, atomic_load(&ctx->dmax), atomic_load(&ctx->dmin),
4452 tstamp_at(ctx->p, t_round_end - ctx->start_time).s);
4453 }
4454 ctx_stop(ctx, STOP_CC_FOUND);
4455 break;
4456 } else {
4457 if (!round_completed) {
4458 break;
4459 }
4460 const double t_now = t_round_end - ctx->start_time;
4461 if (certified) {
4462 /* Weight w analyzed without success */
4463 const int new_dmin = ctx->even_weight_only ? w + 2 : w + 1;
4464 atomic_store(&ctx->dmin, new_dmin);
4465 res_event_ctx_at(ctx, t_now);
4466 if (ctx->p->debug & DBG_PROGRESS) {
4467 fprintf(stderr, "# CC w=%d completed in %.3fs (%d CC threads): no codewords found -> dmin=%d%s\n",
4468 w, cc_dur, ctx->spawned, new_dmin, tstamp_at(ctx->p, t_now).s);
4469 }
4470 } else if (ctx->p->debug & DBG_PROGRESS) {
4471 fprintf(stderr, "# CC w=%d completed in %.3fs (%d CC threads): no codewords found "
4472 "(dmin=%d not raised: lower weights not scanned)%s\n",
4473 w, cc_dur, ctx->spawned, atomic_load(&ctx->dmin), tstamp_at(ctx->p, t_now).s);
4474 }
4475 }
4476 }
4477}
4478
4479/* Method 3: RW still runs (RW threads, RW steps not all completed, RW not stopped by min_hits) */
4480static inline bool m3_rw_running(distfork_ctx_t * const ctx) {
4481 return ctx->rw_threads > 0 && !atomic_load(&ctx->rw_stop_flag) &&
4482 atomic_load(&ctx->rw_steps_completed) < ctx->total_rw_steps;
4483}
4484
4485/* Method 3: RW thread time per step, measured continuously by the RW workers (before the first step is completed, a
4486 * step takes at least the time elapsed since the start) */
4487static double m3_rw_step_time(distfork_ctx_t * const ctx) {
4488 const long n = atomic_load(&ctx->rw_timed_steps);
4489 if (n > 0) return 1e-9 * (double)atomic_load(&ctx->rw_busy_ns) / (double)n;
4490 const double elapsed = get_time_sec() - ctx->start_time;
4491 return (elapsed > 5e-5) ? elapsed : 5e-5;
4492}
4493
4494/* Method 3: the largest CC weight needed: t-1 once the target t is known, i.e., the upper bound dmax or the stop
4495 * target dstop if smaller (with outC, t+dW: the rounds w = t..t+dW enumerate the codewords to export), otherwise wmax
4496 * (or n); at most MAX_W-2. (`dexp` only affects the thread split, see m3_plan_cc_threads().) */
4497static int m3_cc_target_w(const distfork_ctx_t * const ctx, const int cur_dmin, const int cur_dmax) {
4498 const params_t * const p = ctx->p;
4499 const int t = ctx_target(ctx, cur_dmax);
4500 int target;
4501 if (t > 0) {
4502 if (p->outC && (p->dW > 0 || cur_dmin >= t)) {
4503 target = t + (p->dW > 0 ? p->dW : 0);
4504 } else {
4505 target = t - 1;
4506 }
4507 } else {
4508 target = (p->wmax > 0) ? p->wmax : p->spaH->cols;
4509 }
4510 const int max_allowed_w = (p->wmax > 0) ? minint(p->wmax, MAX_W - 2) : (MAX_W - 2);
4511 int res = minint(target, max_allowed_w);
4512 if (ctx->even_weight_only && (res & 1)) res--;
4513 return res;
4514}
4515
4516#define M3_DEADLINE_FRACTION 0.75 /* with a timeout, a round gets enough CC threads to finish in 3/4 of the time left */
4517#define M3_OVERRUN_FACTOR 1.5 /* a round taking 1.5 times (+20 ms) longer than predicted gets all threads */
4518
4519/* Method 3: number of CC threads for the round at weight w with the estimated work `est` (thread-seconds, 0 if not
4520 * known) and the growth factor `growth` (see cc_work_estimate()); the other threads run RW. Returns 0 if CC is
4521 * paused (`dexp`, below). */
4522static int m3_plan_cc_threads(distfork_ctx_t * const ctx, const int w, const double est, const double growth,
4523 const double remaining_time) {
4524 const int nthr = ctx->num_threads;
4525 if (nthr <= 1) return 1;
4526 /* RW finished, or all RW steps claimed: the RW workers join the round anyway (a worker which still has steps of its
4527 * batch runs them first, see rw_yield_to_cc()) */
4528 if (!m3_rw_running(ctx) || atomic_load(&ctx->rw_steps_started) >= ctx->total_rw_steps) return nthr;
4529 const int cur_dmin = atomic_load(&ctx->dmin);
4530 const int cur_dmax = atomic_load(&ctx->dmax);
4531 /* The round w = t-1 certifies dmin = t (t: dmax, or the stop target dstop if smaller; later rounds only collect
4532 * codewords). RW cannot improve this result, it could only find a codeword of weight w before CC does: all threads
4533 * run CC. */
4534 const int t = ctx_target(ctx, cur_dmax);
4535 const int cert_w = ctx->even_weight_only ? (t - ((t & 1) ? 1 : 2)) : (t - 1);
4536 if (t > 0 && (w >= cert_w || cur_dmin >= t)) return nthr;
4537 /* `dexp` hint: as long as RW has not found any codeword, CC rounds w > dexp run only on the threads which cannot
4538 * run RW (none: CC pauses) */
4539 if (cur_dmax == 0 && ctx->dexp > 0 && w > ctx->dexp) return nthr - ctx->rw_threads;
4540
4541 int n_cc;
4542 if (!(est > 0.0)) {
4543 n_cc = nthr / 2; /* the first round at a supplied dmin: its work is not known */
4544 } else if (est < 0.005) {
4545 n_cc = (nthr >= 4) ? 2 : 1;
4546 } else {
4547 /* Split by the remaining work in thread-seconds: the CC rounds w, w+1, w+2 up to the horizon (dmax-1, or dexp
4548 * before RW has found a codeword), and the remaining RW steps (at most 2000 once dmax is known), but not more RW
4549 * work than the RW threads can do before the timeout */
4550 int horizon = m3_cc_target_w(ctx, cur_dmin, cur_dmax);
4551 if (cur_dmax == 0 && ctx->dexp > 0 && ctx->dexp < horizon) horizon = ctx->dexp;
4552 double t_cc = est, t_k = est;
4553 const int step = ctx->even_weight_only ? 2 : 1;
4554 for (int k = w + step; k <= horizon && k <= w + 2 * step; k += step) {
4555 t_k *= growth;
4556 t_cc += t_k;
4557 }
4558 const long steps_rem = ctx->total_rw_steps - atomic_load(&ctx->rw_steps_completed);
4559 const long eff_steps = (cur_dmax > 0 && steps_rem > 2000) ? 2000 : steps_rem;
4560 double t_rw = (double)eff_steps * m3_rw_step_time(ctx);
4561 if (ctx->timeout > 0.0 && t_rw > remaining_time * ctx->rw_threads) t_rw = remaining_time * ctx->rw_threads;
4562 n_cc = (int)round((double)nthr * t_cc / (t_cc + t_rw));
4563 if (n_cc < 1) n_cc = 1;
4564 if (n_cc > nthr - 1) n_cc = nthr - 1; /* keep at least one RW thread */
4565 }
4566 /* timeout: enough CC threads to finish the round in time */
4567 if (ctx->timeout > 0.0 && est > 0.0 && remaining_time > 0.0) {
4568 const double n_min = ceil(est / (M3_DEADLINE_FRACTION * remaining_time));
4569 if (n_min > n_cc) n_cc = (n_min < nthr) ? (int)n_min : nthr;
4570 }
4571 /* only `rw_threads` workers can run RW (memory / steps limits): the other workers always run CC */
4572 if (nthr - n_cc > ctx->rw_threads) n_cc = nthr - ctx->rw_threads;
4573 return n_cc;
4574}
4575
4576/* Method 3: wait while RW runs, until the upper bound dmax differs from `dmax0`, RW ends, or the run stops; `why`:
4577 * the reason why no CC round runs, for the status line */
4578static void m3_wait_rw(distfork_ctx_t * const ctx, const int dmax0, const char * const why) {
4579 ctx->cc_idle = why;
4580 while (!atomic_load(&ctx->stop_flag) && m3_rw_running(ctx) && atomic_load(&ctx->dmax) == dmax0) {
4581 if (ctx->timeout > 0.0 && (get_time_sec() - ctx->start_time >= ctx->timeout)) {
4582 ctx_stop(ctx, STOP_TIMEOUT);
4583 break;
4584 }
4585 ctx_status(ctx);
4586 usleep(1000);
4587 }
4588 ctx->cc_idle = NULL;
4589}
4590
4591/* Method 3 coordinator */
4592static void run_method3_coordinator(distfork_ctx_t *ctx) {
4593 const int nvar = ctx->p->spaH->cols;
4594 const int nthr = ctx->num_threads;
4595 int w = ctx->p->noscan ? ctx->p->wmax : (ctx->p->dmin > 1 ? ctx->p->dmin : 1);
4596
4597 int init_dmax = atomic_load(&ctx->dmax);
4598 int init_dmin = atomic_load(&ctx->dmin);
4599 if (init_dmax > 0 && init_dmin >= init_dmax && !ctx->p->outC) {
4600 ctx_stop(ctx, STOP_BOUNDS);
4601 return;
4602 }
4603
4604 /* No RW probe: the RW step time is measured continuously by the RW workers (m3_rw_step_time()). CC is never ended
4605 * while RW still runs: if no CC round can be started (CC done up to wmax, a round predicted to exceed the timeout,
4606 * or CC paused by `dexp`), the coordinator waits for RW and re-plans when dmax changes or RW ends. */
4607 int wait_msg_w = 0; /* weight w for which a waiting message was printed (once per round) */
4608 while (!atomic_load(&ctx->stop_flag)) {
4609 if (ctx->even_weight_only && (w & 1)) {
4610 if (w == atomic_load(&ctx->dmin)) {
4611 atomic_store(&ctx->dmin, w + 1);
4612 res_event_ctx(ctx);
4613 }
4614 w++;
4615 continue;
4616 }
4617 double now = get_time_sec();
4618 double remaining_time = (ctx->timeout > 0.0) ? (ctx->timeout - (now - ctx->start_time)) : 1e9;
4619 if (ctx->timeout > 0.0 && remaining_time <= 0.0) {
4620 ctx_stop(ctx, STOP_TIMEOUT);
4621 break;
4622 }
4623
4624 int cur_dmax = atomic_load(&ctx->dmax);
4625 int cur_dmin = atomic_load(&ctx->dmin);
4626 const bool rw_on = m3_rw_running(ctx);
4627
4628 /* Target cluster size for CC */
4629 const int target_cc_w = m3_cc_target_w(ctx, cur_dmin, cur_dmax);
4630
4631 if (cur_dmax > 0 && cur_dmin >= cur_dmax && w > target_cc_w) {
4632 /* Bracketing converged and all requested dW rounds completed */
4633 atomic_store(&ctx->dmin, cur_dmax);
4634 res_event_ctx_at(ctx, now - ctx->start_time);
4635 ctx_stop(ctx, (ctx->p->outC && w > cur_dmax) ? STOP_COLLECTED : STOP_BOUNDS);
4636 break;
4637 }
4638 if (ctx->p->dstop > 0 && cur_dmin >= ctx->p->dstop && w > target_cc_w) {
4639 /* The stop target dstop reached (with outC, after the rounds w = dstop..dstop+dW which collect codewords) */
4640 ctx_stop(ctx, STOP_DSTOP);
4641 break;
4642 }
4643
4644 if (w > target_cc_w) {
4645 /* CC done up to wmax: only RW can still lower dmax */
4646 if (!rw_on) {
4647 const int max_allowed_w = (ctx->p->wmax > 0) ? minint(ctx->p->wmax, MAX_W - 2) : (MAX_W - 2);
4648 ctx->stop_w = (ctx->even_weight_only && target_cc_w + 1 == max_allowed_w) ? max_allowed_w : target_cc_w;
4649 ctx_stop(ctx, STOP_CC_DONE);
4650 break;
4651 }
4652 if ((ctx->p->debug & DBG_TIMING) && wait_msg_w != w) {
4653 wait_msg_w = w;
4654 fprintf(stderr, "# CC done up to w=%d, waiting for RW (bounds [%d, %d])\n", target_cc_w, cur_dmin, cur_dmax);
4655 }
4656 m3_wait_rw(ctx, cur_dmax, "done up to wmax, waiting for RW");
4657 continue;
4658 }
4659
4660 /* Estimated CC work of the round (thread-seconds). A round predicted not to finish in time on all threads is not
4661 * started while RW runs; once RW has ended, the run ends. Without RW (steps=0), as in method 2, the round is
4662 * started anyway: it can still end early with a codeword of weight w (exact if w = dmin). */
4663 double growth;
4664 const double t_cc_est = cc_work_estimate(ctx, w, &growth);
4665 if (ctx->timeout > 0.0 && t_cc_est / nthr > remaining_time) {
4666 if (rw_on) {
4667 if ((ctx->p->debug & DBG_TIMING) && wait_msg_w != w) {
4668 wait_msg_w = w;
4669 fprintf(stderr, "# CC for w=%d (est %.2fs) exceeds remaining timeout %.2fs, devoting %d threads to RW\n",
4670 w, t_cc_est / nthr, remaining_time, ctx->rw_threads);
4671 }
4672 m3_wait_rw(ctx, cur_dmax, "round predicted to exceed the timeout, waiting for RW");
4673 continue;
4674 }
4675 if (ctx->rw_threads > 0) {
4676 if (ctx->p->debug & DBG_PROGRESS) {
4677 fprintf(stderr, "# CC for w=%d (est %.2fs) exceeds remaining timeout %.2fs, RW ended: terminating early "
4678 "(dmin=%d)%s\n", w, t_cc_est / nthr, remaining_time, cur_dmin,
4679 tstamp_at(ctx->p, now - ctx->start_time).s);
4680 }
4681 ctx->stop_w = w;
4682 ctx_stop(ctx, STOP_CC_SLOW);
4683 break;
4684 }
4685 if ((ctx->p->debug & DBG_PROGRESS) && wait_msg_w != w) {
4686 wait_msg_w = w;
4687 fprintf(stderr, "# CC for w=%d (est %.2fs) may not finish in the remaining time %.2fs, searching anyway "
4688 "(dmin=%d)%s\n", w, t_cc_est / nthr, remaining_time, cur_dmin,
4689 tstamp_at(ctx->p, now - ctx->start_time).s);
4690 }
4691 }
4692
4693 /* Calculate thread balancing */
4694 int n_cc = m3_plan_cc_threads(ctx, w, t_cc_est, growth, remaining_time);
4695 if (n_cc <= 0) {
4696 if ((ctx->p->debug & DBG_TIMING) && wait_msg_w != w) {
4697 wait_msg_w = w;
4698 fprintf(stderr, "# CC paused before w=%d > dexp=%d until RW finds a codeword (or ends)\n", w, ctx->dexp);
4699 }
4700 m3_wait_rw(ctx, cur_dmax, "paused (w > dexp) until RW finds a codeword");
4701 continue;
4702 }
4703 const int n_cc0 = n_cc;
4704 int n_rw = nthr - n_cc;
4705 const long steps_rem = rw_on ? ctx->total_rw_steps - atomic_load(&ctx->rw_steps_completed) : 0;
4706
4707 const int beg = cc_round_beg(ctx->p);
4708 const int end = cc_round_end(ctx->p, w);
4709 /* all weights below w analyzed (or a supplied dmin): a codeword of weight w found is exact */
4710 const bool certified = (w == atomic_load(&ctx->dmin));
4711 const int lev = cc_round_levels(ctx, w, beg, end, t_cc_est); /* fixed levels of the CC work units */
4712 const int last = cc_unit_last(ctx, w, lev);
4713
4714 atomic_store(&ctx->cc_target_workers, n_cc);
4715 const long long busy_ns0 = atomic_load(&ctx->cc_busy_ns);
4716 const long long nodes0 = atomic_load(&ctx->cc_nodes);
4717 const long rw_joins0 = atomic_load(&ctx->cc_rw_joins);
4718 atomic_store(&ctx->cc_next, cc_pack(w, lev, beg * ctx->cc_R[lev]));
4719 atomic_store(&ctx->cc_round_active, 1);
4720
4721 if (ctx->p->debug & DBG_TIMING) {
4722 char est_str[64] = "unknown";
4723 char rw_str[64] = "";
4724 char units[64] = "";
4725 if (t_cc_est > 0.0) snprintf(est_str, sizeof(est_str), "%.3g thread-s", t_cc_est);
4726 if (rw_on) snprintf(rw_str, sizeof(rw_str), ", RW step %.3g s", m3_rw_step_time(ctx));
4727 if (lev > 0) snprintf(units, sizeof(units), ", %d work units per start column", ctx->cc_R[lev]);
4728 fprintf(stderr,
4729 "# CC round w=%d started: %d CC threads, %d RW threads "
4730 "(bounds [%d, %d], rem_rw=%ld, rem_time=%.2fs, est %s%s%s)\n",
4731 w, n_cc, n_rw, cur_dmin, cur_dmax, steps_rem, remaining_time, est_str, rw_str, units);
4732 }
4733
4734 double cc_start = get_time_sec();
4735 bool round_completed = false;
4736 int dmax_seen = cur_dmax;
4737 unsigned int poll = 0;
4738 ctx->round_open = 1;
4739 ctx->round_w = w;
4740 ctx->round_beg = beg;
4741 ctx->round_end = end;
4742 ctx->round_R = ctx->cc_R[lev];
4743 ctx->round_threads = n_cc;
4744 ctx->round_t0 = cc_start;
4745 ctx->round_est = t_cc_est;
4746
4747 while (!atomic_load(&ctx->stop_flag)) {
4748 const double t = get_time_sec();
4749 if (ctx->timeout > 0.0 && (t - ctx->start_time >= ctx->timeout)) {
4750 ctx_stop(ctx, STOP_TIMEOUT);
4751 break;
4752 }
4753 if (cc_unpack_idx(atomic_load(&ctx->cc_next)) > last && atomic_load(&ctx->cc_active_workers) == 0) {
4754 round_completed = true;
4755 break;
4756 }
4757 /* Re-plan during the round (only adding CC threads, workers do not leave a round): when RW finds a new upper
4758 * bound (e.g., this round now certifies dmin = dmax), and when the round takes much longer than predicted */
4759 if ((++poll & 15) == 0 && n_cc < nthr) {
4760 int n_new = n_cc;
4761 const char *why = "";
4762 const int d_now = atomic_load(&ctx->dmax);
4763 if (d_now != dmax_seen) {
4764 dmax_seen = d_now;
4765 const double rem = (ctx->timeout > 0.0) ? ctx->timeout - (t - ctx->start_time) : 1e9;
4766 n_new = m3_plan_cc_threads(ctx, w, t_cc_est, growth, rem);
4767 why = "new upper bound";
4768 }
4769 const bool paused = (d_now == 0 && ctx->dexp > 0 && w > ctx->dexp && m3_rw_running(ctx));
4770 if (!paused && t_cc_est > 0.0 && t - cc_start > M3_OVERRUN_FACTOR * t_cc_est / n_cc0 + 0.02) {
4771 n_new = nthr;
4772 why = "longer than predicted";
4773 }
4774 if (n_new > n_cc) {
4775 if (ctx->p->debug & DBG_TIMING) {
4776 fprintf(stderr, "# CC round w=%d: %d -> %d CC threads (%s, bounds [%d, %d], %.3fs into the round)\n",
4777 w, n_cc, n_new, why, atomic_load(&ctx->dmin), d_now, t - cc_start);
4778 }
4779 n_cc = n_new;
4780 n_rw = nthr - n_cc;
4781 ctx->round_threads = n_cc;
4782 atomic_store(&ctx->cc_target_workers, n_cc);
4783 }
4784 }
4785 ctx_status(ctx);
4786 usleep(100);
4787 }
4788
4789 atomic_store(&ctx->cc_round_active, 0);
4790 if (round_completed) ctx->round_open = 0;
4791
4792 const double t_round_end = get_time_sec();
4793 double cc_dur = t_round_end - cc_start;
4794 const double cc_work_meas = 1e-9 * (double)(atomic_load(&ctx->cc_busy_ns) - busy_ns0);
4795 const long long cc_nodes_meas = atomic_load(&ctx->cc_nodes) - nodes0;
4796 if (w < MAX_W) {
4797 /* CC work of the round in thread-seconds, as measured by the workers: the number of CC threads may exceed
4798 * n_cc (CC-only workers, and RW workers that ran out of RW steps join the round) */
4799 ctx->cc_time_per_weight[w] = cc_work_meas;
4800 if ((ctx->p->debug & DBG_TIMING) && round_completed) {
4801 char est_str[48] = "unknown";
4802 if (t_cc_est > 0.0) snprintf(est_str, sizeof(est_str), "%.3g thread-s", t_cc_est);
4803 fprintf(stderr, "# CC round w=%d work: %.3g thread-s measured, %s predicted (%.3fs, %d CC threads at the "
4804 "end), %lld nodes\n", w, ctx->cc_time_per_weight[w], est_str, cc_dur, n_cc, cc_nodes_meas);
4805 }
4806 }
4807 res_round_add(w, busy_ns0, nodes0, cc_work_meas, cc_dur, cc_nodes_meas, n_cc, round_completed);
4808 const long rw_joins = atomic_load(&ctx->cc_rw_joins) - rw_joins0;
4809 if ((ctx->p->debug & DBG_TIMING) && rw_joins > 0) { /* (see rw_yield_to_cc()) */
4810 fprintf(stderr, "# CC round w=%d: joined by %ld RW threads which left their RW batch between two steps\n", w,
4811 rw_joins);
4812 }
4813
4814 const double t_now = t_round_end - ctx->start_time;
4815 int cw_found = atomic_load(&ctx->cc_found_weight);
4816 if (cw_found > 0 && certified && cw_found == w && !atomic_load(&ctx->cc_exact)) {
4817 atomic_store(&ctx->cc_exact, true);
4818 }
4819 const bool exact = (cw_found > 0) && atomic_load(&ctx->cc_exact);
4820 if (exact) {
4821 atomic_store(&ctx->dmin, cw_found);
4822 atomic_store(&ctx->dmax, cw_found);
4823 res_event_ctx_at(ctx, t_now);
4824
4825 int max_w_lim = minint(ctx->p->wmax > 0 ? ctx->p->wmax : nvar, cw_found + ctx->p->dW);
4826 if (ctx->p->dstop > 0 && ctx->p->dstop < cw_found) {
4827 /* a stop target dstop below the distance: the codewords of weight up to dstop + dW only (as in method 2) */
4828 max_w_lim = minint(max_w_lim, ctx->p->dstop + (ctx->p->dW > 0 ? ctx->p->dW : 0));
4829 }
4830 if (ctx->even_weight_only && (max_w_lim & 1)) max_w_lim--;
4831 if (ctx->p->outC && ctx->p->dW > 0 && w < max_w_lim) {
4832 if (ctx->p->debug & DBG_PROGRESS) {
4833 const tstamp_t ts = tstamp_at(ctx->p, t_now);
4834 if (w == cw_found) {
4835 fprintf(stderr,
4836 "# CC round w=%d finished in %.3fs (%d CC threads, %d RW threads): found codewords "
4837 "(dmin=%d, continuing up to w=%d for dW=%d, total %lld cws)%s\n",
4838 w, cc_dur, n_cc, n_rw, cw_found, max_w_lim, ctx->p->dW, ctx_num_cws(ctx), ts.s);
4839 } else if (round_completed) {
4840 fprintf(stderr,
4841 "# CC round w=%d finished in %.3fs (%d CC threads, %d RW threads): "
4842 "extra dW round completed (dmin=%d, total %lld cws)%s\n",
4843 w, cc_dur, n_cc, n_rw, cw_found, ctx_num_cws(ctx), ts.s);
4844 }
4845 }
4846 } else {
4847 if (ctx->p->debug & DBG_PROGRESS) {
4848 const tstamp_t ts = tstamp_at(ctx->p, t_now);
4849 if (w > cw_found) {
4850 if (round_completed) {
4851 fprintf(stderr,
4852 "# CC round w=%d finished in %.3fs (%d CC threads, %d RW threads): "
4853 "extra dW round completed (dmin=%d, total %lld cws)%s\n",
4854 w, cc_dur, n_cc, n_rw, cw_found, ctx_num_cws(ctx), ts.s);
4855 }
4856 } else {
4857 fprintf(stderr, "# CC found min-weight codeword: d=%d (using %d CC threads, total %lld cws)%s\n",
4858 cw_found, n_cc, ctx_num_cws(ctx), ts.s);
4859 }
4860 }
4861 /* (a stop reason recorded during the round, e.g., the timeout, is kept) */
4862 ctx_stop(ctx, (ctx->p->outC || ctx->p->maxC > 0) ? STOP_COLLECTED : STOP_CC_FOUND);
4863 break;
4864 }
4865 } else if (cur_dmax > 0 && cur_dmin >= cur_dmax) {
4866 /* Extra dW round completed */
4867 if (round_completed && (ctx->p->debug & DBG_PROGRESS)) {
4868 fprintf(stderr,
4869 "# CC round w=%d finished in %.3fs (%d CC threads, %d RW threads): "
4870 "extra dW round completed (dmin=%d, total %lld cws)%s\n",
4871 w, cc_dur, n_cc, n_rw, cur_dmin, ctx_num_cws(ctx), tstamp_at(ctx->p, t_now).s);
4872 }
4873 if (!round_completed) {
4874 break;
4875 }
4876 } else {
4877 if (!round_completed) {
4878 break;
4879 }
4880
4881 /* Weight w analyzed without success */
4882 int new_dmin = ctx->even_weight_only ? w + 2 : w + 1;
4883 atomic_store(&ctx->dmin, new_dmin);
4884 res_event_ctx_at(ctx, t_now);
4885 if (ctx->p->debug & DBG_PROGRESS) {
4886 fprintf(stderr, "# CC round w=%d finished in %.3fs (%d CC threads, %d RW threads): no codewords -> dmin=%d%s\n",
4887 w, cc_dur, n_cc, n_rw, new_dmin, tstamp_at(ctx->p, t_now).s);
4888 }
4889
4890 cur_dmax = atomic_load(&ctx->dmax);
4891 if (cur_dmax > 0 && new_dmin >= cur_dmax) {
4892 atomic_store(&ctx->dmin, cur_dmax);
4893 res_event_ctx_at(ctx, t_now);
4894 /* with outC, the CC rounds w = dmax..dmax+dW enumerate all codewords to export (RW may have missed some) */
4895 const int w_last = ctx->p->outC ? m3_cc_target_w(ctx, cur_dmax, cur_dmax) : 0;
4896 if (w_last > w) {
4897 if (ctx->p->debug & DBG_PROGRESS) {
4898 fprintf(stderr, "# bracketing bounds coincide: dmin = dmax = %d (continuing up to w=%d for dW=%d to export "
4899 "codewords)%s\n", cur_dmax, w_last, ctx->p->dW > 0 ? ctx->p->dW : 0, tstamp_at(ctx->p, t_now).s);
4900 }
4901 } else {
4902 ctx_stop(ctx, STOP_BOUNDS);
4903 if (ctx->p->debug & DBG_PROGRESS) {
4904 fprintf(stderr, "# bracketing bounds coincide: dmin = dmax = %d%s\n", cur_dmax, tstamp_at(ctx->p, t_now).s);
4905 }
4906 break;
4907 }
4908 } else if (ctx->p->dstop > 0 && new_dmin >= ctx->p->dstop) {
4909 /* the stop target dstop reached: no codeword of weight < dstop (RW may still find heavier codewords, but they
4910 * are not needed); with outC, the CC rounds w = dstop..dstop+dW collect codewords first */
4911 const int w_last = ctx->p->outC ? m3_cc_target_w(ctx, new_dmin, cur_dmax) : 0;
4912 if (w_last > w) {
4913 if (ctx->p->debug & DBG_PROGRESS) {
4914 fprintf(stderr, "# lower bound dmin=%d reached dstop=%d (continuing up to w=%d for dW=%d to export "
4915 "codewords)%s\n", new_dmin, ctx->p->dstop, w_last, ctx->p->dW > 0 ? ctx->p->dW : 0,
4916 tstamp_at(ctx->p, t_now).s);
4917 }
4918 } else {
4919 ctx_stop(ctx, STOP_DSTOP);
4920 if (ctx->p->debug & DBG_PROGRESS) {
4921 fprintf(stderr, "# lower bound dmin=%d reached dstop=%d%s\n", new_dmin, ctx->p->dstop,
4922 tstamp_at(ctx->p, t_now).s);
4923 }
4924 break;
4925 }
4926 }
4927 }
4928
4929 w++;
4930 }
4931}
4932
4933/* Default number of worker threads: the logical CPUs the process may run on, i.e., its CPU affinity mask (`taskset`,
4934 * cpusets) on Linux, otherwise the online CPUs (4 if not known). CPU quotas (e.g., `docker --cpus`) are not seen. */
4935static int available_cpus(void) {
4936#ifdef __linux__
4937 cpu_set_t set;
4938 CPU_ZERO(&set);
4939 if (sched_getaffinity(0, sizeof(set), &set) == 0) { /* fails with more than CPU_SETSIZE (1024) CPUs */
4940 const int cnt = CPU_COUNT(&set);
4941 if (cnt > 0) return cnt;
4942 }
4943#endif
4944 const long nprocs = sysconf(_SC_NPROCESSORS_ONLN);
4945 return (nprocs > 0) ? (int)nprocs : 4;
4946}
4947
4948/* The physical memory in bytes (0 if not known) */
4949static unsigned long long physical_memory_bytes(void) {
4950#if defined(_SC_PHYS_PAGES) && defined(_SC_PAGESIZE)
4951 const long pages = sysconf(_SC_PHYS_PAGES), psize = sysconf(_SC_PAGESIZE);
4952 if (pages > 0 && psize > 0) return (unsigned long long)pages * (unsigned long long)psize;
4953#endif
4954 return 0;
4955}
4956
4957/* Maximum number of RW workers for thread throttling (all workers in method 1, the RW share in method 3):
4958 * - dense memory: a full-matrix RW worker holds dense copies of H (m x n) and of its transpose (n x m), a worker
4959 * with ksub > 0 only the sampled subspace matrix (ksub x n). Above 15 MB per worker, RW is limited by the memory
4960 * bandwidth: the throughput peaks at 32-64 RW workers whatever the matrix size (e.g., 32 with 49 MB per worker,
4961 * 32-64 with 0.43 GB). Then at most 32 workers run RW, with their dense matrices in a quarter of the physical memory
4962 * (but at least 2 workers; 1.5 GB if the physical memory is not known);
4963 * - small step counts: at most ceil(steps/10) RW workers. */
4964static int rw_thread_cap(const params_t * const p) {
4965 int cap = INT_MAX;
4966 const int nvar = p->nvar;
4967 const int nrows = p->spaH ? p->spaH->rows : 0;
4968 if (nrows > 0 && nvar > 0) {
4969 const size_t words_n = ((size_t)nvar + 63) / 64;
4970 size_t dense_bytes_per_thread;
4971 if (p->ksub > 0) {
4972 dense_bytes_per_thread = (size_t)minint(p->ksub, nrows) * words_n * 8;
4973 } else if (p->rw_active & RW_OPT_DUAL) {
4974 /* rw_opt, Stage 4: the m x m inverse and its transpose, and the columns of the pairs (about a quarter of the
4975 * transposed matrix, n x m bits) instead of the dense matrix and its transpose */
4976 const size_t words_m = ((size_t)nrows + 63) / 64;
4977 dense_bytes_per_thread = 2 * (size_t)nrows * words_m * 8 + (size_t)nvar * words_m * 2;
4978 } else {
4979 dense_bytes_per_thread = (size_t)nrows * words_n * 8 + (size_t)nvar * (((size_t)nrows + 63) / 64) * 8;
4980 }
4981 if (dense_bytes_per_thread > 15ULL * 1024 * 1024) {
4982 const unsigned long long ram = physical_memory_bytes();
4983 const unsigned long long budget = ram ? ram / 4 : 1536ULL * 1024 * 1024;
4984 const unsigned long long max_mem_threads = budget / dense_bytes_per_thread;
4985 cap = (max_mem_threads < 2) ? 2 : ((max_mem_threads > 32) ? 32 : (int)max_mem_threads);
4986 }
4987 }
4988 if (p->steps > 0) {
4989 const int max_step_threads = (int)(((long)p->steps + 9) / 10);
4990 cap = minint(cap, max_step_threads);
4991 }
4992 return cap;
4993}
4994
4995/* The budget of hash probes of the enumeration of T_3 (Lemma 1 of doc/rw_triplet_degeneracies.tex: the pairs of
4996 * columns with the same smallest row), about one second; with more, Stage 1 is skipped */
4997#define RW_T3_BUDGET 50000000LL
4998
4999/* The largest number of codewords added by the expansion of rw_opt bit 32 (see rw_t3_expand()) */
5000#define RW_EXPAND_MAX (1LL << 22)
5001
5002/* The RW stages of rw_opt which apply to the input (before Stage 1, see rw_stages_setup()), only for full-matrix RW
5003 * (method 1 or 3, steps > 0, ksub=0): with rw_opt=-1, by the dispatch rules D1-D5 of doc/rw_triplet_degeneracies.tex
5004 * (Sec. 9), not for runs of at most 2 steps; with a bitmask, the stages given whose input is there (e.g., finG for
5005 * Stage 2b, a DEM for Stage 3, at most 64 rows of L for Stage 4, outC or maxC for bit 32). */
5006static int rw_stages_plan(const params_t * const p) {
5007 if (p->rw_opt == 0 || !(p->method & 1) || p->steps <= 0 || p->ksub > 0 || !p->spaH) return 0;
5008 const bool expl = (p->rw_opt > 0);
5009 if (!expl && p->steps <= 2) return 0;
5010 const int want = expl ? p->rw_opt : RW_OPT_ALL;
5011 const int m = p->spaH->rows, n = p->spaH->cols;
5012 const bool quantum = !p->classical && p->maskL;
5013 int act = 0;
5014 if ((want & RW_OPT_T3) && quantum) act |= RW_OPT_T3; /* D1: always enumerate (nothing is kept if T_3 is empty) */
5015 if ((want & RW_OPT_GEN) && quantum && p->spaG && expl) act |= RW_OPT_GEN; /* D2: no wall-clock gain measured */
5016 /* D4, row slabs: explicit, or automatic for a DEM with a single round (dem_rounds=1) or without round structure
5017 * (and m <= RW_SLAB_AUTO_MMAX, see rw_slab_auto()), whose boundary slabs are its two detector layers: they reach the
5018 * codewords confined to one layer, e.g., the weight-16 codewords of the double-gross DEM with one round, which the
5019 * uniform steps and the index windows hardly find (the row-slab study); on the window steps of deep DEMs (m >= 600,
5020 * three rounds or more), the slabs found fewer minimum-weight codewords per second than the index windows with the
5021 * contraction of Stage 2 (0.43x on shyps_225, 0.6x on gross_144 circuit DEMs, and no distance on a repetition-code
5022 * DEM with d=51) */
5023 if ((want & RW_OPT_SLAB) && rw_slab_input(p, expl)) act |= RW_OPT_SLAB;
5024 if ((want & RW_OPT_DUAL) && quantum && p->maskL->kw == 1) { /* D4: the dense m x n matrix spills L2 */
5025 const double dense = (double)m * (double)((n + 63) / 64) * 8.0;
5026 if (expl || (dense > 512.0 * 1024.0 && ((double)n >= 20.0 * m || m >= 1400))) act |= RW_OPT_DUAL;
5027 }
5028 if ((want & RW_OPT_CANON) && (quantum || expl) && p->kwin <= 0 && p->min_hits > 0) act |= RW_OPT_CANON; /* D5 */
5029 if ((want & RW_OPT_EXPAND) && quantum && (p->outC || p->maxC > 0)) act |= RW_OPT_EXPAND;
5030 return act;
5031}
5032
5033/* The sources of the hits counted for the `min_hits` statistic <n> (codeword_hit_stats(); p->nhits_src, a bitmask of
5034 * 1 << CW_SRC_*), once the RW stages are resolved (p->rw_active). With RW stages (a nonzero resolved rw_opt), not the
5035 * hits of the row slabs of Stage 3 and of the window steps (the hybrid index windows), which find the same codewords
5036 * over and over (the row-slab study: the vector rule stopped with 41-89% of the codewords found when it counted them,
5037 * 99% without), but the window hits when every RW step has a window (kwin > 0: no uniform steps, so that min_hits can
5038 * stop RW); without RW stages (rw_opt=0, or an automatic rw_opt which resolves to 0, e.g., for a classical code), all
5039 * hits, as in version 0.16.1. The hits of the uniform steps, of CC, and of finC always count. */
5040static int rw_nhits_sources(const params_t * const p) {
5041 if (p->rw_active == 0) return CW_SRC_ALL;
5042 int src = CW_SRC_ALL & ~(1 << CW_SRC_RW_SLAB);
5043 if (!(p->kwin > 0 && p->kwin < p->spaH->cols)) src &= ~(1 << CW_SRC_RW_WINDOW);
5044 return src;
5045}
5046
5047/* Stage 1 of rw_opt and the tables of the RW stages, on the matrix that RW searches (after merge and drop), before the
5048 * run: the Zobrist values of the columns, T_3 (the codewords of weight 1 of the pure-logical columns are recorded), and
5049 * the rows of G; the stages which cannot run are removed from p->rw_active */
5050static void rw_stages_setup(params_t * const p, const csr_t * const HT, rw_t3_t ** const t3p, rw_gdb_t ** const gdbp,
5051 uint64_t ** const zcolp) {
5052 const bool quantum = !p->classical && p->maskL;
5053 *zcolp = rw_zobrist_cols(p->spaH->cols);
5054 if ((p->rw_active & (RW_OPT_T3 | RW_OPT_SLAB | RW_OPT_CANON | RW_OPT_EXPAND)) && quantum) {
5055 rw_t3_t * const t3 = rw_t3_build(HT, p->spaH->rows, p->maskL, RW_T3_BUDGET);
5056 *t3p = t3;
5057 if (!t3->complete) {
5058 p->rw_active &= ~(RW_OPT_T3 | RW_OPT_EXPAND);
5059 if ((p->debug & DBG_SUMMARY) && (t3->probes > RW_T3_BUDGET))
5060 fprintf(stderr, "# Note: RW triplets (rw_opt) not enumerated: %lld hash probes needed (more than %lld), no "
5061 "contraction\n", t3->probes, RW_T3_BUDGET);
5062 else if (p->debug & DBG_SUMMARY) /* (see rw_t3_build()) */
5063 fprintf(stderr, "# Note: RW triplets (rw_opt) not kept: too many for the tables (6 |T3| > 2^30), no "
5064 "contraction\n");
5065 }
5066 if ((p->rw_active & RW_OPT_T3) && t3->npure > 0) { /* the pure-logical columns: codewords of weight 1 */
5067 for (int i = 0; i < t3->npure; i++) p->codewords = codeword_add_maybe(p, &t3->pure[i], 1, CW_SRC_OTHER);
5068 if (p->debug & DBG_SUMMARY)
5069 fprintf(stderr, "# RW triplets: %d zero columns of H with a nonzero column of L (codewords of weight 1)\n",
5070 t3->npure);
5071 }
5072 }
5073 if ((p->rw_active & (RW_OPT_GEN | RW_OPT_CANON)) && p->spaG && quantum) *gdbp = rw_gdb_build(p->spaG, *zcolp);
5074 if (!*gdbp) p->rw_active &= ~RW_OPT_GEN;
5075}
5076
5077/* DBG_PROGRESS: the run plan (method, threads, RW steps, CC weights, timeout, rng seed) */
5078static void print_run_plan(const distfork_ctx_t * const ctx, const int init_dmax) {
5079 const params_t * const p = ctx->p;
5080 fprintf(stderr, "# run plan: method=%d (%s), %d threads", p->method,
5081 (p->method == 1) ? "RW" : ((p->method == 2) ? "CC" : "bracketing"), ctx->num_threads);
5082 if (ctx->spawn_initial < ctx->num_threads) fprintf(stderr, " (%d at first)", ctx->spawn_initial);
5083 if (p->method == 3) fprintf(stderr, " (RW on up to %d)", ctx->rw_threads);
5084 if ((p->method & 1) && ctx->rw_threads > 0) {
5085 fprintf(stderr, ", steps=%ld, min_hits=%d, ksub=%d", ctx->total_rw_steps, p->min_hits, p->ksub);
5086 if (p->rw_opt != 0) fprintf(stderr, ", rw_opt=0x%x", (unsigned int)ctx->rw_active);
5087 if ((ctx->rw_active & RW_OPT_SLAB) && p->rw_opt < 0) { /* (the automatic row slabs, see rw_slab_auto()) */
5088 if (p->dem_rounds == 1)
5089 fprintf(stderr, " (row slabs: dem_rounds=1)");
5090 else
5091 fprintf(stderr, " (row slabs: no round structure, m <= %d)", RW_SLAB_AUTO_MMAX);
5092 }
5093 if (p->rw_active != 0 && p->ksub <= 0 && p->kwin == 0 && p->nvar >= 500 && !rw_hybrid_on(p, p->nvar))
5094 fprintf(stderr, " (matrices with rw_opt != 0: no hybrid windows)"); /* (Rule D3, on the resolved mask) */
5095 }
5096 if (p->method & 2) {
5097 fprintf(stderr, ", CC from w=%d", p->noscan ? p->wmax : (p->dmin > 1 ? p->dmin : 1));
5098 if (p->wmax > 0) fprintf(stderr, " to wmax=%d", p->wmax);
5099 if (p->smax == 0) fprintf(stderr, " (cc_prune=%d)", p->cc_prune);
5100 if (p->method == 3 && ctx->dexp > 0) fprintf(stderr, ", dexp=%d", ctx->dexp);
5101 }
5102 if (init_dmax > 0) fprintf(stderr, ", dmax=%d", init_dmax);
5103 if (p->dstop > 0) fprintf(stderr, ", dstop=%d", p->dstop);
5104 if (ctx->timeout > 0.0) fprintf(stderr, ", timeout=%gs", ctx->timeout);
5105 else fprintf(stderr, ", no timeout");
5106 fprintf(stderr, ", seed=%d%s\n", p->seed, tstamp_now(ctx).s);
5107}
