5109/* Stable machine-readable token for `ctx->stop_reason` (schema "dm4ri-result/1") */
5110static const char *stop_code_str(const int reason) {
5111 switch (reason) {
5112 case STOP_BOUNDS: return "bounds";
5113 case STOP_CC_FOUND: return "cc_found";
5114 case STOP_RW_CONVERGED: return "rw_converged";
5115 case STOP_RW_STEPS: return "rw_steps";
5116 case STOP_TIMEOUT: return "timeout";
5117 case STOP_CC_DONE: return "cc_done";
5118 case STOP_CC_SLOW: return "cc_slow";
5119 case STOP_WMIN: return "wmin";
5120 case STOP_MAXC: return "maxc";
5121 case STOP_COLLECTED: return "collected";
5122 case STOP_DSTOP: return "dstop";
5123 case STOP_K0: return "k0";
5124 default: return "none";
5125 }
5126}
5127
5128/* Format why the run ended (see ctx_stop()) into `buf`, used by print_stop_reason() and the JSON summary */
5129static void format_stop_text(distfork_ctx_t * const ctx, const int final_dmax, const bool cc_exact,
5130 char * const buf, const size_t cap) {
5131 params_t * const p = ctx->p;
5132 const int cc_found = atomic_load(&ctx->cc_found_weight);
5133 const bool rw_ran = (p->method & 1) && ctx->rw_threads > 0;
5134 size_t len = 0;
5135#define STOP_APPEND(...) \
5136 do { \
5137 if (len < cap) { \
5138 const int n_ = snprintf(buf + len, cap - len, __VA_ARGS__); \
5139 if (n_ > 0) len += ((size_t)n_ < cap - len) ? (size_t)n_ : (cap - len - 1); \
5140 } \
5141 } while (0)
5142 buf[0] = '\0';
5143 switch (atomic_load(&ctx->stop_reason)) {
5144 case STOP_BOUNDS:
5145 STOP_APPEND("bounds coincide: dmin = dmax = %d", final_dmax);
5146 break;
5147 case STOP_CC_FOUND:
5148 if (cc_exact)
5149 STOP_APPEND("CC found min-weight codeword: d=%d", cc_found);
5150 else
5151 STOP_APPEND("CC found a codeword of weight %d (upper bound only: lower weights not scanned)", cc_found);
5152 break;
5153 case STOP_RW_CONVERGED: {
5154 if (p->canon.active && !p->canon.full && p->canon.classes > 0) {
5155 STOP_APPEND("RW convergence reached (canonical classes: %.2f >= min_hits=%d step incidences per class, "
5156 "p_GT=%.3g, after %ld RW steps)", (double)p->canon.n_unif / (double)p->canon.classes, p->min_hits,
5157 (double)p->canon.f1 / (double)(p->canon.n_unif > 0 ? p->canon.n_unif : 1),
5158 atomic_load(&ctx->rw_steps_completed));
5159 break;
5160 }
5161 cw_hit_stats_t st;
5162 codeword_hit_stats(p, &st);
5163 STOP_APPEND("RW convergence reached (<n>=%.2f >= min_hits=%d after %ld RW steps)", st.avg, p->min_hits,
5164 atomic_load(&ctx->rw_steps_completed));
5165 break;
5166 }
5167 case STOP_RW_STEPS:
5168 STOP_APPEND("all %ld RW steps done", ctx->total_rw_steps);
5169 break;
5170 case STOP_TIMEOUT:
5171 STOP_APPEND("timeout=%gs reached", ctx->timeout);
5172 if (ctx->round_open)
5173 STOP_APPEND(" during CC round w=%d (%.1f%% of start columns claimed)", ctx->round_w, cc_round_claimed(ctx));
5174 if (rw_ran)
5175 STOP_APPEND(", %ld of %ld RW steps done", atomic_load(&ctx->rw_steps_completed), ctx->total_rw_steps);
5176 break;
5177 case STOP_CC_DONE:
5178 STOP_APPEND("CC done up to w=%d", ctx->stop_w);
5179 if (p->method == 3 && rw_ran) STOP_APPEND(", RW ended (%s)", rw_end_state(ctx));
5180 break;
5181 case STOP_CC_SLOW:
5182 STOP_APPEND("CC round w=%d predicted not to finish before the timeout, RW ended (%s)", ctx->stop_w,
5183 rw_end_state(ctx));
5184 break;
5185 case STOP_WMIN:
5186 STOP_APPEND("found a codeword of weight %d <= wmin=%d", final_dmax, p->wmin);
5187 break;
5188 case STOP_MAXC:
5189 STOP_APPEND("maxC=%lld codewords collected", p->maxC);
5190 break;
5191 case STOP_COLLECTED: {
5192 /* the collection rounds w = d..d+dW (with outC), but at most up to dstop+dW (a stop target dstop < d) and wmax */
5193 int w_hi = final_dmax;
5194 if (p->outC && p->dW > 0) {
5195 w_hi = final_dmax + p->dW;
5196 if (p->dstop > 0 && p->dstop < final_dmax) w_hi = minint(w_hi, p->dstop + p->dW);
5197 if (p->wmax > 0) w_hi = minint(w_hi, p->wmax);
5198 }
5199 STOP_APPEND("CC enumerated all codewords of weight %d", final_dmax);
5200 if (w_hi > final_dmax) STOP_APPEND("..%d", w_hi);
5201 if (p->outC) STOP_APPEND(" (for outC)");
5202 break;
5203 }
5204 case STOP_DSTOP:
5205 STOP_APPEND("lower bound dmin=%d reached dstop=%d", atomic_load(&ctx->dmin), p->dstop);
5206 break;
5207 case STOP_K0:
5208 STOP_APPEND("the rank check found k=0 (no logical codeword)");
5209 break;
5210 default:
5211 STOP_APPEND("search ended");
5212 }
5213#undef STOP_APPEND
5214}
5215
5216static void json_write_str(FILE * const f, const char * const s) {
5217 if (!s) {
5218 fputs("null", f);
5219 return;
5220 }
5221 fputc('"', f);
5222 for (const unsigned char *q = (const unsigned char *)s; *q; q++) {
5223 switch (*q) {
5224 case '"': fputs("\\\"", f); break;
5225 case '\\': fputs("\\\\", f); break;
5226 case '\b': fputs("\\b", f); break;
5227 case '\f': fputs("\\f", f); break;
5228 case '\n': fputs("\\n", f); break;
5229 case '\r': fputs("\\r", f); break;
5230 case '\t': fputs("\\t", f); break;
5231 default:
5232 if (*q < 0x20) fprintf(f, "\\u%04x", (unsigned int)*q);
5233 else fputc(*q, f);
5234 }
5235 }
5236 fputc('"', f);
5237}
5238
5239static void json_write_f6(FILE * const f, double x) {
5240 if (!isfinite(x) || x < 0.0) x = 0.0;
5241 fprintf(f, "%.6f", x);
5242}
5243
5244static void json_write_timeout(FILE * const f, const double x) {
5245 if (!isfinite(x) || x <= 0.0) fputc('0', f);
5246 else fprintf(f, "%.12g", x);
5247}
5248
5249static void res_write_json(FILE * const f, const params_t * const p, const res_summary_t * const s) {
5250 double t_ub = -1.0;
5251 double t_lb = 0.0;
5252 if (!s->k0 && s->dmax > 0) {
5253 for (int i = 0; i < res.nev; i++) {
5254 if (res.ev[i].ub == s->dmax) {
5255 t_ub = res.ev[i].t;
5256 break;
5257 }
5258 }
5259 if (t_ub < 0.0) t_ub = s->t_stop;
5260 }
5261 bool found_lb = false;
5262 for (int i = 0; i < res.nev; i++) {
5263 if (res.ev[i].lb == s->dmin) {
5264 t_lb = res.ev[i].t;
5265 found_lb = true;
5266 break;
5267 }
5268 }
5269 if (!found_lb) t_lb = s->t_stop;
5270
5271 fputs("{\"schema\":\"dm4ri-result/1\",\"version\":", f);
5272 json_write_str(f, DIST_M4RI_VERSION);
5273 fprintf(f, ",\"dmin\":%d,\"dmax\":%d,\"rw_steps\":%ld,\"k0\":%s,\"k0_reason\":",
5274 s->dmin, s->dmax, s->rw_steps, s->k0 ? "true" : "false");
5275 json_write_str(f, (s->k0 && p->k0_reason[0]) ? p->k0_reason : NULL);
5276 fprintf(f, ",\"search\":%s,\"stop\":{\"code\":", s->search ? "true" : "false");
5277 json_write_str(f, s->stop_code);
5278 fputs(",\"text\":", f);
5279 json_write_str(f, s->stop_text);
5280 fputs("},\"t_input\":", f);
5281 json_write_f6(f, s->t_input);
5282 fputs(",\"t_stop\":", f);
5283 json_write_f6(f, s->t_stop);
5284 fputs(",\"t_ub\":", f);
5285 if (t_ub >= 0.0) json_write_f6(f, t_ub);
5286 else fputs("null", f);
5287 fputs(",\"t_lb\":", f);
5288 json_write_f6(f, t_lb);
5289 fputs(",\"timeout\":", f);
5290 json_write_timeout(f, p->timeout);
5291 fprintf(f, ",\"seed\":%d,\"method\":%d,\"threads\":{\"requested\":%d,\"cpus\":%d,\"used\":%d,"
5292 "\"spawned\":%d,\"rw\":%d,\"cc\":%d},\"rw_opt\":%d,\"rw_opt_requested\":%d,\"rw_steps_done\":%ld,"
5293 "\"size\":{\"full\":[%d,%d],\"searched\":[%d,%d]},\"cc_rounds\":[",
5294 p->seed, p->method, s->req_threads, available_cpus(), s->used_threads, s->spawned_threads,
5295 s->rw_threads, s->cc_threads, s->rw_active, p->rw_opt, s->rw_steps_done,
5296 p->m_full, p->n_full, p->spaH ? p->spaH->rows : 0, p->spaH ? p->spaH->cols : 0);
5297 for (int i = 0; i < res.nrounds; i++) {
5298 const res_round_t * const r = &res.rounds[i];
5299 if (i > 0) fputc(',', f);
5300 fprintf(f, "{\"w\":%d,\"thread_s\":", r->w);
5301 json_write_f6(f, r->thread_s);
5302 fputs(",\"wall_s\":", f);
5303 json_write_f6(f, r->wall_s);
5304 fprintf(f, ",\"nodes\":%lld,\"threads\":%d,\"complete\":%s}",
5305 r->nodes, r->threads, r->complete ? "true" : "false");
5306 }
5307 fputs("],\"events\":[", f);
5308 for (int i = 0; i < res.nev; i++) {
5309 if (i > 0) fputc(',', f);
5310 fputc('[', f);
5311 json_write_f6(f, res.ev[i].t);
5312 fprintf(f, ",%d,%d]", res.ev[i].lb, res.ev[i].ub);
5313 }
5314 const bool has_wit = !s->k0 && (res.wit_w > 0) && (res.wit_cols != NULL);
5315 fprintf(f, "],\"witness\":{\"available\":%s,\"weight\":%d,\"source\":",
5316 has_wit ? "true" : "false", has_wit ? res.wit_w : 0);
5317 json_write_str(f, has_wit ? res.wit_src : NULL);
5318 fputs(",\"base\":1,\"support\":[", f);
5319 if (has_wit) {
5320 for (int i = 0; i < res.wit_w; i++) {
5321 if (i > 0) fputc(',', f);
5322 fprintf(f, "%d", 1 + col_orig_index(p, res.wit_cols[i]));
5323 }
5324 }
5325 fputs("]}}", f);
5326}
5327
5328/* Emit the JSON summary (file first, then '# RESULT {...}' as the last line of stderr) and release resources */
5329static void res_emit(const params_t * const p, const res_summary_t * const s) {
5330 if (!res.on) return;
5331 if (res.f) {
5332 res_write_json(res.f, p, s);
5333 fputc('\n', res.f);
5334 if (fclose(res.f) != 0)
5335 fprintf(stderr, "# WARNING: json=%s: write error (%s)\n", p->json_file, strerror(errno));
5336 res.f = NULL;
5337 }
5338 if (p->json) {
5339 fputs("# RESULT ", stderr);
5340 res_write_json(stderr, p, s);
5341 fputc('\n', stderr);
5342 fflush(stderr);
5343 }
5344 res_free();
5345}
5346
5347/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *
5348 * The rank check of k = 0 when not known at once (p->k_zero = -1 after var_init()): one extra thread does the
5349 * elimination (k_zero_rank(), malloc only) on its own copies of H and L during the search. A codeword found proves
5350 * k > 0: the check is not waited for (it is stopped at the end, see k0_check_exit()); if it finds k = 0, it stops the
5351 * run (STOP_K0); a search which ends without a codeword waits for it (k0_check_finish()).
5352 * ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
5353enum { K0_RUNNING = 0, K0_POSITIVE, K0_ZERO };
5354
5355typedef struct {
5356 pthread_t tid;
5357 bool started, joined;
5358 csr_t *H, *L; /* the copies of H and L (L: NULL for a classical code), freed by the thread */
5359 atomic_int result; /* K0_RUNNING, K0_POSITIVE (k > 0), or K0_ZERO (k = 0) */
5360 atomic_int stop; /* nonzero: the thread ends without a result */
5361 _Atomic(distfork_ctx_t *) ctx; /* the run to stop on k = 0 (NULL until its stop flags are initialized) */
5362 char reason[sizeof(prm.k0_reason)]; /* why k = 0 (written before `result`) */
5363} k0_check_t;
5364
5365static k0_check_t k0c;
5366
5367static csr_t *k0_csr_copy(const csr_t * const a) {
5368 const int nz = (a->nz == -1) ? a->p[a->rows] : a->nz;
5369 csr_t * const b = csr_init(NULL, a->rows, a->cols, nz > 0 ? nz : 1);
5370 memcpy(b->p, a->p, (size_t)((a->nz == -1) ? a->rows + 1 : nz) * sizeof(int));
5371 memcpy(b->i, a->i, (size_t)nz * sizeof(int));
5372 b->nz = a->nz;
5373 return b;
5374}
5375
5376static void *k0_check_thread(void *arg) {
5377 (void)arg;
5378 const int zero = k_zero_rank(k0c.H, k0c.L, k0c.reason, sizeof(k0c.reason), &k0c.stop);
5379 k0c.H = csr_free(k0c.H);
5380 if (k0c.L) k0c.L = csr_free(k0c.L);
5381 if (zero < 0) return NULL; /* (stopped) */
5382 atomic_store(&k0c.result, zero ? K0_ZERO : K0_POSITIVE);
5383 if (zero) { /* (with k = 0 no codeword is found, so that main() is still in the run or waits for this thread) */
5384 distfork_ctx_t * const ctx = atomic_load(&k0c.ctx);
5385 if (ctx) ctx_stop(ctx, STOP_K0);
5386 }
5387 return NULL;
5388}
5389
5390/* Start the rank check of k = 0 in its own thread (without a thread: before the search) */
5391static void k0_check_start(params_t * const p) {
5392 k0c.H = k0_csr_copy(p->spaH);
5393 k0c.L = p->classical ? NULL : k0_csr_copy(p->spaL);
5394 atomic_init(&k0c.result, K0_RUNNING);
5395 atomic_init(&k0c.stop, 0);
5396 atomic_init(&k0c.ctx, NULL);
5397 k0c.started = (pthread_create(&k0c.tid, NULL, k0_check_thread, NULL) == 0);
5398 if (!k0c.started)
5399 k0_check_thread(NULL);
5400 if (p->debug & DBG_TIMING)
5401 fprintf(stderr, "# the rank check of k=0 runs %s\n", k0c.started ? "in its own thread" : "before the search");
5402}
5403
5404/* The run whose stop flags are initialized: stopped at once if the rank check has already found k = 0 (with the store
5405 * of k0_check_thread() before its load, at least one of the two sees the other) */
5406static void k0_check_publish(distfork_ctx_t * const ctx) {
5407 atomic_store(&k0c.ctx, ctx);
5408 if (atomic_load(&k0c.result) == K0_ZERO) ctx_stop(ctx, STOP_K0);
5409}
5410
5411/* After a search (or none): returns 1 if the rank check found k = 0 (then sets p->k_zero and p->k0_reason), waiting
5412 * for it only if no codeword proves k > 0 */
5413static int k0_check_finish(params_t * const p) {
5414 if (p->k_zero >= 0 || p->num_cws > 0 || p->min_w < INT_MAX)
5415 return p->k_zero == 1;
5416 if (k0c.started && !k0c.joined) {
5417 pthread_join(k0c.tid, NULL);
5418 k0c.joined = true;
5419 }
5420 if (atomic_load(&k0c.result) != K0_ZERO) {
5421 p->k_zero = 0;
5422 return 0;
5423 }
5424 p->k_zero = 1;
5425 memcpy(p->k0_reason, k0c.reason, sizeof(p->k0_reason));
5426 return 1;
5427}
5428
5429/* The result of a run with k = 0 found by the rank check */
5430static void k0_print_result(const params_t * const p) {
5431 k_zero_note(p, "0 0 0");
5432 printf("0 0 0\n");
5433}
5434
5435/* The end of main(): the rank check, if it still runs (a codeword proved k > 0), is stopped (it polls k0c.stop every
5436 * 256 columns) and joined; returns 0 */
5437static int k0_check_exit(void) {
5438 if (k0c.started && !k0c.joined) {
5439 atomic_store(&k0c.stop, 1);
5440 pthread_join(k0c.tid, NULL);
5441 k0c.joined = true;
5442 }
5443 return 0;
5444}
5445
5446typedef struct {
5447 uint64_t h;
5448 int c;
5449} cc_hash_col_t;
5450
5451static int cc_hash_col_cmp(const void *a, const void *b) {
5452 const cc_hash_col_t *x = a, *y = b;
5453 if (x->h != y->h) return (x->h < y->h) ? -1 : 1;
5454 return (x->c > y->c) - (x->c < y->c);
5455}
5456
5457/* The CC column-syndrome hash of H (mHT: its transpose with m rows), see cc_hash_t; NULL if H has no nonzero column */
5458static cc_hash_t *cc_hash_new(const csr_t * const mHT, const int m) {
5459 const int n = mHT->rows;
5460 cc_hash_t * const hs = calloc(1, sizeof(cc_hash_t));
5461 cc_hash_col_t * const tmp = malloc((size_t)(n > 0 ? n : 1) * sizeof(cc_hash_col_t));
5462 if (!hs || !tmp) ERROR("memory allocation");
5463 hs->zr = malloc((size_t)(m > 0 ? m : 1) * sizeof(uint64_t));
5464 hs->hc = calloc((size_t)(n > 0 ? n : 1), sizeof(uint64_t));
5465 if (!hs->zr || !hs->hc) ERROR("memory allocation");
5466 uint64_t state = 0x243f6a8885a308d3ULL; /* fixed: the results do not depend on the hash */
5467 for (int r = 0; r < m; r++) hs->zr[r] = splitmix64(&state);
5468 int nz = 0;
5469 for (int c = 0; c < n; c++) {
5470 if (mHT->p[c + 1] == mHT->p[c]) continue;
5471 uint64_t h = 0;
5472 for (int k = mHT->p[c]; k < mHT->p[c + 1]; k++) h ^= hs->zr[mHT->i[k]];
5473 hs->hc[c] = h;
5474 tmp[nz].h = h;
5475 tmp[nz++].c = c;
5476 }
5477 if (nz == 0) {
5478 free(tmp);
5479 free(hs->zr);
5480 free(hs->hc);
5481 free(hs);
5482 return NULL;
5483 }
5484 qsort(tmp, nz, sizeof(cc_hash_col_t), cc_hash_col_cmp);
5485 int nkeys = 0;
5486 for (int k = 0; k < nz; k++) nkeys += (k == 0 || tmp[k].h != tmp[k - 1].h);
5487 int lg = 0; /* ceil(log2(nkeys)) */
5488 while ((1LL << lg) < nkeys) lg++;
5489 const int tbits = lg + 1; /* table: at most half full */
5490 const int fbits = (lg + 4 > 6) ? lg + 4 : 6; /* filter: 16 bits per key */
5491 hs->tshift = 64 - tbits;
5492 hs->tmask = (int)((1ULL << tbits) - 1);
5493 hs->tab = calloc((size_t)1 << tbits, sizeof(cc_hash_slot_t));
5494 hs->bmask = ((uint64_t)1 << fbits) - 1;
5495 hs->bits = calloc((size_t)1 << (fbits - 6), sizeof(uint64_t));
5496 hs->cols = malloc((size_t)nz * sizeof(int));
5497 if (!hs->tab || !hs->bits || !hs->cols) ERROR("memory allocation");
5498 for (int k = 0; k < nz; k++) hs->cols[k] = tmp[k].c;
5499 for (int k = 0; k < nz;) {
5500 const uint64_t key = tmp[k].h;
5501 int k2 = k + 1;
5502 while (k2 < nz && tmp[k2].h == key) k2++;
5503 int j = (int)(key >> hs->tshift);
5504 while (hs->tab[j].cnt > 0) j = (j + 1) & hs->tmask;
5505 hs->tab[j].key = key;
5506 hs->tab[j].beg = k;
5507 hs->tab[j].cnt = k2 - k;
5508 const uint64_t fb = key & hs->bmask;
5509 hs->bits[fb >> 6] |= (uint64_t)1 << (fb & 63);
5510 k = k2;
5511 }
5512 hs->ncols = nz;
5513 hs->nkeys = nkeys;
5514 free(tmp);
5515 return hs;
5516}
5517
5518static void cc_hash_free(cc_hash_t * const hs) {
5519 if (!hs) return;
5520 free(hs->zr);
5521 free(hs->hc);
5522 free(hs->bits);
5523 free(hs->tab);
5524 free(hs->cols);
5525 free(hs);
5526}
5527
5528/* steplog=FILE: open the log of the RW steps (before the workers start) and write its header (see steplog_t) */
5529static void steplog_open(distfork_ctx_t * const ctx) {
5530 const params_t * const p = ctx->p;
5531 steplog_t * const sl = calloc(1, sizeof(steplog_t));
5532 if (!sl) ERROR("memory allocation");
5533 sl->f = fopen(p->steplog, "w");
5534 if (!sl->f) ERROR("can't open the file steplog='%s' for writing: %s", p->steplog, strerror(errno));
5535 setvbuf(sl->f, NULL, _IOFBF, (size_t)1 << 20);
5536 pthread_mutex_init(&sl->mtx, NULL);
5537 if (ctx->zcol) {
5538 sl->zcol = ctx->zcol;
5539 } else { /* (the same values as rw_stages_setup()) */
5540 sl->own_zcol = rw_zobrist_cols(p->spaH->cols);
5541 sl->zcol = sl->own_zcol;
5542 }
5543 sl->smask = 1023;
5544 sl->seen = calloc((size_t)sl->smask + 1, sizeof(uint64_t));
5545 if (!sl->seen) ERROR("memory allocation");
5546 const int nvar = p->spaH->cols;
5547 const bool hyb = (p->kwin == 0) && !ctx->slab_on && rw_hybrid_on(p, nvar);
5548 fprintf(sl->f, "# dist_m4ri steplog: input=%s n=%d m=%d rows_L=%d classical=%d method=%d threads=%d rw_threads=%d "
5549 "steps=%ld seed=%d rw_opt=%d rw_active=0x%x kwin=%d win_mode=%d hybrid_window=%d pairs=%d min_hits=%d "
5550 "cov_cws=%d slab_on=%d slab_rows=%d slab_bnd=%d slab_var=%d slab_every=%d T3=%lld G_rows=%d\n",
5551 p->fdem ? p->fdem : (p->finH ? p->finH : (p->fin ? p->fin : "")), nvar, p->spaH->rows,
5552 p->maskL ? p->maskL->rows : 0, p->classical, p->method, ctx->num_threads, ctx->rw_threads,
5553 ctx->total_rw_steps, p->seed, p->rw_opt, (unsigned int)ctx->rw_active, p->kwin, p->win_mode,
5554 hyb ? hybrid_window(p, nvar) : 0, p->pairs, p->min_hits, p->cov_cws, ctx->slab_on,
5555 ctx->slab_on ? ctx->slab_msub : 0, p->slab_bnd, p->slab_var, p->slab_every,
5556 ctx->t3 ? ctx->t3->ntrip : 0LL, ctx->gdb ? ctx->gdb->nrows : 0);
5557 fprintf(sl->f, "# S tid step type a b ns rank ok ncw t_us dt_us (type u: uniform, i: index window of the columns "
5558 "a..b-1 mod n, b: BFS window, seed column a, b columns, s: row slab of the detectors a..b-1; ok=0: abandoned "
5559 "at a stop; t_us: the end since the start, dt_us: the duration, microseconds)\n");
5560 fprintf(sl->f, "# C w key ckey flag o [lsig rlo rhi c_1 ... c_w] (flag n: new in the codeword hash, o: one more hit, "
5561 "x: not kept; o: 1 a single column, 2 a pair, 5 and 6 their shortened forms; ckey 0: not computed; on the "
5562 "first line of a key: its L syndrome, the smallest and largest detector, and its 0-based columns)\n");
5563 if (fflush(sl->f) != 0) ERROR("steplog: write error (%s)", strerror(errno));
5564 ctx->steplog = sl;
5565 if ((p->debug & DBG_SUMMARY) && (!(p->method & 1) || ctx->rw_threads == 0 || p->ksub > 0))
5566 fprintf(stderr, "# Note: steplog=%s: no full-matrix RW steps to log (method=2, steps=0, or ksub > 0)\n",
5567 p->steplog);
5568}
5569
5570/* steplog=FILE: write the last line of the log (the result) and close it (after the workers ended) */
5571static void steplog_close(distfork_ctx_t * const ctx, const int dmin, const int dmax, const long rw_steps) {
5572 steplog_t * const sl = ctx->steplog;
5573 if (!sl) return;
5574 fprintf(sl->f, "# end: dmin=%d dmax=%d rw_steps=%ld steps_logged=%lld cw_lines=%lld keys=%u%s stop=%d time=%.3f\n",
5575 dmin, dmax, rw_steps, sl->nsteps, sl->ncw, sl->nseen, sl->seen_full ? " (full)" : "",
5576 atomic_load(&ctx->stop_reason), get_time_sec() - ctx->start_time);
5577 if (fclose(sl->f) != 0) fprintf(stderr, "# WARNING: steplog=%s: write error (%s)\n", ctx->p->steplog,
5578 strerror(errno));
5579 pthread_mutex_destroy(&sl->mtx);
5580 free(sl->own_zcol);
5581 free(sl->seen);
5582 free(sl);
5583 ctx->steplog = NULL;
5584}
5585
5586int main(int argc, char **argv) {
5587 params_t * const p = &prm;
5588 memset(&res, 0, sizeof(res));
5589 res.t_proc0 = get_time_sec();
5590
5591 var_init(argc, argv, p);
5592 res_init(p);
5593
5594 /* k = 0 known at once (no codeword, see var_init()): no search, the result 0 0 0 (with outC, none exported) */
5595 if (p->k_zero == 1) {
5596 res_open_file(p);
5597 const double t_now = get_time_sec();
5598 k_zero_note(p, "0 0 0");
5599 printf("0 0 0\n");
5600 fflush(stdout);
5601 if (p->outC) {
5602 const long long num_written = nzlist_write(p->outC, "generated by dist_m4ri", p);
5603 if (p->debug & DBG_SUMMARY)
5604 fprintf(stderr, "# exported %lld codewords to %s\n", num_written, p->outC);
5605 }
5606 if (res.on) {
5607 if (p->seed <= 0) /* (var_init() returned before resolving seed when all DEM columns were removed) */
5608 p->seed = time(NULL) - 1000 * p->seed + 10 * getpid();
5609 char stxt[128];
5610 if (p->k0_reason[0]) snprintf(stxt, sizeof(stxt), "k=0: no logical codeword (%s)", p->k0_reason);
5611 else snprintf(stxt, sizeof(stxt), "k=0: no logical codeword");
5612 res_event_push(0.0, 0, 0);
5613 const res_summary_t sm = {
5614 .dmin = 0, .dmax = 0, .rw_steps = 0, .rw_steps_done = 0, .k0 = true, .search = false,
5615 .stop_code = "k0", .stop_text = stxt, .t_input = t_now - res.t_proc0, .t_stop = 0.0,
5616 .req_threads = p->threads, .used_threads = 0, .spawned_threads = 0, .rw_threads = 0, .cc_threads = 0,
5617 .rw_active = 0
5618 };
5619 res_emit(p, &sm);
5620 }
5621 var_kill(p);
5622 return 0;
5623 }
5624
5625 if (p->finC) {
5626 nzlist_read(p->finC, p);
5627 if (res.on && p->min_w != INT_MAX) res_witness_from_hash(p, "finc");
5628 }
5629 res_open_file(p);
5630
5631 /* k not known at once: the rank check in its own thread during the search (a codeword of finC proves k > 0) */
5632 if (p->k_zero < 0 && p->num_cws == 0)
5633 k0_check_start(p);
5634
5635 /* Check ksub feasibility before the RW stages and the thread throttling (require m >= nu >= n - m): otherwise
5636 * full-matrix RW (ksub=0), with the RW stages, the thread limits, and the L hashes of the pairs of ksub=0 */
5637 mzd_t *ksub_N = NULL; /* (the basis of ker(H) for ksub > 0, see ctx.N_global) */
5638 int ksub_nu = 0;
5639 if ((p->method & 1) && p->ksub > 0 && p->spaH) {
5640 int nrows = p->spaH->rows;
5641 int nvar = p->spaH->cols;
5642 if (2 * nrows < nvar) {
5643 if (p->debug & DBG_SUMMARY) {
5644 fprintf(stderr,
5645 "# Warning: ksub=%d requested, but m=%d < n-m=%d (<= nu); "
5646 "falling back to full-matrix RW (ksub=0)\n",
5647 p->ksub, nrows, nvar - nrows);
5648 }
5649 p->ksub = 0;
5650 } else if (!(p->method == 3 && p->steps == 0)) { /* (no RW with method=3 steps=0) */
5651 const double t_ker0 = get_time_sec();
5652 ksub_N = mzd_nullspace(p->spaH);
5653 ksub_nu = ksub_N ? ksub_N->nrows : 0;
5654 if (nrows < ksub_nu || ksub_nu <= 0) {
5655 if (p->debug & DBG_SUMMARY) {
5656 fprintf(stderr,
5657 "# Warning: ksub=%d requested, but m=%d < nu=%d; "
5658 "falling back to full-matrix RW (ksub=0)\n",
5659 p->ksub, nrows, ksub_nu);
5660 }
5661 safe_mzd_free(ksub_N);
5662 ksub_N = NULL;
5663 ksub_nu = 0;
5664 p->ksub = 0;
5665 } else if (p->debug & DBG_TIMING) {
5666 fprintf(stderr, "# computed ker(H) in %.4fs: nu=%d, n=%d, ksub=%d (eff=%d)\n", get_time_sec() - t_ker0, ksub_nu,
5667 nvar, p->ksub, minint(p->ksub, ksub_nu));
5668 }
5669 }
5670 }
5671 if ((p->method & 1) && p->ksub > 0) { /* (after a fallback to ksub=0, the RW stages and the pairs run) */
5672 if (p->rw_opt > 0)
5673 fprintf(stderr, "# WARNING: rw_opt=%d is ignored with ksub=%d (no RW stages with the experimental ksub)\n",
5674 p->rw_opt, p->ksub);
5675 if (p->pairs > 0)
5676 fprintf(stderr, "# WARNING: pairs=%d is ignored with ksub=%d (no RW pairs with the experimental ksub)\n",
5677 p->pairs, p->ksub);
5678 }
5679
5680 /* The RW stages of rw_opt (see rw_stages_plan()), before the thread throttling (Stage 4 needs less memory per RW
5681 * thread) */
5682 p->rw_active = rw_stages_plan(p);
5683 p->rw_planned = 1; /* (Rule D3, see rw_hybrid_on(): keyed on the resolved mask from now on) */
5684
5685 /* Determine number of threads (default: all logical CPUs available to the process) */
5686 int requested_threads = p->threads;
5687 int num_threads = p->threads;
5688 if (num_threads <= 0) num_threads = available_cpus();
5689 /* Workers which may run RW (each allocates dense RW matrices): all workers in method 1, none in method 2.
5690 * In method 3, the RW share may be limited further while CC rounds can use all workers. */
5691 int rw_threads = 0;
5692
5693 if (!p->nothrottle) {
5694 /* Thread throttling for small codes and large-memory matrices */
5695 int nvar = p->nvar;
5696 int nrows = p->spaH ? p->spaH->rows : 0;
5697 unsigned long long n_elements = (unsigned long long)nrows * (unsigned long long)nvar;
5698
5699 /* 1. Small-code throttling by the RW work (methods 1 and 3): avoid the thread start-up overhead on tiny
5700 * workloads. The CC work is not known in advance: method 2 starts a few workers only, and the others once a
5701 * CC round takes longer (see CC_SPAWN_INITIAL) */
5702 if (p->method & 1) {
5703 const double rw_work = (double)n_elements * (double)(p->steps > 0 ? p->steps : 1);
5704 if (nvar < 60 || (n_elements < 20000ULL && rw_work < 5.0e7)) {
5705 if (num_threads > 4) num_threads = 4;
5706 } else if ((nvar < 150 || n_elements < 100000ULL) && rw_work < 2.0e8) {
5707 if (num_threads > 16) num_threads = 16;
5708 }
5709 }
5710
5711 /* 2. Large-matrix memory throttling and 3. steps throttling: these limit only the RW workers, i.e., all
5712 * workers in method 1 and the RW share in method 3; CC (method 2, CC rounds in method 3) is not limited */
5713 if (p->method & 1) {
5714 const int rw_cap = rw_thread_cap(p);
5715 if (p->method == 1 && num_threads > rw_cap) num_threads = rw_cap;
5716 rw_threads = minint(num_threads, rw_cap);
5717 }
5718
5719 if (requested_threads > 0 && num_threads != requested_threads && (p->debug & DBG_TIMING)) {
5720 fprintf(stderr, "# Note: throttled threads from %d to %d (n=%d, r=%d)\n",
5721 requested_threads, num_threads, nvar, nrows);
5722 }
5723 } else {
5724 if (p->method & 1) rw_threads = num_threads;
5725 if (p->debug & DBG_TIMING) {
5726 fprintf(stderr, "# Thread throttling disabled (nothrottle=1); running with %d threads\n", num_threads);
5727 }
5728 }
5729 if (p->method == 3 && p->steps == 0) {
5730 rw_threads = 0; /* no RW steps: pure CC through the bracketing coordinator, no RW matrices needed */
5731 }
5732 if (rw_threads == 0) p->rw_active = 0;
5733 /* the line of the hybrid windows of the input summary, if an rw_opt != 0 resolved to 0 (see rw_hybrid_on()) */
5734 if ((p->debug & DBG_SUMMARY) && rw_threads > 0 && p->rw_opt != 0 && !p->fdem && p->win_hyb <= 0 &&
5735 rw_hybrid_on(p, p->nvar))
5736 print_window_summary(stderr, p);
5737 if (p->method == 3 && rw_threads < num_threads && (p->debug & DBG_TIMING)) {
5738 if (rw_threads == 0) {
5739 fprintf(stderr, "# Note: steps=0, no RW; CC rounds use all %d threads\n", num_threads);
5740 } else {
5741 fprintf(stderr, "# Note: RW limited to %d of %d threads (memory, steps); CC rounds can use all threads\n",
5742 rw_threads, num_threads);
5743 }
5744 }
5745
5746 /* the columns of H (also for CC), and Stage 1 of rw_opt with the tables of the RW stages (before the bounds: the
5747 * pure-logical columns are codewords of weight 1); the clock of the timeout starts here, so that the enumeration of
5748 * T_3 (up to about one second, see RW_T3_BUDGET) counts */
5749 const double t_start = get_time_sec();
5750 csr_t * const mHT = csr_transpose(NULL, p->spaH);
5751 rw_t3_t *t3 = NULL;
5752 rw_gdb_t *gdb = NULL;
5753 uint64_t *zcol = NULL;
5754 if (p->rw_active) rw_stages_setup(p, mHT, &t3, &gdb, &zcol);
5755 if (res.on && p->min_w != INT_MAX) res_witness_from_hash(p, "rw");
5756 p->nhits_src = rw_nhits_sources(p); /* (the hits of <n>, on the final mask; those before the search count anyway) */
5757
5758 double timeout = (p->timeout > 0.0) ? p->timeout : 0.0;
5759
5760 distfork_ctx_t ctx;
5761 memset(&ctx, 0, sizeof(ctx));
5762 ctx.p = p;
5763 ctx.num_threads = num_threads;
5764 ctx.rw_threads = rw_threads;
5765 ctx.timeout = timeout;
5766 ctx.start_time = t_start;
5767 ctx.dexp = p->dexp;
5768 ctx.total_rw_steps = (p->steps >= 0) ? p->steps : 1;
5769
5770 /* Initialize dmin and dmax */
5771 atomic_init(&ctx.dmin, p->dmin > 1 ? p->dmin : 1);
5772 int init_dmax = 0;
5773 if (p->dmax > 0) {
5774 init_dmax = p->dmax;
5775 }
5776 if (p->min_w != INT_MAX) {
5777 if (init_dmax == 0 || p->min_w < init_dmax) {
5778 init_dmax = p->min_w;
5779 }
5780 }
5781 atomic_init(&ctx.dmax, init_dmax);
5782
5783 if (init_dmax > 0 && p->wmin > 0 && init_dmax <= p->wmin && !p->outC && p->maxC == 0) {
5784 const double t_stop = get_time_sec() - t_start;
5785 const bool is_k0 = (k0_check_finish(p) != 0);
5786 int dmin_out = 0, dmax_out = 0;
5787 const char *scode = "k0";
5788 char stxt[128] = "the rank check found k=0 (no logical codeword)";
5789 if (is_k0) { /* (no codeword: the rank check is waited for) */
5790 k0_print_result(p);
5791 } else {
5792 dmin_out = p->dmin > 1 ? p->dmin : 1;
5793 dmax_out = init_dmax;
5794 scode = "wmin";
5795 snprintf(stxt, sizeof(stxt), "known upper bound dmax=%d <= wmin=%d (no search)", init_dmax, p->wmin);
5796 if (p->debug & DBG_SUMMARY)
5797 fprintf(stderr, "# stopped: %s%s\n", stxt, tstamp_at(p, t_stop).s);
5798 printf("%d %d 0\n", dmin_out, dmax_out);
5799 }
5800 fflush(stdout);
5801 if (res.on) {
5802 res_event_push(is_k0 ? t_stop : 0.0, dmin_out, dmax_out);
5803 const res_summary_t sm = {
5804 .dmin = dmin_out, .dmax = dmax_out, .rw_steps = 0, .rw_steps_done = 0, .k0 = is_k0, .search = false,
5805 .stop_code = scode, .stop_text = stxt, .t_input = t_start - res.t_proc0, .t_stop = t_stop,
5806 .req_threads = requested_threads, .used_threads = 0, .spawned_threads = 0, .rw_threads = 0, .cc_threads = 0,
5807 .rw_active = p->rw_active
5808 };
5809 res_emit(p, &sm);
5810 }
5811 csr_free(mHT);
5812 rw_t3_free(t3);
5813 rw_gdb_free(gdb);
5814 free(zcol);
5815 safe_mzd_free(ksub_N);
5816 var_kill(p);
5817 return k0_check_exit();
5818 }
5819
5820 if (p->method == 3 && init_dmax > 0 && p->dmin > 1 && p->dmin >= init_dmax && !p->outC) {
5821 const double t_stop = get_time_sec() - t_start;
5822 const bool is_k0 = (k0_check_finish(p) != 0);
5823 int dmin_out = 0, dmax_out = 0;
5824 const char *scode = "k0";
5825 char stxt[128] = "the rank check found k=0 (no logical codeword)";
5826 if (is_k0) {
5827 k0_print_result(p);
5828 } else {
5829 dmin_out = p->dmin;
5830 dmax_out = init_dmax;
5831 scode = "bounds";
5832 snprintf(stxt, sizeof(stxt), "bounds coincide: dmin = dmax = %d (supplied, no search)", init_dmax);
5833 if (p->debug & DBG_SUMMARY)
5834 fprintf(stderr, "# stopped: %s%s\n", stxt, tstamp_at(p, t_stop).s);
5835 printf("%d %d 0\n", dmin_out, dmax_out);
5836 }
5837 fflush(stdout);
5838 if (res.on) {
5839 res_event_push(is_k0 ? t_stop : 0.0, dmin_out, dmax_out);
5840 const res_summary_t sm = {
5841 .dmin = dmin_out, .dmax = dmax_out, .rw_steps = 0, .rw_steps_done = 0, .k0 = is_k0, .search = false,
5842 .stop_code = scode, .stop_text = stxt, .t_input = t_start - res.t_proc0, .t_stop = t_stop,
5843 .req_threads = requested_threads, .used_threads = 0, .spawned_threads = 0, .rw_threads = 0, .cc_threads = 0,
5844 .rw_active = p->rw_active
5845 };
5846 res_emit(p, &sm);
5847 }
5848 csr_free(mHT);
5849 rw_t3_free(t3);
5850 rw_gdb_free(gdb);
5851 free(zcol);
5852 safe_mzd_free(ksub_N);
5853 var_kill(p);
5854 return k0_check_exit();
5855 }
5856
5857 /* the supplied dmin already reaches the stop target dstop (any method; with outC or maxC, the CC rounds which collect
5858 * codewords still run) */
5859 if (p->dstop > 0 && p->dmin >= p->dstop && !p->outC && p->maxC == 0) {
5860 const double t_stop = get_time_sec() - t_start;
5861 const bool is_k0 = (k0_check_finish(p) != 0);
5862 int dmin_out = 0, dmax_out = 0;
5863 const char *scode = "k0";
5864 char stxt[128] = "the rank check found k=0 (no logical codeword)";
5865 if (is_k0) {
5866 k0_print_result(p);
5867 } else {
5868 dmin_out = (init_dmax > 0 && p->dmin >= init_dmax) ? init_dmax : p->dmin;
5869 dmax_out = init_dmax;
5870 scode = "dstop";
5871 snprintf(stxt, sizeof(stxt), "lower bound dmin=%d >= dstop=%d (supplied, no search)", p->dmin, p->dstop);
5872 if (p->debug & DBG_SUMMARY)
5873 fprintf(stderr, "# stopped: %s%s\n", stxt, tstamp_at(p, t_stop).s);

6240 for (int t = 0; t < ctx.spawned; t++) {
6241 for (int k = 0; k < 2; k++) {
6242 fsum[k] += args[t].fkg_sum[k];
6243 fsteps[k] += args[t].fkg_steps[k];
6244 }
6245 }
6246 if (fsteps[0] + fsteps[1] > 0 && rw_rank > 0) /* the mean Harris-FKG score, and -ln C(n, r) */
6247 fprintf(stderr, "# RW FKG score: mean_unif=%.2f (steps=%ld), mean_win=%.2f (steps=%ld), -lnC=%.2f\n",
6248 fsteps[0] ? fsum[0] / fsteps[0] : 0.0, fsteps[0], fsteps[1] ? fsum[1] / fsteps[1] : 0.0, fsteps[1],
6249 -(lgamma(p->nvar + 1.0) - lgamma(rw_rank + 1.0) - lgamma(p->nvar - rw_rank + 1.0)));
6250 }
6251 /* the RW upper bound is not certified: warn if the hit counts suggest that some codewords are much harder to
6252 * find than others of the same weight (one pass over the codewords in hash), and then also print the
6253 * information-set estimate of the probability that RW missed a lighter codeword (not after the stop target
6254 * dstop was reached: codewords of weight >= dstop are not needed) */
6255 if (reported_rw_steps > 0 && final_dmin < final_dmax && atomic_load(&ctx.stop_reason) != STOP_DSTOP &&
6256 codeword_hit_check(stderr, p) > 0 && rw_unif > 0 && rw_rank > 0) {
6257 print_rw_infoset_estimate(stderr, p->nvar, rw_rank, (final_dmin > 1) ? final_dmin : 1, final_dmax - 1,
6258 rw_unif, rw_done, (ctx.rw_threads > 0) ? t_step / ctx.rw_threads : 0.0, rw_pairs_l);
6259 }
6260 }
6261
6262 /* Output to stdout: dmin dmax rw_steps (0 0 0 for k = 0, after the note) */
6263 if (k0)
6264 k_zero_note(p, "0 0 0");
6265 printf("%d %d %ld\n", final_dmin, final_dmax, reported_rw_steps);
6266 fflush(stdout);
6267 steplog_close(&ctx, final_dmin, final_dmax, reported_rw_steps); /* (steplog=FILE) */
6268
6269 /* rw_opt bit 32: the codewords obtained from those found by T_3 (2 <-> 2 exchanges, 1 -> 2 splits) and by the 1 <-> 1
6270 * swaps of identical columns, before the export (at most RW_EXPAND_MAX of them) */
6271 if ((ctx.rw_active & RW_OPT_EXPAND) && ctx.collecting && p->min_w < INT_MAX) {
6272 rw_tws_t * const ws = rw_tws_init(p->spaH->cols, NULL, p->spaH->rows);
6273 const long long cnt0 = p->num_cws;
6274 int ntwin = 0;
6275 const long long added = rw_t3_expand(p, t3, ctx.mHT_cc, ws, RW_EXPAND_MAX, &ntwin);
6276 rw_tws_free(ws);
6277 if ((p->debug & DBG_SUMMARY) && ((t3 && t3->ntrip > 0) || ntwin > 0)) {
6278 fprintf(stderr, "# RW triplets: the codewords found expanded by T3 (2 <-> 2 exchanges, 1 -> 2 splits up to "
6279 "weight %d) and by 1 <-> 1 swaps of identical columns (%d columns with a twin): %lld added to %lld\n",
6280 p->min_w + (p->dW > 0 ? p->dW : 0), ntwin, (added < 0) ? -1 - added : added, cnt0);
6281 if (added < 0)
6282 fprintf(stderr, "# Warning: the expansion by T3 stopped after %lld codewords (rw_opt bit 32)\n", -1 - added);
6283 }
6284 }
6285
6286 /* Codeword export */
6287 if (p->outC) {
6288 char comment[256];
6289 sprintf(comment, "generated by dist_m4ri");
6290 const long long num_written = nzlist_write(p->outC, comment, p);
6291 if (p->debug & DBG_SUMMARY) {
6292 fprintf(stderr, "# exported %lld codewords to %s\n", num_written, p->outC);
6293 }
6294 }
6295
6296 if (p->debug & DBG_CWDUMP) {
6297 cw_vec_t *cw;
6298 fprintf(stderr, "# all %lld codewords in hash (1-based columns, cnt: number of hits, of which u in RW steps with "
6299 "uniform permutations, w in RW steps with windows, and s in row slabs):\n", p->num_cws);
6300 for (cw = p->codewords; cw != NULL; cw = (cw_vec_t *)(cw->hh.next)) {
6301 fprintf(stderr, "# cw: [ ");
6302 for (int i = 0; i < cw->weight; i++) fprintf(stderr, "%d ", 1 + col_orig_index(p, cw->arr[i]));
6303 fprintf(stderr, "] cnt=%d (u=%d, w=%d, s=%d)\n", cw->cnt, cw->cnt_u, cw->cnt_w, cw->cnt_s);
6304 }
6305 }
6306
6307 if (res.on) {
6308 res_event_push(t_stop, final_dmin, final_dmax);
6309 const res_summary_t sm = {
6310 .dmin = final_dmin, .dmax = final_dmax, .rw_steps = reported_rw_steps,
6311 .rw_steps_done = atomic_load(&ctx.rw_steps_completed),
6312 .k0 = (k0 != 0), .search = true,
6313 .stop_code = stop_code_str(atomic_load(&ctx.stop_reason)), .stop_text = stop_buf,
6314 .t_input = t_start - res.t_proc0, .t_stop = t_stop,
6315 .req_threads = requested_threads, .used_threads = ctx.num_threads,
6316 .spawned_threads = ctx.spawned,
6317 .rw_threads = minint(ctx.rw_threads, ctx.spawned),
6318 .cc_threads = (p->method >= 2) ? ctx.spawned : 0,
6319 .rw_active = ctx.rw_active
6320 };
6321 res_emit(p, &sm);
6322 }
6323
6324 /* Cleanup */
6325 free(rw_lhash);
6326 rw_t3_free(t3);
6327 rw_gdb_free(gdb);
6328 free(zcol);
6329 rw_canon_tab_free(ctx.canon_tab);
6330 free(ctx.col_rmax);
6331 free(ctx.slab_order);
6332 free(ctx.slab_first);
6333 free(ctx.dcp);
6334 free(ctx.dci);
6335 safe_mzd_free(ctx.N_global);
6336 cc_hash_free(cc_hash);
6337 csr_free(ctx.mHT_cc);
6338 free(ctx.threads);
6339 free(args);
6340 pthread_rwlock_destroy(&ctx.basis_rwlock);
6341 pthread_mutex_destroy(&ctx.cw_mutex);
6342
6343 var_kill(p);
6344
6345 return k0_check_exit();
6346}
